assert(Run:IsStudio() and not Run:IsRunning(),'V16: Stop Play and run this in Roblox Studio. Nothing changed.')

local issues={}
local function problem(message) issues[#issues+1]=tostring(message) end
local function canonical(text) return text:gsub('\r\n','\n'):match('^%s*(.-)%s*$') end
local function stop()
 if #issues>0 then error('V16 compatibility checks stopped; existing game preserved.\n- '..table.concat(issues,'\n- '),0) end
end
local function full(o) return o and o:GetFullName() or '(missing)' end
local function find(path,optional)
 local parts=string.split(path,'/');local current=game:GetService(parts[1])
 for i=2,#parts do
  local matches={}
  for _,o in ipairs(current:GetChildren()) do if o.Name==parts[i] then matches[#matches+1]=o end end
  if #matches~=1 then
   if #matches>1 or not optional then problem(path..': '..(#matches==0 and 'missing '..parts[i] or 'duplicate '..parts[i])) end
   return nil
  end
  current=matches[1]
 end
 return current
end
local function try(label,fn)
 local ok,result=pcall(fn);if not ok then problem(label..': '..tostring(result));return nil end;return result
end

local function motion(o,goal,t)
 if tweens[o] then tweens[o]:Cancel(); tweens[o]=nil end
 if P:GetAttribute("HussReducedMotion")==true then for k,v in pairs(goal) do o[k]=v end; return end
 local a=Tween:Create(o,TweenInfo.new(t or .16,Enum.EasingStyle.Quart,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),goal); tweens[o]=a
 local done; done=a.Completed:Connect(function() if tweens[o]==a then tweens[o]=nil end; if done then done:Disconnect() end end); a:Play()
end

local function button(parent,name,caption,callback,danger,bucket)
 local purchase=name:sub(1,5)=='Item_' or name:sub(1,6)=='Quest_'
 local tone=danger and tones.Close or purchase and rgb(25,227,48) or tones[name:sub(1,3)=='Nav' and name:sub(4) or name] or rgb(47,175,228)
 local b=make('TextButton',parent,{Name=name,Text=caption,TextTransparency=1,TextStrokeTransparency=1,TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,Size=UDim2.fromOffset(120,44),BackgroundColor3=tone,TextColor3=C.white,Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack,TextSize=16,AutoButtonColor=false,BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=(parent.ZIndex or 1)+3})
 rounded(b,12);edge(b,C.ink,4);local rim=gloss(b,true)
 local label=text(b,'ButtonCaption',caption,5,-2,110,44,16,C.white,Enum.TextXAlignment.Center);label.Size=UDim2.new(1,-10,1,0);label.ZIndex=b.ZIndex+6
 local function captionUpdate()
  label.Text=b.Text;label.TextColor3=b.TextColor3;label.TextSize=b.TextSize;label.TextTruncate=b.TextTruncate;label.TextXAlignment=b.TextXAlignment;label.Font=b.TextSize>=18 and Enum.Font.FredokaOne or Enum.Font.GothamBlack
  label:FindFirstChildOfClass('UIStroke').Thickness=b.TextSize>=18 and 2.6 or 1.5
 end
 for _,key in ipairs({'Text','TextColor3','TextSize','TextTruncate','TextXAlignment'}) do connect(b:GetPropertyChangedSignal(key),captionUpdate,bucket) end
 local focused=false
 local function paint()
  local selected=b:GetAttribute('HussSelected')==true;local disabled=b:GetAttribute('HussDisabled')==true
  local color=selected and rgb(47,222,66) or (disabled and rgb(83,110,93) or tone)
  b.Interactable=not disabled;b.Selectable=not disabled
  motion(rim,{Color=selected and C.gold or (focused and not disabled and C.white or color:Lerp(C.white,.45))})
  motion(b,{BackgroundColor3=focused and not disabled and color:Lerp(C.white,.14) or color})
 end
 local function focus(on) focused=on;paint() end
 connect(b.MouseEnter,function() focus(true) end,bucket);connect(b.MouseLeave,function() focus(false) end,bucket)
 connect(b.SelectionGained,function() focus(true) end,bucket);connect(b.SelectionLost,function() focus(false) end,bucket)
 connect(b:GetAttributeChangedSignal('HussSelected'),paint,bucket);connect(b:GetAttributeChangedSignal('HussDisabled'),paint,bucket)
 connect(b.Activated,function() if b:GetAttribute('HussDisabled')~=true then callback() end end,bucket);captionUpdate();return b
end

local function view(parent)

local function fit(v)
 if not v.center then return end
 local size=v.frame.AbsoluteSize; local ratio=size.X/math.max(size.Y,1)
 local angle=math.atan(math.tan(math.rad(v.camera.FieldOfView/2))*math.min(1,ratio))
 local distance=v.radius/math.max(.1,math.sin(angle))*1.12
 v.camera.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(v.center+Vector3.new(1,.86,1).Unit*distance,v.center)
end
local function loadPreview(v,name)
 if v.name==name then fit(v); return end
 v.world:ClearAllChildren(); v.name=nil; v.center=nil
 local source=previewFolder and previewFolder:FindFirstChild(name or "")
 if not source or not source:IsA("Model") then return end
 local copy=source:Clone(); copy.Parent=v.world
 for _,o in ipairs(copy:GetDescendants()) do
  if o:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or o:IsA("SurfaceGui") or o:IsA("BillboardGui") or o:IsA("Light") or o.Name=="Spawns" or (o:IsA("BasePart") and o.Transparency>=1) then o:Destroy() end
 end
 local cf,size=copy:GetBoundingBox(); v.name=name; v.center=cf.Position; v.radius=math.max(size.Magnitude/2,1); fit(v)
end
local function ecoRefresh()
 if U.Mode=='menu' and (menu=='INDEX' or menu=='QUESTS' or menu=='LEADERBOARDS' or menu=='STATS') then local pos=U.Body.CanvasPosition;buildPage();U.Body.CanvasPosition=pos end
end
local function request(action,id)
 if busy or not economy then return end
 serial+=1;local ticket=serial;local generation=epoch;busy=ticket;ecoMessage=nil
 economy:FireServer(action,id,ticket);ecoRefresh()
 task.delay(10,function()
  if started and epoch==generation and busy==ticket then busy=nil;ecoMessage='This is taking longer than expected. Please try again.';ecoRefresh() end
 end)
end
local function cleanText(v,f) return type(v)=='string' and v:sub(1,90) or f or '' end
local function amount(v) return math.clamp(math.floor(num(v,0)),0,1000000000000) end
local function receive(data)
 if type(data)~='table' then return end
 if data.kind=='Profile' then
  local p={ready=data.ready==true,mode=cleanText(data.mode),Equipped=cleanText(data.Equipped),EquippedByCategory={},Catalog={},Quests={},Owned={},resetsAt=amount(data.resetsAt)}
  for _,name in ipairs(categories) do p.EquippedByCategory[name]=type(data.EquippedByCategory)=='table' and cleanText(data.EquippedByCategory[name],defaults[name]) or (name=='Trails' and p.Equipped or defaults[name]) end
  if type(data.Owned)=='table' then for i,id in ipairs(data.Owned) do if i>100 then break end;if type(id)=='string' then p.Owned[id:sub(1,90)]=true end end end
  if type(data.Catalog)=='table' then for i,item in ipairs(data.Catalog) do
   if i>100 then break end
   if type(item)=='table' and type(item.id)=='string' then
    local color=type(item.color)=='table' and item.color or {};table.insert(p.Catalog,{id=cleanText(item.id),name=cleanText(item.name,'Cosmetic'),category=defaults[item.category] and item.category or 'Trails',description=cleanText(item.description,'Equip this cosmetic to make it yours.'),rarity=cleanText(item.rarity,'Common'),style=cleanText(item.style),price=amount(item.price),color=rgb(math.clamp(num(color[1],255),0,255),math.clamp(num(color[2],255),0,255),math.clamp(num(color[3],255),0,255))})
   end
  end end
  if type(data.Quests)=='table' then for i,q in ipairs(data.Quests) do
   if i>12 then break end
   if type(q)=='table' and type(q.id)=='string' then table.insert(p.Quests,{id=cleanText(q.id),title=cleanText(q.title,'Daily quest'),target=math.max(1,amount(q.target)),progress=amount(q.progress),reward=amount(q.reward),gemReward=amount(q.gemReward),claimed=q.claimed==true}) end
  end end
  profile=p
 elseif data.kind=='Board' then
  board={status=cleanText(data.status),rows={}}
  if type(data.rows)=='table' then for i,r in ipairs(data.rows) do
   if i>25 then break end
   if type(r)=='table' then table.insert(board.rows,{name=cleanText(r.name,'Player'),wins=amount(r.wins)}) end
  end end
 else return end
 if busy==data.requestId then
  busy=nil
  if type(data.message)=='string' and data.message~='' then ecoMessage=cleanText(data.message);announce(data.ok==true and 'ALL SET!' or 'PLEASE TRY AGAIN',cleanText(data.message),data.ok==true and C.green or C.gold) end
 end
 ecoRefresh()
end
local function watchPlayer(player)
 if rosterLinks[player] then clear(rosterLinks[player]) end
 local bucket={};rosterLinks[player]=bucket
 local function update() if player==P then U.Identity.Player.Text=player.DisplayName:upper() end;ecoRefresh() end
 if player==P then for _,key in ipairs({"GamesPlayed","Passes","HussEmotePlaying"}) do connect(player:GetAttributeChangedSignal(key),update,bucket) end end
 local function value(v) if v:IsA('IntValue') or v:IsA('NumberValue') then connect(v.Changed,update,bucket) end end
 local function folder(f)
  if f.Name=='leaderstats' then connect(f.ChildAdded,function() watchPlayer(player) end,bucket);connect(f.ChildRemoved,function() watchPlayer(player) end,bucket);for _,v in ipairs(f:GetChildren()) do value(v) end end
 end
 connect(player.ChildAdded,function() watchPlayer(player) end,bucket);connect(player.ChildRemoved,function() watchPlayer(player) end,bucket)
 connect(player:GetPropertyChangedSignal('DisplayName'),update,bucket)
 for _,f in ipairs(player:GetChildren()) do folder(f) end
 update()
end
local function playEmote(id)
 if inRound() or not cosmetics or not profile or not profile.ready or not profile.Owned[id] or profile.EquippedByCategory.Emotes~=id then return end
 if P:GetAttribute('HussEmotePlaying')==id then cosmetics:FireServer('StopEmote')
 elseif time()-emoteAt>=1.3 then emoteAt=time();cosmetics:FireServer('Emote',id) end
end
local function collectionPage(width,y)
 local ownedCount,total=0,0;local list={}
 for _,item in ipairs(profile.Catalog) do if item.category==category then table.insert(list,item);total+=1;if profile.Owned[item.id] then ownedCount+=1 end end end
 local cols=width>=810 and 3 or width>=520 and 2 or 1
 local pageSize=6;local pageCount=math.max(1,math.ceil(total/pageSize));collectionPageNumber=math.clamp(collectionPageNumber,1,pageCount)
 local h=text(U.Body,'CollectionHeading',category:upper()..'  '..ownedCount..'/'..total,5,y,width-16,34,23,categoryColors[category]);h.TextSize=width<350 and 18 or 23;y+=42
 local tabCols=width<520 and 2 or 4
 for i,name in ipairs(categories) do
  local b=button(U.Body,'Category_'..name,name:upper(),function() category=name;collectionPageNumber=1;ecoMessage=nil;buildPage() end,false,pageLinks)
  b.Position=UDim2.new((i-1)%tabCols/tabCols,5,0,y+math.floor((i-1)/tabCols)*53);b.Size=UDim2.new(1/tabCols,-14,0,44);b.TextSize=width<350 and 13 or 16;b:SetAttribute('HussSelected',category==name)
 end
 y+=math.ceil(4/tabCols)*53+4
 local caption=category=='Emotes' and 'Equip and play owned emotes here. Find new ones at the lobby stands.' or 'Equip your collection here. Walk up to the lobby stands to buy new items.'
 text(U.Body,'CollectionDescription',caption,6,y,width-18,32,width<350 and 11 or 14,C.muted).TextWrapped=true;y+=40
 local start=y;local height=344;local count=0
 for i=(collectionPageNumber-1)*pageSize+1,math.min(collectionPageNumber*pageSize,total) do
  local item=list[i];local owned=profile.Owned[item.id]==true;local equipped=profile.EquippedByCategory[category]==item.id
  local accent=item.color:Lerp(C.white,item.color.R+item.color.G+item.color.B<1 and .55 or .2)
  local c=panel(U.Body,'Collectible_'..item.id,250,height,54,accent);c.Position=UDim2.new(count%cols/cols,7,0,start+math.floor(count/cols)*(height+20));c.Size=UDim2.new(1/cols,-16,0,height);count+=1
  c.BackgroundColor3=item.color:Lerp(C.ink,.86);c.Gloss:Destroy();c.InnerRim:FindFirstChildOfClass('UIStroke').Thickness=4
  local g=c:FindFirstChildOfClass('UIGradient');if g then g.Color=ColorSequence.new(rgb(60,67,70),C.white) end
  local art
  if category=='Bombs' and catalog.ById[item.id] then
   art=make('ViewportFrame',c,{Name='BombPreview',Size=UDim2.fromOffset(122,110),BackgroundTransparency=1,Ambient=rgb(205,211,225),LightColor=C.white,LightDirection=Vector3.new(-1,-1,-.5),ZIndex=c.ZIndex+4})
   local world=make('WorldModel',art);local core=make('Part',world,{Name='PreviewBomb',Size=Vector3.new(2.25,2.25,2.25),Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball,Anchored=true,CanCollide=false,CanTouch=false,CanQuery=false})
   skinBuilder.Apply(core,catalog.ById[item.id],{Preview=true})
   local camera=make('Camera',art,{FieldOfView=36,CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(5,3.5,6),Vector3.new(0,.15,0))});art.CurrentCamera=camera
  else art=emblem(c,category,102,item.color) end
  art.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,0);art.Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,0,8)
  local nameY=118
  local title=text(c,'ItemName',item.name:upper(),9,nameY,240,48,23,accent,Enum.TextXAlignment.Center);title.Size=UDim2.new(1,-18,0,48);title.TextWrapped=true
  local rarity=text(c,'Rarity',item.rarity:upper()..' • '..(owned and (equipped and 'EQUIPPED' or 'OWNED') or 'LOCKED'),9,nameY+50,240,22,12,owned and C.green or C.gold,Enum.TextXAlignment.Center);rarity.Size=UDim2.new(1,-18,0,22)
  local description=text(c,'ItemDescription',item.description,14,nameY+76,228,44,12,C.white,Enum.TextXAlignment.Center);description.Size=UDim2.new(1,-28,0,44);description.TextWrapped=true
  local caption=busy and 'PLEASE WAIT…' or equipped and 'EQUIPPED' or owned and 'EQUIP' or 'FIND AT LOBBY STAND'
  local b=button(c,'Item_'..item.id,caption,function() if owned then request('Equip',item.id) end end,false,pageLinks)

local function economyPage(block,width)
 local y=0
 local function card(title,body,color,height)
  local before=#U.Body:GetChildren();block(title,body,color,height);local o=U.Body:GetChildren()[before+1];y+=height+12;return o
 end
 local function action(parent,name,caption,fn,disabled)
  local b=button(parent,name,caption,fn,false,pageLinks);b.Position=UDim2.new(0,12,1,-56);b.Size=UDim2.new(1,-24,0,44);b:SetAttribute('HussDisabled',busy~=nil or disabled==true);return b
 end
 if ecoMessage then card('UPDATE',ecoMessage,C.gold,100) end
 if menu=='LEADERBOARDS' then
  card('THIS SERVER','The same Wins and Coins shown in the Roblox player list.',C.cyan,88)
  local list=Players:GetPlayers()
  local function stat(p,key) local f=p:FindFirstChild('leaderstats');local v=f and f:FindFirstChild(key);return v and (v:IsA('IntValue') or v:IsA('NumberValue')) and amount(v.Value) or 0 end
  table.sort(list,function(a,b) local aw,bw=stat(a,'Wins'),stat(b,'Wins');return aw==bw and a.UserId<b.UserId or aw>bw end)
  for i,p in ipairs(list) do card(i..'. '..p.DisplayName,formatted(stat(p,'Wins'))..' WINS   •   '..formatted(stat(p,'Coins'))..' COINS\n'..formatted(stat(p,'Kills'))..' KILLS   •   '..formatted(stat(p,'FinalStands'))..' FINAL STANDS',p==P and C.gold or C.white,100) end
  local message=not board and 'Load the global wins leaderboard.' or board.status=='ready' and 'Most wins across all servers. Updates about every 2 minutes.' or board.status=='loading' and 'Loading global wins…' or board.status=='preview' and 'Play the published game for global rankings.' or 'Global rankings are temporarily unavailable.'
  local c=card('GLOBAL WINS',message,C.violet,158)
  action(c,'LoadBoard',busy and 'LOADING…' or 'REFRESH GLOBAL WINS',function() request('Board') end,not economy)
  if board and board.status=='ready' then for i,row in ipairs(board.rows) do card('#'..i..'  '..row.name,formatted(row.wins)..' WINS',C.gold,86) end end
 elseif not profile or not profile.ready then
  local c=card('YOUR PLAYER RECORD',profile and profile.mode=='unavailable' and 'Your saved record is unavailable. Please rejoin before earning or spending.' or 'Connecting to your saved coins, quests and collection…',C.gold,180)
  action(c,'RetryProfile',busy and 'CONNECTING…' or 'REFRESH STATUS',function() request('Sync') end,not economy)
 else
  local coins=numberStat('Coins')
  if menu=='QUESTS' then card('DAILY QUESTS','Claim Coins + Gems. Gems are used at the crate shop. Resets at 00:00 UTC.',C.gold,108) end
  if profile.mode=='preview' then card('STUDIO PREVIEW','Preview progress is temporary. Your live saved record is separate.',C.gold,90) end
  if menu=='INDEX' then
   y=collectionPage(width,y)
  else
   for _,q in ipairs(profile.Quests) do
    local done=q.progress>=q.target
    local c=card(q.title:upper(),math.min(q.progress,q.target)..' / '..q.target..'   •   +'..formatted(q.reward)..' COINS  +  '..formatted(q.gemReward or 0)..' GEMS',C.green,166);c.BackgroundColor3=rgb(28,76,73)
    local rail,fill=bar(c,'QuestProgress',C.green);rail.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(14,74);rail.Size=UDim2.new(1,-28,0,7);fill.Size=UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(q.progress/q.target,0,1),1)
    action(c,'Quest_'..q.id,busy and 'PLEASE WAIT…' or q.claimed and 'CLAIMED' or done and 'CLAIM REWARD' or 'IN PROGRESS',function() request('Claim',q.id) end,q.claimed or not done)
   end
  end
 end
 return y
end

 local width=math.max(200,U.Window.Size.X.Offset-44); local y=0
 local function block(title,body,color,height)
  local card=panel(U.Body,title,width-6,height or 100,54,color)

  text(card,"Heading",title,14,10,width-34,22,15,color or C.green).Size=UDim2.new(1,-28,0,22)
  local label=text(card,"Description",body,14,38,width-34,(height or 100)-48,13,C.muted)
  label.Size=UDim2.new(1,-28,0,(height or 100)-48);label.TextWrapped=true; label.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.None; label.TextYAlignment=Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
  y+=(height or 100)+12
 end
 if menu=='INDEX' or menu=='QUESTS' or menu=='LEADERBOARDS' then
  y=economyPage(block,width)
 elseif U.Mode=="result" then
  block("LAST PLAYER STANDING",winner~="" and winner or "No survivor this round.",C.green,130)
  local title=U.Body:GetChildren()[1]; local label=title and title:FindFirstChild("Description")
  if label then label.TextColor3=C.white; label.TextSize=29; label.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack end

 local function currency(n)
  if n>=1000000000 then return string.format('%.1fB',n/1000000000) end
  if n>=1000000 then return string.format('%.1fM',n/1000000) end
  if n>=10000 then return string.format('%.1fK',n/1000) end
  return formatted(n)

local function bindCharacter(new)
 clear(charLinks); character=new; humanoid=nil; dodgeAt=-math.huge
 if not new then return end
 humanoid=new:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 connect(new.ChildAdded,function(child) if child:IsA("Humanoid") then humanoid=child end end,charLinks)
 local last=new:GetAttribute("MovementActionId")
 connect(new:GetAttributeChangedSignal("MovementActionId"),function()
  local id=new:GetAttribute("MovementActionId"); if id==last then return end; last=id
  local action=tostring(new:GetAttribute("MovementAction") or "")
  if action:sub(1,4)=="Dive" and action~="DiveEnd" and action~="DiveRecover" then
   dodgeAt=time(); direction=(action:sub(5):gsub("(%l)(%u)","%1 %2")):upper(); direction="WEAVE "..direction
  end
 end,charLinks)
end
local function onRound(data)
 if type(data)~="table" or type(data.State)~="string" then return end
 local previous=phase; phase=data.State; duration=math.max(0,num(data.TimeLeft,0)); phaseAt=time()
 alive=(phase=="ROUND" or phase=="FINAL_DUEL" or phase=="PRACTICE") and num(data.Alive,phase=="FINAL_DUEL" and 2 or nil) or nil; if alive then alive=math.max(0,math.floor(alive)) end
 if phase=="STARTING" and duration>=1 and duration<=3 then
  local value=tostring(math.ceil(duration)); if countdown~=value then
   countdown=value; countUntil=time()+1.2; U.CountText.Text=value; U.CountText.TextColor3=C.white; U.CountLabel.Text="GET READY TO RUN"; U.CountScale.Scale=reduced() and 1 or .82; motion(U.CountScale,{Scale=1},.23)
  end
 elseif (phase=="ROUND" or phase=="FINAL_DUEL" or phase=="PRACTICE") and previous=="STARTING" then
  countdown="GO!"; countUntil=time()+.7; U.CountText.Text="GO!"; U.CountText.TextColor3=C.green; U.CountLabel.Text="RUN. PASS. SURVIVE."
 else countdown=nil end
 if phase=="RESULT" and previous~="RESULT" then winner=type(data.Winner)=="string" and data.Winner or ""; resultDismissed=false; menu=nil; noticeUntil=0 end
 if phase=="RESULT" or phase=="WAITING" or phase=="INTERMISSION" then bomb=false end
 refresh()
end
local function onBomb(data)
 if type(data)~="table" then return end
 local previousOwner=owner; local event=type(data.Event)=="string" and data.Event or ""
 bomb=data.Active==true; owner=num(data.CarrierUserId,0); carrier=type(data.CarrierName)=="string" and data.CarrierName or "PLAYER"
 fuseEnd=num(data.EndTime,0)
 if event=="Started" then fuseLength=math.max(.1,fuseEnd-workspace:GetServerTimeNow()) end
 if event=="Exploded" then announce(owner==P.UserId and "ELIMINATED" or "PLAYER ELIMINATED",carrier.." ran out of time.",C.red)
 elseif bomb and owner==P.UserId and previousOwner~=owner then announce("YOU HAVE THE BOMB","Find a player. Pass the pressure.",C.red)
 elseif event=="Transferred" and previousOwner==P.UserId then announce("BOMB PASSED","Keep moving. The fuse is still live.",C.green) end
 refresh()
end
local function onVote(kind,data)
 if type(data)~="table" then return end
 if kind=="Open" or kind=="Sync" then
  local valid={}; if type(data.Options)=="table" then for _,name in ipairs(data.Options) do if type(name)=="string" and #valid<3 then table.insert(valid,name) end end end
  options=valid; voteOpen=data.Open==true and #options>0; voteEnd=num(data.EndsAt,0); voteChosen=nil; voteResultUntil=0
  if kind=="Open" then selection=nil; voteDismissed=false end

-- map a value from one range to another
local function map(x: number, inMin: number, inMax: number, outMin: number, outMax: number): number
	return (x - inMin)*(outMax - outMin)/(inMax - inMin) + outMin
end

local function getRelativeVelocity(cm, velocity)
	if not cm then
		return velocity
	end
	local activeSensor = cm.ActiveController and
	(
		(cm.ActiveController:IsA("GroundController") and cm.GroundSensor) or
		(cm.ActiveController:IsA("ClimbController") and cm.ClimbSensor)
	)
	if activeSensor and activeSensor.SensedPart then
		-- Calculate the platform relative velocity by subtracting the velocity of the surface we're attached to or standing on.
		local platformVelocity = activeSensor.SensedPart:GetVelocityAtPosition(cm.RootPart.Position)
		return velocity - platformVelocity
	end
	return velocity
end

local function playSound(sound: Playable, continue: boolean?)
	if not continue then
		(sound :: any).TimePosition = 0
	end
	if FFlagUserNewCharacterSoundsApi and sound:IsA("AudioPlayer") then
		sound:Play()
	else
		(sound :: Sound).Playing = true
	end
end

local function stopSound(sound: Playable)
	if FFlagUserNewCharacterSoundsApi and sound:IsA("AudioPlayer") then
		sound:Stop()
	else
		(sound :: Sound).Playing = false
	end
end

local function playSoundIf(sound: Playable, condition: boolean)
	if FFlagUserNewCharacterSoundsApi and sound:IsA("AudioPlayer") then
		if (sound.IsPlaying and not condition) then
			sound:Stop()
		elseif (not sound.IsPlaying and condition) then
			sound:Play()
		end
	else
		(sound :: Sound).Playing = condition
	end
end

local function setSoundLooped(sound: Playable, isLooped: boolean)
	if FFlagUserNewCharacterSoundsApi and sound:IsA("AudioPlayer") then
		sound.Looping = isLooped
	else
		(sound :: Sound).Looped = isLooped
	end
end

local function shallowCopy(t)
	local out = {}
	for k, v in pairs(t) do
		out[k] = v
	end
	return out
end

local function initializeSoundSystem(instances: { [string]: Instance })
	local humanoid = instances.humanoid
	local rootPart = instances.rootPart
	local audioEmitter = nil
	local cm = nil
	if FFlagUserSoundsUseRelativeVelocity then
		local character = humanoid.Parent
		cm = character:FindFirstChild('ControllerManager')
	end

	local sounds: {[string]: Playable} = {}

	if FFlagUserNewCharacterSoundsApi and SoundService.CharacterSoundsUseNewApi == Enum.RolloutState.Enabled then
		-- initialize Audio Emitter
		local localPlayer = nil
		local character = nil
		local humanoidRootPart = nil
		if FFlagUserFixCharSoundsEmitters then
			humanoidRootPart = humanoid.RootPart
		else
			localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
			character = localPlayer.Character
		end
		local curve = {}
		local i : number = 5
		local step : number = 1.25 -- determines how fine-grained the curve gets sampled
		while i < 150 do
			curve[i] = 5 / i;
			i *= step;
		end
		curve[150] = 0
		if FFlagUserFixCharSoundsEmitters then
			audioEmitter = Instance.new("AudioEmitter", humanoidRootPart)
		else
			audioEmitter = Instance.new("AudioEmitter", character)
		end
		audioEmitter.Name = "RbxCharacterSoundsEmitter"
		audioEmitter:SetDistanceAttenuation(curve)
		-- initialize sounds
		for name: string, props: {[string]: any} in pairs(AUDIOPLAYER_DATA) do
			local sound = Instance.new("AudioPlayer")
			local audioPlayerWire: Wire = Instance.new("Wire")
			sound.Name = name
			audioPlayerWire.Name = name .. "Wire"
			-- set default values
			sound.Archivable = false
			sound.Volume = 0.65
			for propName, propValue: any in pairs(props) do
				(sound :: any)[propName] = propValue
			end
			sound.Parent = rootPart
			audioPlayerWire.Parent = sound
			audioPlayerWire.SourceInstance = sound
			audioPlayerWire.TargetInstance = audioEmitter
			sounds[name] = sound
		end
	else
		-- initialize sounds
		for name: string, props: {[string]: any} in pairs(SOUND_DATA) do
			local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
			sound.Name = name
			-- set default values
			sound.Archivable = false
			sound.RollOffMinDistance = 9
			sound.RollOffMaxDistance = 250
			sound.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.InverseTapered
			sound.SoundGroup = SoundService:WaitForChild("Main"):WaitForChild("Character"):WaitForChild("Footsteps")
			sound.Volume = 0.65
			for propName, propValue: any in pairs(props) do
				(sound :: any)[propName] = propValue
			end
			sound.Parent = rootPart
			sounds[name] = sound
		end
	end

	local playingLoopedSounds: {[Playable]: boolean?} = {}

	local function stopPlayingLoopedSounds(except: Playable?)
		except = except or nil --default value
		for sound in pairs(shallowCopy(playingLoopedSounds)) do
			if sound ~= except then
				stopSound(sound)
				playingLoopedSounds[sound] = nil
			end
		end
	end

	-- state transition callbacks.
	local stateTransitions: {[Enum.HumanoidStateType]: () -> ()} = {
		[Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown] = function()
			stopPlayingLoopedSounds()
		end,

		[Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp] = function()
			stopPlayingLoopedSounds()
			playSound(sounds.GettingUp)
		end,

		[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping] = function()
			stopPlayingLoopedSounds()
			playSound(sounds.Jumping)
		end,

		[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming] = function()
			local verticalSpeed = math.abs(rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y)
			if verticalSpeed > 0.1 then
				(sounds.Splash :: any).Volume = math.clamp(map(verticalSpeed, 100, 350, 0.28, 1), 0, 1)
				playSound(sounds.Splash)
			end
			stopPlayingLoopedSounds(sounds.Swimming)
			playSound(sounds.Swimming, true)
			playingLoopedSounds[sounds.Swimming] = true
		end,

		[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall] = function()
			(sounds.FreeFalling :: any).Volume = 0
			stopPlayingLoopedSounds(sounds.FreeFalling)
			
			setSoundLooped(sounds.FreeFalling, true)
			if sounds.FreeFalling:IsA("Sound") then
				sounds.FreeFalling.PlaybackRegionsEnabled = true
			end
			(sounds.FreeFalling :: any).LoopRegion = NumberRange.new(2, 9)
			playSound(sounds.FreeFalling)
			
			playingLoopedSounds[sounds.FreeFalling] = true
		end,

		[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed] = function()
			stopPlayingLoopedSounds()
			local verticalSpeed = math.abs(rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y)
			if verticalSpeed > 75 then
				(sounds.Landing :: any).Volume = math.clamp(map(verticalSpeed, 50, 100, 0, 1), 0, 1)
				playSound(sounds.Landing)
			end
		end,

		[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running] = function()
			--stopPlayingLoopedSounds(sounds.Running)
			--playSound(sounds.Running, true)
			--playingLoopedSounds[sounds.Running] = true
		end,

		[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing] = function()
			--local sound = sounds.Climbing
			--local partVelocity = rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			--local velocity = if FFlagUserSoundsUseRelativeVelocity then getRelativeVelocity(cm, partVelocity) else partVelocity
			--if math.abs(velocity.Y) > 0.1 then
			--	playSound(sound, true)
			--	stopPlayingLoopedSounds(sound)
			--else
			--	stopPlayingLoopedSounds()
			--end
			--playingLoopedSounds[sound] = true
		end,

		[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated] = function()
			stopPlayingLoopedSounds()
		end,

		[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead] = function()
			stopPlayingLoopedSounds()
			playSound(sounds.Died)
		end,
	}

	-- updaters for looped sounds
	local loopedSoundUpdaters: {[Playable]: (number, Playable, Vector3) -> ()} = {
		--[sounds.Climbing] = function(dt: number, sound: Playable, vel: Vector3)
		--	local velocity = if FFlagUserSoundsUseRelativeVelocity then getRelativeVelocity(cm, vel) else vel
		--	playSoundIf(sound, velocity.Magnitude > 0.1)
		--end,

		[sounds.FreeFalling] = function(dt: number, sound: Playable, vel: Vector3): ()
			if vel.Magnitude > 75 then
				(sound :: any).Volume = math.clamp((sound :: any).Volume + 0.9*dt, 0, 1)
			else
				(sound :: any).Volume = 0
			end
		end,

		--[sounds.Running] = function(dt: number, sound: Playable, vel: Vector3)
		--	playSoundIf(sound, vel.Magnitude > 0.5 and humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.5)
		--end,
	}

	-- state substitutions to avoid duplicating entries in the state table
	local stateRemap: {[Enum.HumanoidStateType]: Enum.HumanoidStateType} = {
		[Enum.HumanoidStateType.RunningNoPhysics] = Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running,
	}

	local activeState: Enum.HumanoidStateType = stateRemap[humanoid:GetState()] or humanoid:GetState()

	local function transitionTo(state)
		local transitionFunc: () -> () = stateTransitions[state]

		if transitionFunc then
			transitionFunc()
		end

		activeState = state
	end

	transitionTo(activeState)

	local stateChangedConn = humanoid.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, state)
		state = stateRemap[state] or state

		if state ~= activeState then
			transitionTo(state)
		end
	end)

	local steppedConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function(_, worldDt: number)
		-- update looped sounds on stepped
		for sound in pairs(playingLoopedSounds) do
			local updater: (number, Playable, Vector3) -> () = loopedSoundUpdaters[sound]

			if updater then
				updater(worldDt, sound, rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity)
			end
		end
	end)

	local function terminate()
		stateChangedConn:Disconnect()
		steppedConn:Disconnect()

		-- Unparent all sounds and empty sounds table
		-- This is needed in order to support the case where initializeSoundSystem might be called more than once for the same player,
		-- which might happen in case player character is unparented and parented back on server and reset-children mechanism is active.
		for name: string, sound: Playable in pairs(sounds) do
			sound:Destroy()
		end
		table.clear(sounds)
	end

	return terminate
end

local binding = AtomicBinding.new({
	humanoid = "Humanoid",
	rootPart = "HumanoidRootPart",
}, initializeSoundSystem)

local playerConnections = {}

local function characterAdded(character)
	binding:bindRoot(character)
end

local function characterRemoving(character)
	binding:unbindRoot(character)
end

local function playerAdded(player: Player)
	local connections = playerConnections[player]
	if not connections then
		connections = {}
		playerConnections[player] = connections
	end

	if player.Character then
		characterAdded(player.Character)
	end
	table.insert(connections, player.CharacterAdded:Connect(characterAdded))
	table.insert(connections, player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(characterRemoving))
end

local function playerRemoving(player: Player)
	local connections = playerConnections[player]
	if connections then
		for _, conn in ipairs(connections) do
			conn:Disconnect()
		end
		playerConnections[player] = nil
	end

	if player.Character then
		characterRemoving(player.Character)
	end
end

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	task.spawn(playerAdded, player)
end

local ROOT_ALIAS = "root"

local function parsePath(pathStr)
	local pathArray = string.split(pathStr, "/")
	for idx = #pathArray, 1, -1 do
		if pathArray[idx] == "" then
			table.remove(pathArray, idx)
		end
	end
	return pathArray
end

local function isManifestResolved(resolvedManifest, manifestSizeTarget)
	local manifestSize = 0
	for _ in pairs(resolvedManifest) do
		manifestSize += 1
	end

	assert(manifestSize <= manifestSizeTarget, manifestSize)
	return manifestSize == manifestSizeTarget
end

local function unbindNodeDescend(node, resolvedManifest)
	if node.instance == nil then
		return -- Do not try to unbind nodes that are already unbound
	end

	node.instance = nil

	local connections = node.connections
	if connections then
		for _, conn in ipairs(connections) do
			conn:Disconnect()
		end
		table.clear(connections)
	end

	if resolvedManifest and node.alias then
		resolvedManifest[node.alias] = nil
	end

	local children = node.children
	if children then
		for _, childNode in pairs(children) do
			unbindNodeDescend(childNode, resolvedManifest)
		end
	end
end

local AtomicBinding = {}
AtomicBinding.__index = AtomicBinding

function AtomicBinding.new(manifest, boundFn)
	local dtorMap = {} -- { [root] -> dtor }
	local connections = {} -- { Connection, ... }
	local rootInstToRootNode = {} -- { [root] -> rootNode }
	local rootInstToManifest = {} -- { [root] -> { [alias] -> instance } }

	local parsedManifest = {} -- { [alias] = {Name, ...} }
	local manifestSizeTarget = 1 -- Add 1 because root isn't explicitly on the manifest	
	
	for alias, rawPath in pairs(manifest) do
		parsedManifest[alias] = parsePath(rawPath)
		manifestSizeTarget += 1
	end

	return setmetatable({
		_boundFn = boundFn,
		_parsedManifest = parsedManifest,
		_manifestSizeTarget = manifestSizeTarget,
		
		_dtorMap = dtorMap,
		_connections = connections,
		_rootInstToRootNode = rootInstToRootNode,
		_rootInstToManifest = rootInstToManifest,
	}, AtomicBinding)
end

function AtomicBinding:_startBoundFn(root, resolvedManifest)
	local boundFn = self._boundFn
	local dtorMap = self._dtorMap
	
	local oldDtor = dtorMap[root]
	if oldDtor then
		oldDtor()
		dtorMap[root] = nil
	end

	local dtor = boundFn(resolvedManifest)
	if dtor then
		dtorMap[root] = dtor
	end
end

function AtomicBinding:_stopBoundFn(root)
	local dtorMap = self._dtorMap
	
	local dtor = dtorMap[root]
	if dtor then
		dtor()
		dtorMap[root] = nil
	end
end

function AtomicBinding:bindRoot(root)
	debug.profilebegin("AtomicBinding:BindRoot")
	
	local parsedManifest = self._parsedManifest
	local rootInstToRootNode = self._rootInstToRootNode
	local rootInstToManifest = self._rootInstToManifest
	local manifestSizeTarget = self._manifestSizeTarget
	
	assert(rootInstToManifest[root] == nil)

	local resolvedManifest = {}
	rootInstToManifest[root] = resolvedManifest

	debug.profilebegin("BuildTree")

	local rootNode = {}
	rootNode.alias = ROOT_ALIAS
	rootNode.instance = root
	if next(parsedManifest) then
		-- No need to assign child data if there are no children
		rootNode.children = {}
		rootNode.connections = {}
	end

	rootInstToRootNode[root] = rootNode

	for alias, parsedPath in pairs(parsedManifest) do
		local parentNode = rootNode

		for idx, childName in ipairs(parsedPath) do
			local leaf = idx == #parsedPath
			local childNode = parentNode.children[childName] or {}

			if leaf then
				if childNode.alias ~= nil then
					error("Multiple aliases assigned to one instance")
				end

				childNode.alias = alias

			else
				childNode.children = childNode.children or {}
				childNode.connections = childNode.connections or {}
			end

			parentNode.children[childName] = childNode
			parentNode = childNode
		end
	end

	debug.profileend() -- BuildTree

	-- Recursively descend into the tree, resolving each node.
	-- Nodes start out as empty and instance-less; the resolving process discovers instances to map to nodes.
	local function processNode(node)
		local instance = assert(node.instance)

		local children = node.children
		local alias = node.alias
		local isLeaf = not children

		if alias then
			resolvedManifest[alias] = instance
		end

		if not isLeaf then
			local function processAddChild(childInstance)
				local childName = childInstance.Name
				local childNode = children[childName]
				if not childNode or childNode.instance ~= nil then
					return
				end

				childNode.instance = childInstance
				processNode(childNode)
			end

			local function processDeleteChild(childInstance)
				-- Instance deletion - Parent A detects that child B is being removed
				--    1. A removes B from `children`
				--    2. A traverses down from B,
				--       i.  Disconnecting inputs
				--       ii. Removing nodes from the resolved manifest
				--    3. stopBoundFn is called because we know the tree is no longer complete, or at least has to be refreshed
				-- 	  4. We search A for a replacement for B, and attempt to re-resolve using that replacement if it exists.
				-- To support the above sanely, processAddChild needs to avoid resolving nodes that are already resolved.

				local childName = childInstance.Name
				local childNode = children[childName]

				if not childNode then
					return -- There's no child node corresponding to the deleted instance, ignore
				end

				if childNode.instance ~= childInstance then
					return -- A child was removed with the same name as a node instance, ignore
				end

				self:_stopBoundFn(root) -- Happens before the tree is unbound so the manifest is still valid in the destructor.
				unbindNodeDescend(childNode, resolvedManifest) -- Unbind the tree

				assert(childNode.instance == nil) -- If this triggers, unbindNodeDescend failed

				-- Search for a replacement
				local replacementChild = instance:FindFirstChild(childName)
				if replacementChild then
					processAddChild(replacementChild)
				end
			end

			for _, child in ipairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
				processAddChild(child)
			end

			table.insert(node.connections, instance.ChildAdded:Connect(processAddChild))
			table.insert(node.connections, instance.ChildRemoved:Connect(processDeleteChild))
		end

		if isLeaf and isManifestResolved(resolvedManifest, manifestSizeTarget) then
			self:_startBoundFn(root, resolvedManifest)
		end
	end

	debug.profilebegin("ResolveTree")
	processNode(rootNode)
	debug.profileend() -- ResolveTree
	
	debug.profileend() -- AtomicBinding:BindRoot
end

function AtomicBinding:unbindRoot(root)
	local rootInstToRootNode = self._rootInstToRootNode
	local rootInstToManifest = self._rootInstToManifest
	
	self:_stopBoundFn(root)

	local rootNode = rootInstToRootNode[root]
	if rootNode then
		local resolvedManifest = assert(rootInstToManifest[root])
		unbindNodeDescend(rootNode, resolvedManifest)
		rootInstToRootNode[root] = nil
	end

	rootInstToManifest[root] = nil
end

function AtomicBinding:destroy()
	debug.profilebegin("AtomicBinding:destroy")

	for _, dtor in pairs(self._dtorMap) do
		dtor:destroy()
	end
	table.clear(self._dtorMap)

	for _, conn in ipairs(self._connections) do
		conn:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(self._connections)

	local rootInstToManifest = self._rootInstToManifest
	for rootInst, rootNode in pairs(self._rootInstToRootNode) do
		local resolvedManifest = assert(rootInstToManifest[rootInst])
		unbindNodeDescend(rootNode, resolvedManifest)
	end
	table.clear(self._rootInstToManifest)
	table.clear(self._rootInstToRootNode)

	debug.profileend()
end

return AtomicBinding

local DIVE_LATE_DRAG = 2.7

local HANDOFF_RESPONSE = 8.5

local SIDE_MULTIPLIER = 0.98

local BACKWARD_MULTIPLIER = 0.91

-- HussShiftLockV7: inspect the actual facing constraint, not a delayed flag.
-- HussPerfectMovementV11
local function boostedSpeed(base)
 local bonus=0
 if player:GetAttribute('InRound')==true and character then
  local untilTime=character:GetAttribute('HussPerfectBoostUntil')
  if type(untilTime)=='number' and workspace:GetServerTimeNow()<untilTime then bonus=6 end
  if base==SPRINT_SPEED and character:GetAttribute('HussBombCarrier')==true then
   local extra=character:GetAttribute('HABCarrierSprintBonus')
   if type(extra)=='number' and extra==extra then bonus=bonus+math.clamp(extra,0,5) end
  end
 end
 if player:GetAttribute('InRound')==true and character then
  local untilAt=character:GetAttribute('HABSpeedUntil')
  local boost=character:GetAttribute('HABSpeedBonus')
  if type(untilAt)=='number' and untilAt==untilAt and workspace:GetServerTimeNow()<untilAt
   and type(boost)=='number' and boost==boost then bonus=bonus+math.clamp(boost,0,6) end
 end
 return base+math.min(bonus,15)
end
local function cameraOwnsFacing()
 local lock=root and root:FindFirstChild('ForcedShiftLockOrientation')
 return lock~=nil and lock:IsA('AlignOrientation') and lock.Enabled
end

local function horizontal(
	vector
)

	return Vector3.new(
		vector.X,
		0,
		vector.Z
	)
end

------------------------------------------------------------

local function smoothStep(
	value
)

	value =
		math.clamp(
			value,
			0,
			1
		)

	return value
		* value
		* (
			3
			- 2
			* value
		)
end

------------------------------------------------------------

local function getHorizontalSpeed()

	if not root then
		return 0
	end

	return horizontal(
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	).Magnitude
end

------------------------------------------------------------

local function isGrounded()

	if not humanoid then
		return false
	end

	return humanoid.FloorMaterial
		~= Enum.Material.Air
end

------------------------------------------------------------

local function movementLocked()

	if not character
		or not humanoid
		or not root then

		return true
	end

	if humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.PlatformStand or humanoid.Sit
  or character:GetAttribute('Ragdolled')==true or character:GetAttribute('IsRagdoll')==true
  or player:GetAttribute('HussGamePaused')==true or workspace:GetAttribute('HussGamePaused')==true
  or humanoid:GetState()==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
  or humanoid:GetState()==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
  or humanoid:GetState()==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated then
		return true
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- RoundService anchors the root during 3 / 2 / 1.
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if root.Anchored then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

	state

	if not character then
		return

	character:SetAttribute(

	)
end

	action

	if not character then

	character:SetAttribute(

	local actionId =
		character:GetAttribute(
			"MovementActionId"

	character:SetAttribute(

		actionId + 1
	)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- CAMERA RELATIVE DIRECTIONS
------------------------------------------------------------

local function getCameraDirections()

	local camera =
		workspace.CurrentCamera

	if not camera then

		return
			Vector3.new(
				0,
				0,
				-1
			),

			Vector3.new(
				1,
				0,
				0
			)
	end

	local forward =
		horizontal(
			camera.CFrame.LookVector
		)

	local right =
		horizontal(
			camera.CFrame.RightVector
		)

	if forward.Magnitude <= 0.01 then

		forward =
			Vector3.new(
				0,
				0,
				-1
			)

	else

		forward =
			forward.Unit
	end

	if right.Magnitude <= 0.01 then

		right =
			Vector3.new(
				1,
				0,
				0
			)

	else

		right =
			right.Unit
	end

	return forward,
		right
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- HELD WASD DIRECTION
------------------------------------------------------------

local function getInputDirection()

	local forward,
		right =
		getCameraDirections()

	local direction =
		Vector3.zero

	if held.W then

		direction +=
			forward
	end

	if held.S then

		direction -=
			forward
	end

	if held.D then

		direction +=
			right
	end

	if held.A then

		direction -=
			right
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- SPACE ALONE DOES NOTHING
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if direction.Magnitude <= 0.01 then

		return nil
	end

	return direction.Unit
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- DETERMINE DIVE TYPE
------------------------------------------------------------

local function getDiveType(
	direction
)

	local forward,
		right =
		getCameraDirections()

	local forwardDot =
		direction:Dot(
			forward
		)

	local rightDot =
		direction:Dot(
			right
		)

	local absForward =
		math.abs(
			forwardDot
		)

	local absRight =
		math.abs(
			rightDot
		)

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- DIAGONALS
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if absForward > 0.35
		and absRight > 0.35 then

		if forwardDot > 0
			and rightDot > 0 then

			return
				DIAGONAL_MULTIPLIER,
				"DiveForwardRight"

		elseif forwardDot > 0
			and rightDot < 0 then

			return
				DIAGONAL_MULTIPLIER,
				"DiveForwardLeft"

		elseif forwardDot < 0
			and rightDot > 0 then

			return
				DIAGONAL_MULTIPLIER,
				"DiveBackRight"

		else

			return
				DIAGONAL_MULTIPLIER,
				"DiveBackLeft"
		end
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- FORWARD
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if forwardDot > 0.5 then

		return
			FORWARD_MULTIPLIER,
			"DiveForward"
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- BACKWARD
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if forwardDot < -0.5 then

		return
			BACKWARD_MULTIPLIER,
			"DiveBack"
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- LEFT
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if rightDot < 0 then

		return
			SIDE_MULTIPLIER,
			"DiveLeft"
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- RIGHT
	--------------------------------------------------------

	return
		SIDE_MULTIPLIER,
		"DiveRight"
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- FACE MOVEMENT DIRECTION
------------------------------------------------------------

local function faceDirection(
	direction,
	dt
)
 if cameraOwnsFacing() then return end

	if not root then
		return
	end

	direction =
		horizontal(
			direction
		)

	if direction.Magnitude <= 0.01 then
		return
	end

	direction =
		direction.Unit

	local position =
		root.Position

	local target =
		CFrame.lookAt(
			position,
			position + direction,
			Vector3.yAxis
		)

	local alpha =
		1
	- math.exp(
		-DIVE_TURN_RESPONSE
			* dt
	)

	root.CFrame =
		root.CFrame:Lerp(
			target,
			alpha
		)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- END DIVE
------------------------------------------------------------

local function finishDive()

	if not diving then
		return
	end

	diving =
		false

	humanoid.AutoRotate = not cameraOwnsFacing()

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- DO NOT ZERO VELOCITY.
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if sprintHeld
		and humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude
		> 0.05 then

		humanoid.WalkSpeed =
			boostedSpeed(SPRINT_SPEED)

	else

		humanoid.WalkSpeed =
			boostedSpeed(WALK_SPEED)
	end

	fireMovementAction(
		"DiveEnd"
	)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- START DIVE
------------------------------------------------------------

local function attemptDive()

	if movementLocked() then
		return
	end

	if diving then
		return
	end

	if not isGrounded() then
		return
	end

	local now =
		time()

	if now - lastDiveAt
		< DIVE_COOLDOWN then

		return
	end

	local direction =
		getInputDirection()

	if not direction then
		return
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- CURRENT MOMENTUM
	--------------------------------------------------------

	local currentSpeed =
		getHorizontalSpeed()

	local startingSpeed =
		math.clamp(
			currentSpeed
			+ DIVE_MOMENTUM_BONUS,

			DIVE_MIN_START_SPEED,

			DIVE_MAX_START_SPEED
		)

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- DIRECTION TYPE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	local multiplier,
		action =
		getDiveType(
			direction
		)

	startingSpeed =
		startingSpeed
		* multiplier

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- START DIVE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	lastDiveAt =
		now

	diveStartedAt =
		now

	diveDirection =
		direction

	diveVelocity =
		direction
		* startingSpeed

	diving =
		true

	humanoid.AutoRotate =
		false

	humanoid.WalkSpeed =
		0

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- ASK SERVER FOR DODGE I-FRAMES
	--------------------------------------------------------

	DodgeIFrameRequest:FireServer(direction, action) -- HussDodgeV5

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- APPLY INITIAL DIVE VELOCITY
	--------------------------------------------------------

	local oldVelocity =
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity

	root.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
		Vector3.new(
			diveVelocity.X,
			oldVelocity.Y,
			diveVelocity.Z
		)

	setMovementState(
		"Dive"
	)

	fireMovementAction(
		action
	)
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(
	function(
		input,
		gameProcessed
	)

		if gameProcessed then
			return
		end

		local key =
			input.KeyCode

		if key == Enum.KeyCode.W then

			held.W =
				true

		elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.A then

			held.A =
				true

		elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.S then

			held.S =
				true

		elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.D then

			held.D =
				true

		elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then

			sprintHeld =
				true
		end
	end
)

------------------------------------------------------------

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(
	function(input)

		local key =
			input.KeyCode

		if key == Enum.KeyCode.W then

			held.W =
				false

		elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.A then

			held.A =
				false

		elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.S then

			held.S =
				false

		elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.D then

			held.D =
				false

		elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then

			sprintHeld =
				false
		end
	end
)

	actionName,
	inputState,
	inputObject
)

	if inputState
		== Enum.UserInputState.Begin then

		attemptDive()
	end

	return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PHYSICS
------------------------------------------------------------

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(
	function(dt)

		if not character
			or not humanoid
			or not root then

			return
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- NEVER ALLOW NORMAL JUMP
		----------------------------------------------------

		humanoid.Jump =
			false

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- ROUND COUNTDOWN LOCK
		----------------------------------------------------

		if movementLocked() then

			diving =
				false

			humanoid.WalkSpeed =
				0

			setMovementState(
				"Locked"
			)

			return
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- ACTIVE DIVE
		----------------------------------------------------

		if diving then

			local elapsed =
				time()
			- diveStartedAt

			local progress =
				math.clamp(
					elapsed
					/ DIVE_DURATION,

					0,
					1
				)

			local speed =
				diveVelocity.Magnitude

			if elapsed >= DIVE_DURATION
				or speed <= DIVE_STOP_SPEED then

				finishDive()

				return
			end

			------------------------------------------------
			-- CURRENT INPUT
			------------------------------------------------

			local inputDirection =
				getInputDirection()

			------------------------------------------------
			-- STEERING CONTROL CURVE
			------------------------------------------------

			local controlAmount =
				0

			if progress
				> CONTROL_RETURN_START then

				controlAmount =
					(
						progress
						- CONTROL_RETURN_START
					)
					/
					(
						FULL_CONTROL_POINT
						- CONTROL_RETURN_START
					)

				controlAmount =
					smoothStep(
						controlAmount
					)
			end

			------------------------------------------------
			-- CURVE DIVE
			------------------------------------------------

			if inputDirection
				and controlAmount > 0 then

				local desiredVelocity =
					inputDirection
					* speed

				local steerAlpha =
					1
				- math.exp(
					-DIVE_STEER_RESPONSE
						* controlAmount
						* dt
				)

				diveVelocity =
					diveVelocity:Lerp(
						desiredVelocity,
						steerAlpha
					)

				if diveVelocity.Magnitude
					> 0.01 then

					diveDirection =
						diveVelocity.Unit
				end
			end

			------------------------------------------------
			-- VARIABLE DRAG
			------------------------------------------------

			local dragProgress =
				smoothStep(
					progress
				)

			local currentDrag =
				DIVE_EARLY_DRAG
				+ (
					DIVE_LATE_DRAG
					- DIVE_EARLY_DRAG
				)
				* dragProgress

			local dragMultiplier =
				math.exp(
					-currentDrag
					* dt
				)

			diveVelocity *=
				dragMultiplier

			------------------------------------------------
			-- RUNNING HANDOFF
			------------------------------------------------

			local handoffAmount =
				0

			if progress
				> HANDOFF_START then

				handoffAmount =
					(
						progress
						- HANDOFF_START
					)
					/
					(
						1
						- HANDOFF_START
					)

				handoffAmount =
					smoothStep(
						handoffAmount
					)
			end

			local desiredSpeed =
				boostedSpeed(WALK_SPEED)

			if sprintHeld then

				desiredSpeed =
					boostedSpeed(SPRINT_SPEED)
			end

			------------------------------------------------
			-- BLEND INTO NORMAL RUNNING
			------------------------------------------------

			if inputDirection
				and handoffAmount > 0 then

				local targetRunVelocity =
					inputDirection
					* desiredSpeed

				local handoffAlpha =
					1
				- math.exp(
					-HANDOFF_RESPONSE
						* handoffAmount
						* dt
				)

				diveVelocity =
					diveVelocity:Lerp(
						targetRunVelocity,
						handoffAlpha
					)
			end

			------------------------------------------------
			-- HUMANOID CONTROL GRADUALLY RETURNS
			------------------------------------------------

			humanoid.WalkSpeed =
				desiredSpeed
				* handoffAmount

			------------------------------------------------
			-- APPLY VELOCITY
			------------------------------------------------

			local currentVelocity =
				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity

			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
				Vector3.new(
					diveVelocity.X,
					currentVelocity.Y,
					diveVelocity.Z
				)

			------------------------------------------------
			-- SMOOTH FACING
			------------------------------------------------

			if diveVelocity.Magnitude
				> 0.01 then

				faceDirection(
					diveVelocity.Unit,
					dt
				)
			end

			setMovementState(
				"Dive"
			)

			return
		end

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- NORMAL MOVEMENT
		----------------------------------------------------

		local moving =
			humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude
			> 0.05

		if sprintHeld
			and moving then

			humanoid.WalkSpeed =
				boostedSpeed(SPRINT_SPEED)

			setMovementState(
				"Sprint"
			)

		else

			humanoid.WalkSpeed =
				boostedSpeed(WALK_SPEED)

			if moving then

				setMovementState(
					"Run"
				)

			else

				setMovementState(
					"Idle"
				)
			end
		end
	end
)

------------------------------------------------------------
-- CAMERA
------------------------------------------------------------

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(
	function(dt)

		local camera =
			workspace.CurrentCamera

		if not camera
			or not humanoid then

			return
		end

		local targetFOV =
			NORMAL_FOV

		if diving then

			local progress =
				math.clamp(
					(
						time()
						- diveStartedAt
					)
					/ DIVE_DURATION,

					0,
					1
				)

			local normalTarget =
				NORMAL_FOV

			if sprintHeld then

				normalTarget =
					SPRINT_FOV
			end

			local handoff =
				smoothStep(
					math.clamp(
						(
							progress
							- HANDOFF_START
						)
						/
						(
							1
							- HANDOFF_START
						),

						0,
						1
					)
				)

			targetFOV =
				DIVE_FOV
				+ (
					normalTarget
					- DIVE_FOV
				)
				* handoff

		elseif sprintHeld
			and humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude
			> 0.05 then

			targetFOV =
				SPRINT_FOV
		end

		local alpha =
			1
		- math.exp(
			-FOV_RESPONSE
				* dt
		)

		camera.FieldOfView =
			camera.FieldOfView
			+ (
				targetFOV
				- camera.FieldOfView
			)
			* alpha
	end
)

	end
end

local function updateCameraOffset(
	dt
)

	if not humanoid then
		return
	end

	local targetOffset =
		Vector3.zero

	if isInRound() then

		targetOffset =
			CAMERA_OFFSET
	end

	local alpha =
		1
	- math.exp(
		-CAMERA_RESPONSE
			* dt
	)

	currentCameraOffset =
		currentCameraOffset:Lerp(
			targetOffset,
			alpha
		)

	humanoid.CameraOffset =
		currentCameraOffset
end

updateCharacterRotation=function()
 -- HussShiftLockV7: stay camera-facing during every directional dodge.
 if not humanoid or not root or not alignOrientation then return end
 local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
 local mode=humanoid:GetState()
 local blocked=humanoid.Health<=0 or root.Anchored or humanoid.PlatformStand or humanoid.Sit
  or character:GetAttribute('Ragdolled')==true or character:GetAttribute('IsRagdoll')==true
  or player:GetAttribute('HussGamePaused')==true or workspace:GetAttribute('HussGamePaused')==true
  or mode==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead or mode==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
  or mode==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or mode==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated
 local owns=shouldUseShiftLock() and not blocked and camera~=nil
 if owns then
  local look=camera.CFrame.LookVector
  local flat=Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
  if flat.Magnitude>.001 then
   alignOrientation.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero,flat.Unit,Vector3.yAxis)
  elseif not alignOrientation.Enabled then
   local facing=root.CFrame.LookVector
   flat=Vector3.new(facing.X,0,facing.Z)
   if flat.Magnitude>.001 then alignOrientation.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero,flat.Unit,Vector3.yAxis)
   else owns=false end
  end
 end
 alignOrientation.Enabled=owns
 humanoid.AutoRotate=not owns and not blocked and character:GetAttribute('MovementState')~='Dive'
end
updateCharacterRotation()

------------------------------------------------------------
-- ROUND TRANSITION
------------------------------------------------------------

local function updateRoundTransition()

	local currentlyInRound =
		isInRound()

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- JUST ENTERED ROUND
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if currentlyInRound
		and not wasInRound then

		if humanoid then

			humanoid.AutoRotate =
				false
		end
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- JUST LEFT ROUND
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if not currentlyInRound
		and wasInRound then

		if alignOrientation then

			alignOrientation.Enabled =
				false
		end

		if humanoid then

			humanoid.AutoRotate =
				true

			humanoid.CameraOffset =
				Vector3.zero
		end

		currentCameraOffset =
			Vector3.zero

		----------------------------------------------------
		-- RELEASE IT ONCE.
		--
		-- After this, Roblox owns the lobby mouse again.
		----------------------------------------------------

		UserInputService.MouseBehavior =
			Enum.MouseBehavior.Default

		UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled =
			true

		reticle.Visible =
			false
	end

	wasInRound =
		currentlyInRound
end

			return
		end

		updateCameraOffset(
			dt
		)

		updateCharacterRotation()
	end

)]==],[ [==[disabled]==] ]=false},{[ [==[path]==] ]=[==[StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/DodgeWeaveV5]==],[ [==[class]==] ]=[==[LocalScript]==],[ [==[old]==] ]=[==[--!nonstrict
-- V6 ACTION DODGE: shoulder drive, lateral power-step, braced backstep.
-- Cosmetic R6/R15 joints only. SnappyMovement owns speed, collisions and cooldown.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local me = Players.LocalPlayer
local remote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Net"):WaitForChild("DodgeIFrameRequest")
local DURATION = .72
local CF, V = CFrame.new, Vector3.new
local active, players, connections = {}, {}, {}
local stopped = false

local directions = {
	DiveForward={0,1}, DiveBack={0,-1}, DiveLeft={-1,0}, DiveRight={1,0},
	DiveForwardLeft={-.7071,.7071}, DiveForwardRight={.7071,.7071},
	DiveBackLeft={-.7071,-.7071}, DiveBackRight={.7071,-.7071},
}
-- time, blend, compression, lean, guard, stride: snap-load, burst, reach, plant, recover.
local keys = {
	{0,0,0,0,0,0}, {.045,.88,.58,-.18,.85,-.5},
	{.135,1,1,1,1,1}, {.28,1,.84,.92,.94,.68},
	{.46,.84,.48,.48,.58,-.32}, {.60,.30,.1,.09,.15,.12},
	{DURATION,0,0,0,0,0},
}
local roles = {
	Torso="root", LowerTorso="root", UpperTorso="waist", Head="neck",
	["Left Arm"]="leftArm", ["Right Arm"]="rightArm",
	["Left Leg"]="leftHip", ["Right Leg"]="rightHip",
	LeftUpperArm="leftArm", RightUpperArm="rightArm",
	LeftLowerArm="leftElbow", RightLowerArm="rightElbow",
	LeftUpperLeg="leftHip", RightUpperLeg="rightHip",
	LeftLowerLeg="leftKnee", RightLowerLeg="rightKnee",
	LeftFoot="leftAnkle", RightFoot="rightAnkle",
}
local function sample(t)
	for i=2,#keys do
		local b,a = keys[i],keys[i-1]
		if t<=b[1] then
			local u=math.clamp((t-a[1])/(b[1]-a[1]),0,1)
			u=u*u*(3-2*u)
			local result={}
			for j=2,6 do result[j-1]=a[j]+(b[j]-a[j])*u end
			return result
		end
	end
	return {0,0,0,0,0}
end
local function pose(role,r15,d,s)
	local _,dip,lean,guard,stride=table.unpack(s)
	local side,front=d[1],d[2]
	local forward,back=math.max(front,0),math.max(-front,0)
	local bank=side~=0 and side or (front>0 and -.26 or .18)
	local pitch=(-34*forward+19*back-12*math.abs(side))*lean
	local roll=-bank*27*lean
	local yaw=(side*16+(side==0 and front*12 or 0))*lean
	local hip=(r15 and 32*dip or 0)-(r15 and pitch*.34 or pitch*.92)
	local lead=(side<0 and -1 or 1)*(25*stride+12*back*lean)
	local armDrive=(front*42+side*32)*lean
	local x,y,z,rx,ry,rz=0,0,0,0,0,0
	if role=="root" then
		x,y,z=side*.32*lean,(r15 and -.18 or .12+.26*math.abs(side))*dip,-forward*.22*lean
		rx,ry,rz=pitch*(r15 and .34 or 1),yaw,roll*(r15 and .52 or 1)
	elseif role=="waist" then rx,ry,rz=pitch*.66,side*14*lean,roll*.48
	elseif role=="neck" then rx,ry,rz=-pitch*.70,-yaw*.65,-roll*.5
	elseif role=="leftArm" then
		rx,ry,rz=16+47*guard+armDrive,-18*guard,-14-16*guard+side*9*lean
	elseif role=="rightArm" then
		rx,ry,rz=16+47*guard-armDrive,18*guard,14+16*guard+side*9*lean
	elseif role=="leftElbow" then rx=30+45*guard+math.max(armDrive,0)*.3
	elseif role=="rightElbow" then rx=30+45*guard+math.max(-armDrive,0)*.3
	elseif role=="leftHip" then rx,ry,rz=hip+lead,-side*8*lean,-9*dip-roll*.42
	elseif role=="rightHip" then rx,ry,rz=hip-lead,-side*8*lean,9*dip-roll*.42
	elseif role=="leftKnee" then rx=-56*dip-math.max(lead,0)*.45
	elseif role=="rightKnee" then rx=-56*dip-math.max(-lead,0)*.45
	elseif role=="leftAnkle" or role=="rightAnkle" then rx=26*dip
	end
	return CF(x,y,z)*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(rx),math.rad(ry),math.rad(rz))
end
local function restore(state)
	for _,j in ipairs(state.joints) do
		if j.base then
			if j.motor.Parent and j.motor.Transform==j.applied then
				j.motor.Transform=j.base
			end
			j.base,j.applied=nil,nil
		end
	end
end
local function cancel(state)
	restore(state)
	state.started=nil
	for _,trail in ipairs(state.trails) do trail.Enabled=false end
end
local function blocked(state)
	local h,c,r=state.humanoid,state.character,state.root
	if not c.Parent or not h.Parent or h.Health<=0 or not r.Parent or r.Anchored then return true end
	if state.player:GetAttribute("HussGamePaused")==true or workspace:GetAttribute("HussGamePaused")==true then return true end
	if c:GetAttribute("Ragdolled")==true or c:GetAttribute("IsRagdoll")==true or h.PlatformStand or h.Sit then return true end
	local mode=h:GetState()
	return mode==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead or mode==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
		or mode==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or mode==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated
end
local function trailFor(state,part)
	if not part then return end
	local a,b=Instance.new("Attachment"),Instance.new("Attachment")
	a.Name,b.Name="HussDodgeTrailTop","HussDodgeTrailBottom"
	a.Position,b.Position=V(0,-part.Size.Y*.2,0),V(0,-part.Size.Y*.45,0)
	a.Parent,b.Parent=part,part
	local t=Instance.new("Trail")
	t.Name="HussActionBurst"
	t.Attachment0,t.Attachment1=a,b
	t.Lifetime=.115
	t.MinLength=.12
	t.LightEmission=.7
	t.Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(225,255,238),Color3.fromRGB(137,244,177))
	t.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,.52),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)})
	t.WidthScale=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,1),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0)})
	t.FaceCamera=true
	t.Enabled=false
	t.Parent=part
	table.insert(state.trails,t)
	for _,object in ipairs({a,b,t}) do table.insert(state.effects,object) end
end
local function start(state,action,age)

local soft={Grass=true,Ground=true,Sand=true,Snow=true,Fabric=true,LeafyGrass=true,Mud=true}
local metal={Metal=true,DiamondPlate=true,CorrodedMetal=true}
local function feet()
 local now=os.clock();local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera;local candidates={}
 for _,record in pairs(people) do
  local c,h,r=record.character,record.humanoid,record.root
  local distance=camera and r and (camera.CFrame.Position-r.Position).Magnitude or math.huge
  local mode=h and h:GetState()
  local velocity=r and r.AssemblyLinearVelocity
  local valid=c and c.Parent and h and h.Parent==c and r and r.Parent and h.Health>0 and not r.Anchored
   and Vector3.new(velocity.X,0,velocity.Z).Magnitude>5
   and not h.Sit and not h.PlatformStand and distance<48 and sfx.Volume>0
   and (mode==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running or mode==Enum.HumanoidStateType.RunningNoPhysics or mode==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed)
   and c:GetAttribute('MovementState')~='Dive' and c:GetAttribute('MovementState')~='Locked'
   and c:GetAttribute('Ragdolled')~=true and c:GetAttribute('IsRagdoll')~=true
   and record.player:GetAttribute('HussGamePaused')~=true and workspace:GetAttribute('HussGamePaused')~=true
   and now>=(record.dodgeUntil or 0) and (record.player~=P or h.MoveDirection.Magnitude>.05)
  if valid then table.insert(candidates,{record=record,distance=record.player==P and -1 or distance})
  else record.nextStep=nil end
 end
 table.sort(candidates,function(x,y) return x.distance<y.distance end)
 for i,entry in ipairs(candidates) do
  local record=entry.record;local r,h,c=record.root,record.humanoid,record.character
  if i>4 then record.nextStep=nil;continue end
  if not record.ray then
   record.ray=RaycastParams.new();record.ray.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;record.ray.RespectCanCollide=true;record.ray.IgnoreWater=true
  end
  record.ray.FilterDescendantsInstances={c}
  local hit=workspace:Raycast(r.Position,Vector3.new(0,-math.max(3.4,h.HipHeight+r.Size.Y/2+.8),0),record.ray)
  local velocity=r.AssemblyLinearVelocity
  if hit and hit.Instance:IsA('BasePart') then velocity-=hit.Instance:GetVelocityAtPosition(hit.Position) end
  local speed=Vector3.new(velocity.X,0,velocity.Z).Magnitude
  if not hit or speed<5 or math.abs(velocity.Y)>12 or (record.player==P and h.FloorMaterial==Enum.Material.Air) then record.nextStep=nil;continue end
  if now<(record.nextStep or 0) then continue end
  record.nextStep=now+math.clamp(7.8/speed,.2,.48)
  record.stride=(record.stride or 0)+1
  local variation=1+((record.stride*7%11)-5)*.009
  local name=hit.Material.Name;local gentle=soft[name];local hard=metal[name]
  local level=(record.player==P and 1 or .7)*math.clamp(speed/28,.7,1.2)
  play(stepVoices,'hit',level*(gentle and .032 or .045),variation*(hard and 1.3 or gentle and .98 or 1.1),.19,r,.033)
  play(stepVoices,'swish',level*(gentle and .01 or hard and .006 or .007),variation*1.1,.14,r,.12)
 end
end

local function blocked(s)
 local id=s.p:GetAttribute('HABPackTrail')
 if type(id)=='string' and id~='' then return true end
    local c,h,r=s.c,s.h,s.r

    if not c or not c.Parent
        or not h or not h.Parent
        or not r or not r.Parent then
        return true
    end

    local state=h:GetState()

    return h.Health<=0
        or r.Anchored
        or h.Sit
        or h.PlatformStand
        or c:GetAttribute('Ragdolled')==true
        or c:GetAttribute('IsRagdoll')==true
        or s.p:GetAttribute('HussGamePaused')==true
        or workspace:GetAttribute('HussGamePaused')==true
        or state==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
        or state==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
        or state==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated
        or state==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming
end

local function beginDodge(s,age)
    if age<-.15 or age>=.72 or blocked(s) then
        return
    end

    local now=os.clock()

    if s.lastWeave and now-s.lastWeave<.1 then
        return
    end

    s.lastWeave=now
    s.dodgeUntil=now+.72-math.max(0,age)
    s.pending=age<.3
    s.weaveSerial=(s.weaveSerial or 0)+1

    budgetClock=0
end

  s.c,s.h,s.r=c,h,r
  s.ray=RaycastParams.new();s.ray.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
  s.ray.FilterDescendantsInstances={c,world};s.ray.IgnoreWater=true;s.ray.RespectCanCollide=true;s.ray.CollisionGroup=r.CollisionGroup
  s.groundAt=0;s.usedAt=0;s.dodgeUntil=0
  link(h.Died,function() destroyFx(s) end,s.charLinks)
  if s.p==me then link(c:GetAttributeChangedSignal('MovementActionId'),function()
   local action=c:GetAttribute('MovementAction')
   if actions[action] then beginDodge(s,0) elseif action=='DiveEnd' then s.dodgeUntil=0 end
  end,s.charLinks) end
 end)
end

local function grounded(s,now)
    if now<(s.groundAt or 0) then
        return s.ground
    end

    s.groundAt=now+.08

    local r,h,c=s.r,s.h,s.c
    local leg=c:FindFirstChild('Left Leg')

    local height=math.clamp(
        h.HipHeight+r.Size.Y*.5+(leg and leg.Size.Y or 0),
        1.6,
        12
    )

    local foot=c:FindFirstChild('LeftFoot') or leg or r
    s.ray.CollisionGroup=foot.CollisionGroup

    local hit

    for _,offset in ipairs({
        V(0,0,0),
        V(.7,0,0),
        V(-.7,0,0)
    }) do
        local result=workspace:Raycast(
            r.Position+V(0,.5,0)+offset,
            V(0,-height-2,0),
            s.ray
        )

        if result and result.Normal.Y>.35 then
            hit=result
            break
        end
    end

    if not hit and h.FloorMaterial~=Enum.Material.Air then
        hit={
            Position=r.Position-V(0,height,0),
            Normal=V(0,1,0)
        }
    end

    s.ground=hit
    return hit
end

local Recipes={}
local function nozzle(f,name,texture,rate,size,life,speed,color,offset,spread,alpha,accel)
 local a=make('Attachment',f.root,{Name='HABUnique_'..name})
 local e=make('ParticleEmitter',a,{
  Name=name,Texture=TEXTURES[texture],Enabled=false,Rate=0,EmissionDirection=Enum.NormalId.Front,
  Lifetime=NumberRange.new(life*.7,life),Speed=NumberRange.new(speed*.7,speed),SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(spread,spread),
  Color=ColorSequence.new(color,color:Lerp(WHITE,.12)),LightEmission=texture=='smoke' and .15 or .8,
  LightInfluence=texture=='smoke' and .4 or 0,Drag=1.4,Acceleration=accel or V(0,0,0),
  LockedToPart=false,VelocityInheritance=0,Rotation=NumberRange.new(0,360),RotSpeed=NumberRange.new(-35,35),
  Size=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,size*.25),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.4,size),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,size*.4)}),
  Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,alpha),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.4,alpha+.08),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)}),
 })
 f.attachments[#f.attachments+1]=a;f.emitters[#f.emitters+1]=e
 local n={a=a,e=e,rate=rate,offset=offset or V(0,0,0)};f.nozzles[#f.nozzles+1]=n
 return n
end
local function group(f,frame,life,velocity,gravity,spin,scale,flicker)
    local follow=f.followPart

    local g={
        f=f,
        frame=frame,
        life=life,
        age=0,
        velocity=velocity or V(0,0,0),
        gravity=gravity or V(0,0,0),
        spin=spin or V(0,0,0),
        scale=scale,
        atoms={},
        flicker=flicker,
        effectSize=f.spawnSize or 1,
        follow=follow,
        localFrame=follow and follow.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(frame)
    }

    if follow then
        g.velocity=g.velocity*.12
        g.gravity=g.gravity*.12
    end

    f.groups[#f.groups+1]=g
    return g
end

local function atom(g,shape,cf,size,color,alpha,mat,endColor)
    local p=takePart(g.f)
    if not p then return end

    local s=g.effectSize

    p.Shape=shape or Enum.PartType.Block
    p.Material=mat or Enum.Material.Neon
    p.Color=color

    p.Size=V(
        math.max(.01,size.X*s),
        math.max(.01,size.Y*s),
        math.max(.01,size.Z*s)
    )

    p.CFrame=g.frame*CF.new(cf.Position*s)*cf.Rotation
    p.Transparency=alpha or 0

    g.atoms[#g.atoms+1]={
        p=p,
        cf=cf,
        size=size,
        color=color,
        alpha=alpha or 0,
        endColor=endColor
    }
end

local function block(g,cf,size,c,a,mat,endColor) atom(g,Enum.PartType.Block,cf,size,c,a,mat,endColor) end
local function orb(g,cf,size,c,a,mat,endColor) atom(g,Enum.PartType.Ball,cf,size,c,a,mat,endColor) end
local function rod(g,a,b,width,c,alpha,mat)
 if (b-a).Magnitude<.01 then return end
 local up=math.abs((b-a).Unit.Y)>.98 and V(1,0,0) or V(0,1,0)
 block(g,CF.lookAt((a+b)/2,b,up),V(width,width,(b-a).Magnitude),c,alpha,mat)
end
local function ring(g,center,radius,width,c,n,tilt,alpha)
 n=n or 10;tilt=tilt or CF.identity
 for i=0,n-1 do
  local a,b=i*2*math.pi/n,(i+1)*2*math.pi/n
  local pa=(center*tilt):PointToWorldSpace(V(math.cos(a)*radius,math.sin(a)*radius,0))
  local pb=(center*tilt):PointToWorldSpace(V(math.cos(b)*radius,math.sin(b)*radius,0))
  rod(g,pa,pb,width,c,alpha or .12)
 end
end
local function shard(g,cf,length,width,c,alpha)
 -- Tapered crystal made from three decreasing prisms, not a plain cube.
 for j=0,2 do
  block(g,cf*CF.new(0,0,-j*length*.25),V(width*(1-j*.3),width*(1-j*.3),length*.45),c,alpha or .1)
 end
end
local function crown(g,c)
 ring(g,CF.new(),.42,.1,GOLD,8,CF.Angles(math.pi/2,0,0),.06)
 for j=0,4 do
  local a=j*math.pi*2/5;local x,z=math.cos(a)*.42,math.sin(a)*.42
  block(g,CF.new(x,.22,z),V(.14,.5,.14),GOLD,.08)
  orb(g,CF.new(x,.5,z),V(.18,.18,.18),c,.02)
 end
end
local function snowflake(g,size,c)
 for j=0,5 do
  local a=j*math.pi/3;local dir=V(math.cos(a),math.sin(a),0)
  rod(g,V(0,0,0),dir*size,.065,c,.07)
  for _,side in ipairs({-1,1}) do
   local turn=V(math.cos(a+side*.75),math.sin(a+side*.75),0)
   rod(g,dir*size*.57,dir*size*.57+turn*size*.28,.05,c,.1)
  end
 end
end
local function bloom(g,c)
 for j=0,4 do
  local a=j*math.pi*2/5
  orb(g,CF.new(math.cos(a)*.3,math.sin(a)*.3,0)*CF.Angles(0,0,a),V(.48,.23,.09),c,.13,Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
 end
 orb(g,CF.new(0,0,.04),V(.18,.18,.12),GOLD,.08)
end
local function sample(f,frame,life,speed,spin,gravity,scale)
 return group(f,frame,life,frame.LookVector*(speed or 0),gravity,spin,scale)
end
local function add(id,interval,build,emit)
 assert(not Recipes[id],'Duplicate effect: '..id)
 Recipes[id]={interval=interval,build=build,emit=emit}
end
