local Looks={
    default={1.35,false,2,'wind'},
    aqua={1.45,true,8,'frost'},
    sunset={1.55,true,2,'fire'},
    royal={1.7,true,19,'gold'},
    lime={1.7,true,3,'mist'},
    rose={1.55,false,5,'petal'},

    trail_ice={1.65,false,9,'frost'},
    trail_smoke={1.6,true,3,'mist'},
    trail_coins={1.8,false,2,'gold'},
    trail_ocean={1.65,false,10,'wind'},
    trail_berry={1.75,false,5,'petal'},
    trail_volt={1.7,true,7,'electric'},
    trail_petals={1.7,false,8,'petal'},
    trail_cosmic={1.65,true,11,'star'},
    trail_lava={1.65,true,4,'fire'},
    trail_ghost={1.65,true,7,'mist'},
    trail_neon={1.65,true,5,'electric'},
    trail_party={1.65,false,17,'petal'},
    trail_halo={1.9,true,22,'gold'},
    trail_blizzard={1.6,true,18,'frost'},
    trail_comet={1.65,false,10,'star'},
    trail_eclipse={1.9,true,9,'star'},
    trail_overload={1.8,true,7,'electric'},
    trail_supernova={2,true,9,'star'},
    trail_celebrate={1.75,false,21,'gold'},
}

local function look(item)
    return Looks[item.id] or Looks.default
end

local function scaledSequence(sequence,multiplier)
    local keys={}

    for _,k in ipairs(sequence.Keypoints) do
        keys[#keys+1]=NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(
            k.Time,
            k.Value*multiplier,
            k.Envelope*multiplier
        )
    end

    return NumberSequence.new(keys)
end

local function room(f,cost)
    return #f.free+math.max(
        0,
        math.min(f.limit-#f.parts,PART_BUDGET-allocated)
    )>=cost
end

local function findHand(c,side)
    local p=
        c:FindFirstChild(side..'Hand')
        or c:FindFirstChild(side..' Arm')
        or c:FindFirstChild(side..'LowerArm')

    return p and p:IsA('BasePart') and p or nil
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- BUILD MATCHING FOOT AND ARM EFFECTS
--------------------------------------------------

local function createFx(s,item)
    local f={
        id=item.id,
        root=s.r,
        recipe=Recipes[item.id] or Recipes.default,
        look=look(item),

        attachments={},
        emitters={},
        nozzles={},
        parts={},
        free={},
        groups={},
        hands={},

        count=0,
        next=0,
        handAt=0,
        handIndex=0,
        weaveSeen=0,
        echoUntil=0,
        echoAt=0,

        limit=s.p==me
            and (Input.TouchEnabled and 210 or 400)
            or (Input.TouchEnabled and 65 or 100),

        color=Color3.fromRGB(table.unpack(item.color))
    }

    f.folder=make('Folder',world,{
        Name='Unique_'..s.p.UserId..'_'..item.id
    })

    s.fx=f
    f.recipe.build(f)

    for _,side in ipairs({'Left','Right'}) do
        local limb=findHand(s.c,side)

        if limb then
            local hand={
                part=limb,
                offset=V(0,-limb.Size.Y*.35,0),
                nozzles={}
            }

            f.hands[#f.hands+1]=hand

            local seen={}

            for _,n in ipairs(f.nozzles) do
                if not seen[n.e.Name] then
                    seen[n.e.Name]=true

                    local att=make('Attachment',limb,{
                        Name='HABArm_'..n.e.Name
                    })

                    local e=n.e:Clone()

                    e.Size=scaledSequence(
                        e.Size,
                        f.look[1]*.60
                    )

                    e.Speed=NumberRange.new(
                        e.Speed.Min*.65,
                        e.Speed.Max*.65
                    )

                    e.Enabled=false
                    e.Rate=0
                    e.Parent=att

                    hand.nozzles[#hand.nozzles+1]={
                        a=att,
                        e=e,
                        rate=n.rate*.6
                    }

                    f.attachments[#f.attachments+1]=att
                    f.emitters[#f.emitters+1]=e
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for _,n in ipairs(f.nozzles) do
        n.e.Size=scaledSequence(n.e.Size,f.look[1])
    end

    return f
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- ANIMATE AND RECYCLE COSMETIC GEOMETRY
--------------------------------------------------

local function animateGeometry(f,dt)
    for i=#f.groups,1,-1 do
        local g=f.groups[i]
        g.age=g.age+dt

        if g.age>=g.life
            or (g.follow and not g.follow.Parent) then

            recycle(g)
            table.remove(f.groups,i)
        else
            local t=g.age/g.life

            local size=math.max(
                .03,
                (g.scale and g.scale(t) or 1)*g.effectSize
            )

            local frame=
                g.follow and g.follow.CFrame*g.localFrame
                or g.frame

            local position=
                frame.Position
                +g.velocity*g.age
                +g.gravity*(.5*g.age*g.age)

            local transform=
                CF.new(position)
                *frame.Rotation
                *CF.Angles(
                    g.spin.X*g.age,
                    g.spin.Y*g.age,
                    g.spin.Z*g.age
                )

            local fade=math.clamp(t^1.65,0,1)

            if g.flicker and math.floor(g.age*22)%3==1 then
                fade=1
            end

            for _,a in ipairs(g.atoms) do
                a.p.CFrame=
                    transform
                    *CF.new(a.cf.Position*size)
                    *a.cf.Rotation

                a.p.Size=V(
                    math.max(.01,a.size.X*size),
                    math.max(.01,a.size.Y*size),
                    math.max(.01,a.size.Z*size)
                )

                a.p.Transparency=a.alpha+(1-a.alpha)*fade

                if a.endColor then
                    a.p.Color=a.color:Lerp(a.endColor,t)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

local function emitRecipe(f,frame,dash,size,follow)
    if not room(f,f.look[3]) then return end

    f.count=f.count+1
    f.spawnSize=size
    f.followPart=follow

    f.recipe.emit(f,frame,dash)

    f.spawnSize=nil
    f.followPart=nil
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- WEAVE AFTERIMAGES
-- Copies only body-part silhouettes, never scripts or hitboxes.
--------------------------------------------------

local function echo(s,f)
    local body={}

    for _,p in ipairs(s.c:GetChildren()) do
        if p:IsA('BasePart')
            and p.Name~='HumanoidRootPart'
            and p.Transparency<.95 then

            body[#body+1]=p
        end
    end

    if not room(f,#body) then return end

    local g=group(f,s.r.CFrame,.23)

    for _,p in ipairs(body) do
        atom(
            g,
            p:IsA('Part') and p.Shape or Enum.PartType.Block,
            s.r.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame),
            p.Size*.98,
            f.color:Lerp(WHITE,.18),
            .79,
            Enum.Material.Neon
        )
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- DIRECTIONAL WEAVE BURSTS
--------------------------------------------------

local function weave(s,f,now)
    f.weaveSeen=s.weaveSerial or 0
    f.echoUntil=now+.32
    f.echoAt=now

    -- No screen flash, camera shake, hitbox, speed or i-frame changes.
    if not room(f,30) then return end

    local v=s.r.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    local direction=V(v.X,0,v.Z)

    if direction.Magnitude<1 then
        direction=s.r.CFrame.LookVector
    end

    direction=V(direction.X,0,direction.Z)

    if direction.Magnitude<.1 then
        direction=V(0,0,-1)
    end

    local frame=CF.lookAt(
        s.r.Position,
        s.r.Position+direction.Unit
    )

    local style=f.look[4]

    local g=group(
        f,frame,.42,nil,nil,V(0,3,0),
        function(t)
            return .65+t*1.3
        end
    )

    if style=='electric' then
        -- Forked electricity tears outward from both sides.
        for _,side in ipairs({-1,1}) do
            local last=V(side*.9,-.3,.4)

            for j=1,6 do
                local nextPoint=V(
                    side*(.9+j*.32),
                    rng:NextNumber(-.5,.6),
                    .4+j*.55
                )

                rod(g,last,nextPoint,.13,f.color,.18)
                last=nextPoint
            end
        end

    elseif style=='mist' then
        -- Soft spectral/colored smoke rather than bright rings.
        for j=1,6 do
            orb(
                g,
                CF.new(
                    rng:NextNumber(-2,2),
                    -.6,
                    rng:NextNumber(-1,1)
                ),
                V(1.4,1.7,1.4),
                f.color,
                .88,
                Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            )
        end

    elseif style=='star' then
        -- Expanding stellar corona.
        ring(
            g,CF.identity,
            1.7,.1,f.color,12,nil,.32
        )

        for j=0,7 do
            local a=j*math.pi/4

            rod(
                g,
                V(math.cos(a)*1.9,math.sin(a)*1.9,0),
                V(math.cos(a)*2.8,math.sin(a)*2.8,.3),
                .1,
                WHITE,
                .45
            )
        end

    else
        -- Paired crescents follow the actual dodge direction.
        for _,side in ipairs({-1,1}) do
            local previous

            for j=0,9 do
                local a=-1.1+j*.25

                local point=V(
                    side*math.cos(a)*2.1,
                    math.sin(a)*.65,
                    math.sin(a)*2.4
                )

                if previous then
                    rod(
                        g,previous,point,
                        style=='gold' and .13 or .09,
                        style=='gold' and GOLD or f.color,
                        .24
                    )
                end

                previous=point
            end
        end
    end

    for _,hand in ipairs(f.hands) do
        for _,n in ipairs(hand.nozzles) do
            n.e:Emit(Input.TouchEnabled and 5 or 10)
        end
    end
end

local function handFrame(hand,back,idle)
    local pos=hand.part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(hand.offset)

    local direction=
        idle and V(.1,.7,.2).Unit
        or back

    return CF.lookAt(pos,pos+direction)
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- CONTINUOUS EFFECT OUTPUT
--------------------------------------------------

local function update(s,dt,now,quality)
    if s.fx then
        animateGeometry(s.fx,dt)
    end

    if blocked(s) or not s.allowed then
        destroyFx(s)
        s.pending=false
        return
    end

    local item=selected(s)

    if not item then
        destroyFx(s)
        return
    end

    if s.fx and s.fx.id~=item.id then
        destroyFx(s)
    end

    local r=s.r

    if s.previous and (r.Position-s.previous).Magnitude>55 then
        if s.fx then
            clearParticles(s.fx)
            s.fx.echoUntil=0
        end

        s.pending=false
        s.dodgeUntil=0
        s.groundAt=0
    end

    s.previous=r.Position

    local velocity=r.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    local hit=grounded(s,now)

    if hit and hit.Instance and hit.Instance:IsA('BasePart') then
        velocity=
            velocity
            -hit.Instance:GetVelocityAtPosition(hit.Position)
    end

    local flat=V(velocity.X,0,velocity.Z)

    local climb=
        s.h:GetState()==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing
        and velocity.Magnitude>1

    if flat.Magnitude>2 or climb then
        s.motionUntil=now+.16
    end

    local moving=now<(s.motionUntil or 0)
    local dash=now<(s.dodgeUntil or 0)
    local idle=not moving and not dash

    local on=
        (moving or dash or look(item)[2])
        and s.p:GetAttribute('HussEmotePlaying')==nil

    if not on then
        s.pending=false

        if s.fx then
            for _,e in ipairs(s.fx.emitters) do
                e.Enabled=false
                e.Rate=0
            end

            if now-s.usedAt>1.4 then
                destroyFx(s)
            end
        end

        return
    end

    s.usedAt=now

    local f=s.fx or createFx(s,item)

    local back=
        flat.Magnitude>.5 and -flat.Unit
        or -r.CFrame.LookVector

    local factor=quality*(s.p==me and 1 or .42)
    local power=idle and .24 or (dash and 2.2 or 1.55)
    local cap=Input.TouchEnabled and 75 or 140

    local groundPos=
        hit and hit.Position
        or r.Position-V(0,2.8,0)

    local base=
        V(r.Position.X,groundPos.Y+.8,r.Position.Z)
        +back*.7

    local footCF=CF.lookAt(base,base+back)

    -- Foot/back emitters.
    for _,n in ipairs(f.nozzles) do
        n.a.CFrame=r.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(
            footCF*CF.new(n.offset)
        )

        n.e.Rate=
            hit and math.clamp(
                n.rate*power*factor*1.4,
                0,
                cap
            )
            or 0

        n.e.Enabled=n.e.Rate>0
    end

    -- Matching emitters attached to both hands/arms.
    for _,hand in ipairs(f.hands) do
        if hand.part.Parent then
            local cf=handFrame(hand,back,idle)

            for _,n in ipairs(hand.nozzles) do
                n.a.CFrame=
                    hand.part.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(cf)

                n.e.Rate=math.clamp(
                    n.rate*power*factor*1.4,
                    0,
                    cap
                )

                n.e.Enabled=true
            end
        end
    end

    if s.pending then
        weave(s,f,now)
        s.pending=false
        f.next=0
        f.handAt=0
    end

    if now<f.echoUntil and now>=f.echoAt then
        f.echoAt=now+(Input.TouchEnabled and .12 or .085)
        echo(s,f)
    end

    -- Preserve the selected trail's original geometry recipe.
    if now>=f.next and hit then
        f.next=now+math.max(
            .07,
            f.recipe.interval
                *(idle and 2.4 or .62)
                /math.max(.4,factor)
        )

        emitRecipe(
            f,
            footCF,
            dash,
            f.look[1]*(idle and .60 or 1),
            nil
        )
    end

    -- Alternate recipe geometry between the two arms.
    -- Idle aura geometry follows its hand; moving geometry falls behind.
    if #f.hands>0 and now>=f.handAt then
        f.handAt=now+math.max(
            .11,
            f.recipe.interval
                *(idle and 1.8 or .75)
                /math.max(.45,factor)
        )

        f.handIndex=f.handIndex%#f.hands+1

        local hand=f.hands[f.handIndex]

        if hand.part.Parent then
            local cf=handFrame(hand,back,idle)

            emitRecipe(
                f,
                cf,
                dash,
                f.look[1]*.72,
                idle and hand.part or nil
            )
        end
    end
end

link(Players.PlayerAdded,addPlayer)
link(Players.PlayerRemoving,removePlayer)

for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

local warnedReduced=false

link(Run.Heartbeat,function(dt)
    frameAverage=frameAverage*.96+math.min(dt,.2)*.04
    accum=accum+dt

    if accum<1/30 then
        return
    end

    local step=math.min(accum,.12)
    accum=0

    local now=os.clock()

    if reduced() then
        if not warnedReduced then
            warnedReduced=true

            warn(
                '[HAB Effects] Reduced Motion is ON; '
                .. 'cosmetic trails/auras are hidden.'
            )
        end

        for _,s in pairs(states) do
            destroyFx(s)
            s.pending=false
        end

        return
    end

    warnedReduced=false

    local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then return end

    if now>=budgetClock then
        budgetClock=now+.12

        local candidates={}

        for _,s in pairs(states) do
            s.allowed=false

            if not blocked(s) then
                local item=selected(s)
                local velocity=s.r.AssemblyLinearVelocity

                local moving=
                    V(velocity.X,0,velocity.Z).Magnitude>2
                    or (
                        s.h:GetState()==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing
                        and velocity.Magnitude>1
                    )

                s.distance=
                    (s.r.Position-camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude

                if item
                    and (s.p==me or s.distance<FAR)
                    and (
                        moving
                        or look(item)[2]
                        or now<s.dodgeUntil
                        or s.fx~=nil
                    ) then

                    candidates[#candidates+1]=s
                end
            end
        end

        table.sort(candidates,function(a,b)
            if a.p==me then return b.p~=me end
            if b.p==me then return false end
            return a.distance<b.distance
        end)

        for i=1,math.min(MAX_SETS,#candidates) do
            candidates[i].allowed=true
        end
    end

    local quality=
        (Input.TouchEnabled and .72 or 1)
        *(frameAverage>1/35 and .7 or 1)

    for _,s in pairs(states) do
        if s.r then
            local ok,err=pcall(update,s,step,now,quality)

            if not ok then
                destroyFx(s)

                if now>(s.warnAt or 0) then
                    s.warnAt=now+10

                    warn(
                        '[HAB Arm/Weave] '
                        .. s.p.Name
                        .. ': '
                        .. tostring(err)
                    )
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- HAB_MOTION_REPAIR_1: one visual emote layer, after Animator evaluation.
local jointRoles = {
 Torso='body', LowerTorso='body', UpperTorso='waist', Head='neck',
 ['Right Arm']='right', ['Left Arm']='left',
 RightUpperArm='right', LeftUpperArm='left',
 RightLowerArm='rightElbow', LeftLowerArm='leftElbow',
 RightHand='rightWrist', LeftHand='leftWrist',
 ['Right Leg']='rightLeg', ['Left Leg']='leftLeg',
 RightUpperLeg='rightLeg', LeftUpperLeg='leftLeg',
 RightLowerLeg='rightKnee', LeftLowerLeg='leftKnee',
}
local function emote(s,now,near)
 local id=s.p:GetAttribute('HussEmotePlaying')
 local stamp=s.p:GetAttribute('HussEmoteStarted')
 local i=C.ById[id]
 if not near or not i or i.category~='Emotes' or type(stamp)~='number' or stamp~=stamp
  or s.p:GetAttribute('InRound')==true or s.h.Health<=0 or s.h.Sit or s.h.PlatformStand
  or s.root.Anchored or s.character:GetAttribute('Ragdolled')==true
  or s.character:GetAttribute('IsRagdoll')==true then poseEnd(s);return end
 local age=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()-stamp
 if age<0 or age>6.2 then poseEnd(s);return end
 if s.pose and (s.pose.id~=id or s.pose.stamp~=stamp) then poseEnd(s) end
 if not s.pose then
  local pose={id=id,stamp=stamp,joints={}}
  for _,joint in ipairs(s.character:GetDescendants()) do
   if joint:IsA('Motor6D') or joint:IsA('AnimationConstraint') then
    local child=joint.Part1
    local key=child and jointRoles[child.Name]
    if key and not pose.joints[key] then pose.joints[key]={motor=joint} end
   end
  end
  s.pose=pose
  if not next(pose.joints) then
   if not s.missingJointWarn then warn('[HAB Emotes] No supported avatar joints for '..s.p.Name);s.missingJointWarn=true end
   poseEnd(s);return
  end
 end
 local wave=math.sin(age*7)
 local beat=math.sin(age*5)
 local step=math.sin(age*8)
 local a={}
 if i.style=='wave' then
  a.right=V(-.12,0,2.18+wave*.2);a.rightElbow=V(-.55,0,0);a.rightWrist=V(0,.18*wave,0);a.neck=V(0,-.08,.07)
 elseif i.style=='cheer' then
  a.right=V(-.12,0,2.55+beat*.18);a.left=V(-.12,0,-2.55-beat*.18);a.body=V(.035*beat,0,.025*beat)
 elseif i.style=='salute' then

-- HussCarrierPanicV12: cosmetic panic run and pooled tears for the authoritative carrier.
-- Normal locomotion, shift lock, speed, collision, dodge and immunity remain with their controllers.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Run = game:GetService("RunService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local me = Players.LocalPlayer
local V, CF = Vector3.new, CFrame.new
local DODGE_DURATION, IFRAME_DURATION, VIEW_DISTANCE = .72, .45, 110
local DROPS_PER_CARRIER, MAX_DROPS = 12, 36
local states, players, botFolders, links = {}, {}, {}, {}
local stopped, allocated = false, 0
local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name = "HussCarrierTearsV12"
folder.Parent = workspace
local diveActions = {
	DiveForward=true, DiveBack=true, DiveLeft=true, DiveRight=true,
	DiveForwardLeft=true, DiveForwardRight=true, DiveBackLeft=true, DiveBackRight=true,
}
local jointRoles = {
	Torso="body", UpperTorso="body", Head="neck",
	["Left Arm"]="leftArm", ["Right Arm"]="rightArm",
	LeftUpperArm="leftArm", RightUpperArm="rightArm",
	LeftLowerArm="leftElbow", RightLowerArm="rightElbow",
}
local function connect(signal, callback, bucket)
	table.insert(bucket or links, signal:Connect(callback))
end
local function disconnect(bucket)
	for _, connection in ipairs(bucket) do connection:Disconnect() end
	table.clear(bucket)
end
local function finite(value)
	return type(value)=="number" and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge
end
local function reduced()
	return me:GetAttribute("HussReducedMotion")==true or workspace:GetAttribute("HussReducedMotion")==true
end
local function restoreJoint(joint)
	-- Another controller may already own the joint. Never restore over its new pose.
	if joint.base then
		if joint.motor.Parent and joint.motor.Transform==joint.applied then
			joint.motor.Transform=joint.base
		end
		joint.base, joint.applied=nil, nil
	end
end
local function restore(state)
	for _, joint in ipairs(state.joints) do restoreJoint(joint) end
end
local function clearDrops(state)
	if not state.drops then return end
	for _, drop in ipairs(state.drops) do drop.part:Destroy() end
	allocated-=#state.drops
	state.drops=nil
	state.nextDrop=0
end
local function cancel(state)
	restore(state)
	state.weight=0
	clearDrops(state)
end
local function dispose(character)
	local state=states[character]
	if not state then return end
	cancel(state)
	disconnect(state.links)
	states[character]=nil
end
local function addJoint(state, motor)
	if not motor:IsA("Motor6D") or not motor.Part0 or not motor.Part1 then return end
	local role=jointRoles[motor.Part1.Name]
	if not role then return end
	for _, joint in ipairs(state.joints) do if joint.motor==motor then return end end
	table.insert(state.joints, {motor=motor, role=role})
end
local function beginDodge(state, age)
	if not finite(age) or age<0 or age>=DODGE_DURATION then return end
	state.dodgeUntil=math.max(state.dodgeUntil, os.clock()+DODGE_DURATION-age)
	cancel(state)
end
local function actionChanged(state)
	local action=state.character:GetAttribute("MovementAction")
	if diveActions[action] then beginDodge(state, 0) end
	-- Keep the short exclusion through recovery, even if DiveEnd arrived early.
end
local function characterAdded(character, player, sourceFolder)
	if stopped or states[character] or not character:IsA("Model") then return end
	local state={character=character, player=player, sourceFolder=sourceFolder,
		joints={}, links={}, weight=0, dodgeUntil=0, nextDrop=0, phase=0}
	states[character]=state
	local function refresh()
		state.h=character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		state.root=character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		state.head=character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		if state.h and state.boundHumanoid~=state.h then
			state.boundHumanoid=state.h
			connect(state.h.Died, function() cancel(state) end, state.links)
		end
	end
	refresh()
	for _, object in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do addJoint(state, object) end
	connect(character.DescendantAdded, function(object)
		addJoint(state, object)
		if object.Parent==character then refresh() end
	end, state.links)
	connect(character.DescendantRemoving, function(object)
		for index=#state.joints,1,-1 do
			local joint=state.joints[index]
			if joint.motor==object then restoreJoint(joint); table.remove(state.joints,index) end
		end
		if object==state.root or object==state.h or object==state.head then
			cancel(state)
			if object==state.root then state.root=nil end
			if object==state.h then state.h=nil end
			if object==state.head then state.head=nil end
		end
	end, state.links)
	connect(character:GetAttributeChangedSignal("HussBombCarrier"), function()
		if character:GetAttribute("HussBombCarrier")~=true then cancel(state) end
	end, state.links)
	connect(character:GetAttributeChangedSignal("MovementActionId"), function() actionChanged(state) end, state.links)
	local function immunityChanged()
		local untilTime=character:GetAttribute("BombTagIFrameUntil")
		local serverNow=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
		if finite(untilTime) and untilTime>serverNow then
			-- The reviewed server publishes a .45-second immunity window, including to
			-- clients that do not receive the optional dodge animation broadcast.
			beginDodge(state,math.max(0,IFRAME_DURATION-(untilTime-serverNow)))
		end
	end
	connect(character:GetAttributeChangedSignal("BombTagIFrameUntil"),immunityChanged,state.links)
	immunityChanged()
	connect(character.AncestryChanged, function()
		if not character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then dispose(character) end
	end, state.links)
end
local function addPlayer(player)
	if players[player] then return end
	local bucket={}
	players[player]=bucket
	connect(player.CharacterAdded, function(character) characterAdded(character, player) end, bucket)
	connect(player.CharacterRemoving, dispose, bucket)
	if player.Character then characterAdded(player.Character, player) end
end
local function removePlayer(player)
	local bucket=players[player]
	if bucket then disconnect(bucket); players[player]=nil end
	local characters={}
	for character,state in pairs(states) do if state.player==player then table.insert(characters,character) end end
	for _, character in ipairs(characters) do dispose(character) end
end
local function bindBots(object)
	if stopped or object.Name~="HussPracticeBots" or not object:IsA("Folder") or botFolders[object] then return end
	local bucket={}
	botFolders[object]=bucket
	local function add(character)
		if character:IsA("Model") and character:GetAttribute("HussPracticeBot")==true then characterAdded(character,nil,object) end
	end
	connect(object.ChildAdded, add, bucket)
	connect(object.ChildRemoved, dispose, bucket)
	for _, character in ipairs(object:GetChildren()) do add(character) end
end
local function removeBots(object)
	local bucket=botFolders[object]
	if not bucket then return end
	disconnect(bucket)
	botFolders[object]=nil
	local characters={}
	for character,state in pairs(states) do if state.sourceFolder==object then table.insert(characters,character) end end
	for _, character in ipairs(characters) do dispose(character) end
end
local function blocked(state, now, serverNow)
	local c,h,r,head=state.character,state.h,state.root,state.head
	if c:GetAttribute("HussBombCarrier")~=true or not c.Parent or not h or not r or not head
		or not h.Parent or not r.Parent or not head.Parent or h.Health<=0 or r.Anchored or h.Sit or h.PlatformStand then return true end
	if reduced() or workspace:GetAttribute("HussGamePaused")==true or c:GetAttribute("HussGamePaused")==true
		or state.player and state.player:GetAttribute("HussGamePaused")==true then return true end
	if c:GetAttribute("Ragdolled")==true or c:GetAttribute("IsRagdoll")==true then return true end
	local mode=h:GetState()
	if mode==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead or mode==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
		or mode==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or mode==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated then return true end
	-- Emotes use C0 in CollectionEffects; panic uses Transform and gives emotes priority.
	if state.player and type(state.player:GetAttribute("HussEmotePlaying"))=="string" then return true end
	if now<state.dodgeUntil then return true end
	local started=c:GetAttribute("HussDodgeStartedAt")
	if finite(started) and serverNow>=started-.1 and serverNow<started+DODGE_DURATION then return true end
	local immuneUntil=c:GetAttribute("BombTagIFrameUntil")
	if finite(immuneUntil) and immuneUntil>serverNow then return true end
	local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
	return not camera or (camera.CFrame.Position-r.Position).Magnitude>VIEW_DISTANCE
end
local function pose(role, phase, running, r15)
	local swing=math.sin(phase)
	local flutter=math.sin(phase*1.9)
	local pitch,yaw,roll=0,0,0
	if role=="body" then
		pitch=-4-7*running
		yaw=swing*(2+3*running)
		roll=swing*(1.5+2.5*running)
	elseif role=="neck" then
		pitch=8+flutter*3
		yaw=math.sin(phase*.48)*17
		roll=-swing*4
	elseif role=="leftArm" then
		pitch=136+swing*(14+10*running)
		yaw=-12
		roll=-38-flutter*8
	elseif role=="rightArm" then
		pitch=136-swing*(14+10*running)
		yaw=12
		roll=38+flutter*8
	elseif role=="leftElbow" then pitch=48-swing*12
	elseif role=="rightElbow" then pitch=48+swing*12 end
	if role=="body" and not r15 then pitch*=.65; roll*=.7 end
	if not r15 and (role=="leftArm" or role=="rightArm") then pitch+=14 end
	return CFrame.Angles(math.rad(pitch),math.rad(yaw),math.rad(roll))
end
local function makeDrops(state)
	if state.drops then return true end
	if allocated+DROPS_PER_CARRIER>MAX_DROPS then return false end

		local part=Instance.new("Part")
		part.Name="PanicTear"
		part.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball
		part.Size=V(.12,.22,.12)
		part.Color=Color3.fromRGB(97,225,255)
		part.Material=Enum.Material.Neon
		part.Anchored=true
		part.CanCollide=false
		part.CanTouch=false
		part.CanQuery=false
		part.CastShadow=false
		part.Transparency=1
		part.Parent=folder
		table.insert(state.drops,{part=part})
	end
	allocated+=DROPS_PER_CARRIER
	return true
end
local function tears(state, now)
	if not makeDrops(state) then return end
	if now>=state.nextDrop then
		state.nextDrop=now+.075
		local head=state.head
		for _, side in ipairs({-1,1}) do
			for _, drop in ipairs(state.drops) do
				if not drop.born then
					drop.born=now
					drop.origin=head.CFrame*V(side*head.Size.X*.18,head.Size.Y*.09,-head.Size.Z*.5-.055)
					local velocity=state.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
					drop.velocity=V(velocity.X,0,velocity.Z)*.42+head.CFrame.RightVector*(side*3.3)+head.CFrame.LookVector*1.3+V(0,1.2,0)
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end
	for _, drop in ipairs(state.drops) do
		if drop.born then
			local age=now-drop.born
			if age>=.38 then drop.born=nil; drop.part.Transparency=1
			else
				local position=drop.origin+drop.velocity*age+V(0,-9*age*age,0)
				local velocity=drop.velocity+V(0,-18*age,0)
				-- A fixed roll avoids lookAt singularities for nearly vertical droplets.
				drop.part.CFrame=CF(position)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.atan2(-velocity.X,math.max(.1,math.abs(velocity.Y))))
				drop.part.Transparency=.08+.92*(age/.38)^1.6
			end
		end
	end
end

connect(Players.PlayerRemoving, removePlayer)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do addPlayer(player) end
connect(workspace.ChildAdded, bindBots)

end)

end)
connect(Run.PreSimulation, function(dt)
	local now,serverNow=os.clock(),workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	for _, state in pairs(states) do
		if blocked(state,now,serverNow) then cancel(state)
		else
			state.weight=math.min(1,state.weight+math.clamp(dt,0,.1)*7)
			local velocity=state.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local running=math.clamp(V(velocity.X,0,velocity.Z).Magnitude/32,0,1)
			state.phase=(state.phase+math.clamp(dt,0,.1)*(8+running*7))%(math.pi*2)
			local phase=state.phase
			for _, joint in ipairs(state.joints) do
				local motor=joint.motor
				if motor.Parent and motor.Enabled then
					local axes=motor.C0.Rotation
					local offset=axes:Inverse()*pose(joint.role,phase,running,state.h.RigType==Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15)*axes
					joint.base=motor.Transform
					local upperArm=joint.role=="leftArm" or joint.role=="rightArm" or joint.role=="leftElbow" or joint.role=="rightElbow"
					joint.applied=upperArm and joint.base:Lerp(offset,state.weight*.86)
						or joint.base:Lerp(joint.base*offset,state.weight)
					motor.Transform=joint.applied
				end
			end
			tears(state,now)
		end
	end
end)

local function restoreJoint(joint)
	-- Another controller may already own the joint. Never restore over its new pose.
	if joint.base then
		if joint.motor.Parent and joint.motor.Transform==joint.applied then
			joint.motor.Transform=joint.base
		end
		joint.base, joint.applied=nil, nil
	end

local function addJoint(state, motor)
	if not motor:IsA("Motor6D") or not motor.Part0 or not motor.Part1 then return end
	local role=jointRoles[motor.Part1.Name]
	if not role then return end
	for _, joint in ipairs(state.joints) do if joint.motor==motor then return end end
	table.insert(state.joints, {motor=motor, role=role})
end
local function beginDodge(state, age)
	if not finite(age) or age<0 or age>=DODGE_DURATION then return end
	state.dodgeUntil=math.max(state.dodgeUntil, os.clock()+DODGE_DURATION-age)
	cancel(state)

	if diveActions[action] then beginDodge(state, 0) end
	-- Keep the short exclusion through recovery, even if DiveEnd arrived early.
end
local function characterAdded(character, player, sourceFolder)
	if stopped or states[character] or not character:IsA("Model") then return end
	local state={character=character, player=player, sourceFolder=sourceFolder,
		joints={}, links={}, weight=0, dodgeUntil=0, nextDrop=0, phase=0}
	states[character]=state
	local function refresh()
		state.h=character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		state.root=character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		state.head=character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		if state.h and state.boundHumanoid~=state.h then
			state.boundHumanoid=state.h
			connect(state.h.Died, function() cancel(state) end, state.links)
		end
	end

		addJoint(state, object)

		end

			if object==state.head then state.head=nil end
		end

local function blocked(state, now, serverNow)
	local c,h,r,head=state.character,state.h,state.root,state.head
	if c:GetAttribute("HussBombCarrier")~=true or not c.Parent or not h or not r or not head
		or not h.Parent or not r.Parent or not head.Parent or h.Health<=0 or r.Anchored or h.Sit or h.PlatformStand then return true end
	if reduced() or workspace:GetAttribute("HussGamePaused")==true or c:GetAttribute("HussGamePaused")==true
		or state.player and state.player:GetAttribute("HussGamePaused")==true then return true end
	if c:GetAttribute("Ragdolled")==true or c:GetAttribute("IsRagdoll")==true then return true end
	local mode=h:GetState()
	if mode==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead or mode==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
		or mode==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or mode==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated then return true end
	-- Emotes use C0 in CollectionEffects; panic uses Transform and gives emotes priority.
	if state.player and type(state.player:GetAttribute("HussEmotePlaying"))=="string" then return true end
	if now<state.dodgeUntil then return true end
	local actionUntil=c:GetAttribute("HABActionPoseUntil")
	local weaveUntil=c:GetAttribute("HABWeavePoseUntil")
	if finite(actionUntil) and actionUntil>serverNow or finite(weaveUntil) and weaveUntil>serverNow then return true end
	local started=c:GetAttribute("HussDodgeStartedAt")
	if finite(started) and serverNow>=started-.1 and serverNow<started+DODGE_DURATION then return true end
	local immuneUntil=c:GetAttribute("BombTagIFrameUntil")
	if finite(immuneUntil) and immuneUntil>serverNow then return true end
	local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
	return not camera or (camera.CFrame.Position-r.Position).Magnitude>VIEW_DISTANCE
end
local function pose(role, phase, running, r15)
	local swing=math.sin(phase)
	local flutter=math.sin(phase*1.9)
	local pitch,yaw,roll=0,0,0
	if role=="body" then
		pitch=-4-7*running
		yaw=swing*(2+3*running)
		roll=swing*(1.5+2.5*running)
	elseif role=="neck" then
		pitch=8+flutter*3
		yaw=math.sin(phase*.48)*17
		roll=-swing*4
	elseif role=="leftArm" then
		pitch=136+swing*(14+10*running)
		yaw=-12
		roll=-38-flutter*8
	elseif role=="rightArm" then
		pitch=136-swing*(14+10*running)
		yaw=12
		roll=38+flutter*8
	elseif role=="leftElbow" then pitch=48-swing*12
	elseif role=="rightElbow" then pitch=48+swing*12 end
	if role=="body" and not r15 then pitch*=.65; roll*=.7 end
	if not r15 and (role=="leftArm" or role=="rightArm") then pitch+=14 end
	return CFrame.Angles(math.rad(pitch),math.rad(yaw),math.rad(roll))
end

local function transact(action,payload)
 if busy or pending then return end
 pending={Action=action,Payload=payload};request(action,payload)
end
local function purchase(direct)
 if busy or pending or not state.Ready then return end
 local crate=Catalog.Crates[category];local p=pool(category);local n=#p.Items
 if not p.CanBuy then say('This collection is complete or already covered by your stored crates.');return end
 if not direct and not state.RandomAllowed then say(state.PolicyMessage);return end
 if direct and not has(p.Items,selected) then say('Choose an unowned, unreserved effect.');return end
 local cost=direct and math.ceil(crate.Price*(n+1)/2) or crate.Price
 if state.Gems<cost then current='GEMS';render();say('Not enough Gems. Claim quests or buy Gems.');return end
 local payload={Category=category,Token=Http:GenerateGUID(false),Revision=state.Revision,Choice=direct and selected or nil}
 local desc=direct and ('Contents: '..Catalog.ById[selected].Name..'. 100% chance.')
  or (Model.Odds(n)..'\nNo duplicates. The remaining odds update as effects are owned or reserved. See CONTENTS & ODDS for every outcome.')
 confirm('STORE '..crate.Label:upper()..' CRATE',desc..'\n\n'..cost..' Gems. Stored unopened in your inventory.','BUY & STORE',function()
  if state.Revision~=payload.Revision then render();say('Your inventory changed. Review the new odds and confirm again.');return end
  transact('BuyCrate',payload)
 end,not direct and table.clone(p.Items) or nil)
end
local function storedAction(stored,refund)
 if busy or pending or not state.Ready then return end
 local payload={Crate=stored.Id,Token=Http:GenerateGUID(false),Revision=state.Revision}
 local desc,title,caption
 if refund then
  title='REFUND SEALED CRATE';caption='REFUND'
  desc='Remove this unopened crate from inventory and return exactly '..stored.Cost..' Gems.\nNo effect is awarded.'
 else
  if stored.Mode=='Random' and not state.RandomAllowed then say('Random opening is unavailable. Use REFUND to recover this crate\'s Gems.');return end
  local n=#pool(stored.Category).Items
  if stored.Mode=='Random' and n<1 then say('No available contents. Refund this crate instead.');return end
  title='OPEN ONE STORED CRATE';caption='OPEN CRATE'
  desc=stored.Mode=='Guaranteed' and ('Contents: '..(Catalog.ById[stored.Choice] and Catalog.ById[stored.Choice].Name or stored.Choice)..' (100%).')
   or ('One of '..n..' available effects. Each outcome: '..string.format('%.4f%%',100/math.max(1,n))..'.\nUse VIEW REWARDS & ODDS for the complete list. Percentages are rounded.')
  desc=desc..'\n\nConsumes ONE stored crate. Costs NO additional Gems. Your saved reward then receives its opening animation.'
 end
 confirm(title,desc,caption,function()
  if state.Revision~=payload.Revision then render();say('Your inventory changed. Confirm again with the updated contents.');return end
  transact(refund and 'RefundStored' or 'OpenStored',payload)
 end,not refund and stored.Mode=='Random' and table.clone(pool(stored.Category).Items) or nil)
end

  for i,row in ipairs(rows) do if row.Id==focusId then page=math.ceil(i/pageSize);break end end
  focusId=nil
 end
 local index=0
 for i=(page-1)*pageSize+1,math.min(page*pageSize,#rows) do
  local row=rows[i];local color=row.Color or C.cyan
  local f=card(s,'Inventory_'..row.Key,row.Equipped and C.green or color,cw,ch)
  rect(f,6+(index%cols)*(cw+gap),6+math.floor(index/cols)*(ch+gap),cw,ch);index=index+1
  local art=math.min(cw-46,ch-138,196)
  if row.Kind=='Crate' then chest(f,row.Category,18,14,cw-36,art+8)
  elseif not row.Missing then preview(f,row.Id,(cw-art)/2,17,art,7)
  else local missing=text(f,'LEGACY EFFECT',18,C.muted);rect(missing,18,40,cw-36,art) end
  local title=text(f,row.Name,23,C.white);rect(title,18,ch-111,cw-36,47);title.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
  if row.Kind=='Crate' then
   local qty=text(f,'SEALED  x'..row.Count,13,C.gold);rect(qty,16,8,cw-32,23)
   local b=button(f,'Open_'..row.Crate.Id,'OPEN CRATE',C.green,function() storedAction(row.Crate,false) end)
   rect(b,16,ch-56,cw-89,47);b.TextSize=19;disabled(b,busy or pending~=nil or not state.Ready or (row.Crate.Mode=='Random' and not state.RandomAllowed))
   local more=button(f,'CrateInfo_'..row.Crate.Id,'...',C.cyan,function() storedAction(row.Crate,true) end)
   rect(more,cw-64,ch-56,48,47);more.TextSize=22;disabled(more,busy or pending~=nil or not state.Ready)
  else
   local b=button(f,'View_'..row.Id,row.Equipped and 'EQUIPPED • VIEW' or 'VIEW EFFECT',row.Equipped and C.green or color,function()
    if not row.Missing then inspectEffect(row.Id,false) else say('This saved effect is missing from the catalog: '..row.Id) end
   end)
   rect(b,16,ch-57,cw-32,47);b.TextSize=19
   local hit=make('TextButton',f,{Name='Inspect_'..row.Id,Text='',BackgroundTransparency=1,Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,-64),ZIndex=f.ZIndex+45,AutoButtonColor=false})
   link(hit.Activated,function() if not row.Missing then inspectEffect(row.Id,false) end end,pageLinks)
  end
 end
 s.CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,math.ceil(index/cols)*(ch+gap)+12)
 if #rows==0 then
  local title=text(s,not state.Ready and 'LOADING YOUR INVENTORY...' or 'NO ITEMS IN THIS FILTER',22,C.white);rect(title,16,24,bw-32,70);title.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
  local desc=text(s,not state.Ready and 'Waiting for your saved profile.' or 'Opened effects and your sealed crates appear here.',15,C.muted);rect(desc,16,98,bw-32,64);desc.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
  local b=button(s,'InventoryEmptyAction',inventoryFilter~='All' and 'SHOW ALL ITEMS' or 'SHOP CRATES',C.violet,function()
   if inventoryFilter~='All' then inventoryFilter='All' else current='CRATES';category=nil end
   page=1;render()
  end);rect(b,16,175,bw-32,49)
  s.CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,238)
 end
 pagers(body,bh-48,#rows,pageSize)
end

local function supplemental()
 local s=scroll(body,'GemsAndQuests',0,0,bw,bh)
 local y=6
 local function row(title,description,caption,color,fn,off,isGem)
  local rh=bw<580 and 242 or 190
  local f=card(s,'ShopOffer',color,bw-16,rh);rect(f,6,y,bw-16,rh)
  if isGem then local gem=T.Gem(f,bw<580 and 74 or 86);gem.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,bw<580 and 63 or 31) end
  local x=isGem and (bw<580 and 99 or 112) or 16
  local t=text(f,title,bw<580 and 20 or 27,color);rect(t,bw<580 and 16 or x,12,bw-(bw<580 and 55 or x+39),44)
  local d=text(f,description,bw<580 and 12 or 14,C.white);rect(d,x,60,bw-x-39,bw<580 and 85 or 46)
  local b=button(f,'Offer_'..y,caption,color,fn);rect(b,14,rh-59,bw-44,48);b.TextSize=17;disabled(b,off)
  y=y+rh+18;return b
 end
 if current=='QUESTS' then
  for _,q in ipairs(state.Quests or {}) do
   local allowed=state.Ready and q.Progress>=q.Target and not q.Claimed
   row(q.Title:upper(),q.Progress..' / '..q.Target..'   •   +'..q.Coins..' COINS   + '..q.Gems..' GEMS',q.Claimed and 'CLAIMED' or allowed and 'CLAIM REWARDS' or 'IN PROGRESS',C.gold,function() request('ClaimQuest',q.Id) end,busy or pending~=nil or not allowed,false)
  end
  if #(state.Quests or {})==0 then row('DAILY QUESTS','Your quest record is loading. Multiplayer quests award Gems.','REFRESH',C.gold,function() request('Sync') end,busy,false) end
 else
  row(fmt(state.Gems)..' GEMS','Gems buy crates for your inventory. Earn them from quests or buy a configured Gem pack.','EARN GEMS • QUESTS',C.cyan,function() current='QUESTS';page=1;render() end,false,true)
  if #(state.Products or {})==0 then
   row('GEM PACKS','Robux packs are not configured for this experience. Quest Gems still work.','VIEW QUESTS',C.violet,function() current='QUESTS';render() end,false,true)
  end
  for _,offer in ipairs(state.Products or {}) do
   local offerKey=offer.Key;local productId=offer.ProductId
   local cache=prices[productId]
   local caption=cache and cache.Price and ('BUY • R$ '..cache.Price) or cache and cache.Failed and 'PRICE UNAVAILABLE' or 'LOADING PRICE...'
   row(fmt(offer.Gems)..' GEMS • '..offer.Name, 'Added to your saved Gem balance after Roblox confirms your purchase.',caption,C.cyan,function() request('GemPrompt',offerKey) end,busy or pending~=nil or not state.Ready or not(cache and cache.Price),true)
   if not cache then
    prices[productId]={Loading=true}
    task.spawn(function()
     local ok,info=pcall(Marketplace.GetProductInfoAsync,Marketplace,productId,Enum.InfoType.Product)
     prices[productId]=ok and type(info)=='table' and type(info.PriceInRobux)=='number' and {Price=info.PriceInRobux} or {Failed=true}
     if alive and backdrop.Visible and current=='GEMS' then render() end
    end)
   end
  end
 end
 s.CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,y+6)
end

revealReceipt=function(receipt,demo)
 if not loaded or not Catalog.Get(receipt.Item) then return end
 generation=generation+1;local g=generation
 local oldTab,oldCategory,oldSelected,oldPage=current,category,selected,page
 backdrop.Visible=false;clearBody()
 Reveal.Play(receipt,function()
  if not alive or g~=generation or me:GetAttribute('InRound')==true then return end
  if demo then current,category,selected,page=oldTab,oldCategory,oldSelected,oldPage
  else current='INVENTORY';category=nil;inventoryFilter='All';selected=receipt.Item;focusId=receipt.Item;page=1 end
  backdrop.Visible=true;me:SetAttribute('HABCollectionOpen',true);render();request('Sync')
 end,demo)
end
request=function(action,payload)
 if not loaded or busy or not alive then return end
 if pending and action~=pending.Action and action~='Sync' then say('Resume your pending transaction first.');return end
 busy=true;serial=serial+1;local token=serial;local g=generation
 if action~='Sync' then stopConfirm();say('Saving your change...');render() end
 task.delay(25,function()
  if alive and busy and token==serial then busy=false;serial=serial+1;render();say(pending and 'Save/connection delayed. RESUME keeps the same transaction ID.' or 'Connection delayed. Try again.') end
 end)
 task.spawn(function()
  local ok,result=pcall(API.InvokeServer,API,action,payload)
  if not alive or token~=serial then return end
  busy=false
  if not ok or type(result)~='table' then render();say('Connection interrupted. Use RESUME for a pending transaction.');return end
  local before=viewKey(state)
  if type(result.Profile)=='table' then
   state=Model.Accept(state,result.Profile)
  end
  if pending and action==pending.Action and result.Pending~=true and (result.Profile or result.Receipt) then pending=nil end
  if result.OK and result.Receipt and result.Receipt.Kind=='Buy' then current='INVENTORY';category=nil;inventoryFilter='All';page=1 end
  if action~='Sync' or viewKey(state)~=before then render() end
  if action~='Sync' or result.OK~=true then say(result.Message or 'Your inventory is ready.') end
  if action=='GemPrompt' and result.OK and type(result.ProductId)=='number' then
   local good,err=pcall(Marketplace.PromptProductPurchase,Marketplace,me,result.ProductId)
   if not good then say('Roblox purchase window unavailable: '..tostring(err)) end
  end
  local receipt=result.OK and result.Receipt
  if receipt and receipt.Kind=='Open' and Catalog.Get(receipt.Item) and not shown[receipt.Token] then
   if g==generation and backdrop.Visible and me:GetAttribute('InRound')~=true then shown[receipt.Token]=true;revealReceipt(receipt,false)
   else say('Opening completed. Your effect is in INVENTORY.') end
  end
 end)
end

end

  rect(b,5+(i-1)*151,3,140,32);b.TextSize=13;b:SetAttribute('HussSelected',category==cat)
 end
end
local function confirm(title,description,caption,callback,rewardIds)
 if confirmation then return end
 local cover=make('TextButton',root,{Name='ConfirmTransaction',Text='',AutoButtonColor=false,Modal=true,Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundColor3=C.ink,BackgroundTransparency=.18,BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=90})
 confirmation=cover
 local box=T.Panel(cover,'Confirmation',math.min(570,w-28),342,91,C.gold)
 box.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5);box.Position=UDim2.fromScale(.5,.5)
 local t=text(box,title,26,C.gold);rect(t,20,16,box.Size.X.Offset-40,54)
 local d=text(box,description,14,C.white);rect(d,20,82,box.Size.X.Offset-40,164)
 local cancel=button(box,'Close','CANCEL',C.red,function() stopConfirm() end,confirmLinks)
 local yes=button(box,'Confirm',caption,C.green,function() stopConfirm();callback() end,confirmLinks)
 rect(cancel,18,277,(box.Size.X.Offset-48)/2,48);rect(yes,30+(box.Size.X.Offset-48)/2,277,(box.Size.X.Offset-48)/2,48)
 yes.TextSize=16
 if rewardIds and #rewardIds>0 then
  local list=scroll(box,'ConfirmedOutcomeList',20,80,box.Size.X.Offset-40,165);list.Visible=false
  for i,id in ipairs(rewardIds) do
   local item=Catalog.Get(id)
   local line=text(list,(item and item.Name or id)..'  '..string.format('%.6f%%',100/#rewardIds),12,C.white)
   rect(line,5,(i-1)*28,list.Size.X.Offset-17,26)
  end
  list.CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,#rewardIds*28)
  local details=make('TextButton',box,{Name='OutcomeDetails',Text='VIEW REWARDS & ODDS',TextSize=11,Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold,
   BackgroundTransparency=1,TextColor3=C.cyan,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(20,247),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(box.Size.X.Offset-40,22),ZIndex=box.ZIndex+24})
  link(details.Activated,function() list.Visible=not list.Visible;d.Visible=not list.Visible;details.Text=list.Visible and 'BACK TO CONFIRMATION' or 'VIEW REWARDS & ODDS' end,confirmLinks)
 end
end
local function transact(action,payload)
 if busy or pending then return end
 pending={Action=action,Payload=payload};request(action,payload)
end
local function purchase(direct)
 if busy or pending or not state.Ready then return end
 local crate=Catalog.Crates[category];local p=pool(category);local n=#p.Items
 if not p.CanBuy then say('This collection is complete or already covered by your stored crates.');return end
 if not direct and not state.RandomAllowed then say(state.PolicyMessage);return end
 if direct and not has(p.Items,selected) then say('Choose an unowned, unreserved effect.');return end
 local cost=direct and math.ceil(crate.Price*(n+1)/2) or crate.Price
 if state.Gems<cost then current='GEMS';render();say('Not enough Gems. Claim quests or buy Gems.');return end
 local payload={Category=category,Token=Http:GenerateGUID(false),Revision=state.Revision,Choice=direct and selected or nil}
 local desc=direct and ('Contents: '..Catalog.ById[selected].Name..'. 100% chance.')
  or (Model.Odds(n)..'\nNo duplicates. The remaining odds update as effects are owned or reserved. See CONTENTS & ODDS for every outcome.')
 confirm('STORE '..crate.Label:upper()..' CRATE',desc..'\n\n'..cost..' Gems. Stored unopened in your inventory.','BUY & STORE',function()
  if state.Revision~=payload.Revision then render();say('Your inventory changed. Review the new odds and confirm again.');return end
  transact('BuyCrate',payload)
 end,not direct and table.clone(p.Items) or nil)
end
local function storedAction(stored,refund)
 if busy or pending or not state.Ready then return end
 local payload={Crate=stored.Id,Token=Http:GenerateGUID(false),Revision=state.Revision}
 local desc,title,caption
 if refund then
  title='REFUND SEALED CRATE';caption='REFUND'
  desc='Remove this unopened crate from inventory and return exactly '..stored.Cost..' Gems.\nNo effect is awarded.'
 else
  if stored.Mode=='Random' and not state.RandomAllowed then say('Random opening is unavailable. Use REFUND to recover this crate\'s Gems.');return end
  local n=#pool(stored.Category).Items
  if stored.Mode=='Random' and n<1 then say('No available contents. Refund this crate instead.');return end
  title='OPEN ONE STORED CRATE';caption='OPEN CRATE'
  desc=stored.Mode=='Guaranteed' and ('Contents: '..(Catalog.ById[stored.Choice] and Catalog.ById[stored.Choice].Name or stored.Choice)..' (100%).')
   or ('One of '..n..' available effects. Each outcome: '..string.format('%.4f%%',100/math.max(1,n))..'.\nUse VIEW REWARDS & ODDS for the complete list. Percentages are rounded.')
  desc=desc..'\n\nConsumes ONE stored crate. Costs NO additional Gems. Your saved reward then receives its opening animation.'
 end
 confirm(title,desc,caption,function()
  if state.Revision~=payload.Revision then render();say('Your inventory changed. Confirm again with the updated contents.');return end
  transact(refund and 'RefundStored' or 'OpenStored',payload)
 end,not refund and stored.Mode=='Random' and table.clone(pool(stored.Category).Items) or nil)
end
local function pagers(parent,y,total,pageSize)
 local maxPage=math.max(1,math.ceil(total/pageSize));page=math.clamp(page,1,maxPage)
 if maxPage<=1 then return end
 local narrow=bw<450;local ww=narrow and 62 or 140
 local left=button(parent,'Previous',narrow and '<' or '< PREVIOUS',C.cyan,function() page=page-1;render() end)
 local right=button(parent,'Next',narrow and '>' or 'NEXT >',C.cyan,function() page=page+1;render() end)
 rect(left,4,y,ww,46);rect(right,bw-ww-4,y,ww,46);left.TextSize=18;right.TextSize=18
 disabled(left,page<=1);disabled(right,page>=maxPage)
 local t=text(parent,page..' / '..maxPage,16,C.muted);t.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
 rect(t,ww+12,y,bw-2*ww-24,45)
end
local function cardLayout(availableHeight)
 local cols=bw>=660 and 2 or 1
 local gap=24;local cw=(bw-16-gap*(cols-1))/cols
 local rows=availableHeight>=552 and 2 or 1
 local ch=rows==2 and math.floor((availableHeight-32)/2) or math.clamp(availableHeight-12,270,346)
 return cols,rows,cw,ch,gap,cols*rows
end

local function inspectEffect(id,canChoose)
 local item=Catalog.Get(id)
 if not item or confirmation then return end
 local width=math.min(530,w-28);local height=math.min(590,h-20)
 local cover=make('TextButton',root,{Name='EffectInspector',Text='',AutoButtonColor=false,Modal=true,
  Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundColor3=C.ink,BackgroundTransparency=.16,BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=90})
 confirmation=cover
 local box=T.Panel(cover,'EffectInspectorPanel',width,height,91,item.Color)
 box.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5);box.Position=UDim2.fromScale(.5,.5);bubble(box,27)
 local title=text(box,item.Name:upper(),26,C.white);rect(title,20,18,width-91,50)
 local x=button(box,'CloseEffect','X',C.red,function() stopConfirm() end,confirmLinks);rect(x,width-67,17,47,47)
 local artSize=math.max(90,math.min(290,width-50,height-269))
 local art=flat(box,'LargeEffectPreview',(width-artSize)/2,72,artSize,artSize)
 art.BackgroundTransparency=.06;art.BackgroundColor3=C.ink;art.ClipsDescendants=true
 local ok,handle=pcall(Canvas.Mount,art,id,12)
 if ok and handle then modalArtifacts[#modalArtifacts+1]=handle else
  local fail=text(art,'PREVIEW UNAVAILABLE',13,C.white);rect(fail,5,artSize/2-20,artSize-10,40)
 end
 local crate=Catalog.Crates[item.Category]
 local status=state.Owned[id] and (state.Equipped[item.Category]==id and 'EQUIPPED' or 'OWNED') or 'CRATE CONTENTS'
 local info=text(box,crate.Label..'  /  '..status,13,C.gold);rect(info,18,80+artSize,width-36,27);info.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
 local desc=text(box,item.Description or crate.Description,13,C.muted);rect(desc,20,114+artSize,width-40,48);desc.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
 local caption,callback,off='LOCKED',function() end,true
 if state.Owned[id] then
  local equipped=state.Equipped[item.Category]==id
  caption=equipped and 'UNEQUIP' or item.Type=='KillSound' and 'EQUIP SOUND' or 'EQUIP EFFECT'
  callback=function() stopConfirm();request('Equip',{Category=item.Category,Item=equipped and '' or id}) end
  off=busy or pending~=nil or not state.Ready
 elseif canChoose and has(pool(item.Category).Items,id) then
  local n=#pool(item.Category).Items;local cost=math.ceil(crate.Price*(n+1)/2)
  caption='GUARANTEED  '..cost..' GEMS'
  callback=function() stopConfirm();category=item.Category;selected=id;purchase(true) end
  off=busy or pending~=nil or not state.Ready or not pool(item.Category).CanBuy
 end
 local action=button(box,'EffectAction',caption,C.green,callback,confirmLinks)
 rect(action,20,height-101,width-40,52);action.TextSize=width<380 and 16 or 21;disabled(action,off)
 local done=make('TextButton',box,{Name='BackFromEffect',Text='BACK',TextSize=12,Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold,TextColor3=C.white,
  BackgroundTransparency=1,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(20,height-44),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(width-40,35),ZIndex=box.ZIndex+18})
 link(done.Activated,stopConfirm,confirmLinks)
end

local function collection()

 local crate=Catalog.Crates[cat];local p=pool(cat);local eligible={}
 for _,id in ipairs(p.Items) do eligible[id]=true end
 local back=button(body,'BackToCrates','< CRATES',C.violet,function() category=nil;page=1;render() end)
 rect(back,4,0,122,46);back.TextSize=17
 local title=text(body,crate.Name:upper(),bw<500 and 20 or 28,crate.Color);rect(title,144,0,bw-150,46)
 local odds=text(body,Model.Odds(#p.Items),13,C.gold);rect(odds,6,56,bw-12,34)
 local available=math.max(125,bh-212)
 local s=scroll(body,'CrateContents',0,100,bw,available)
 local ids={};for _,id in ipairs(crate.Items) do ids[#ids+1]=id end
 table.sort(ids,function(a,b) if Catalog.ById[a].Name==Catalog.ById[b].Name then return a<b end;return Catalog.ById[a].Name<Catalog.ById[b].Name end)
 local cols,rows,cw,ch,gap,pageSize=cardLayout(available)

 local index=0
 for i=(page-1)*pageSize+1,math.min(page*pageSize,#ids) do
  local id=ids[i];local item=Catalog.ById[id]
  local f=card(s,'Content_'..id,item.Color,cw,ch);rect(f,6+(index%cols)*(cw+gap),6+math.floor(index/cols)*(ch+gap),cw,ch);index=index+1
  local art=math.min(cw-46,ch-122,192);preview(f,id,(cw-art)/2,18,art,7)
  local title=text(f,item.Name,23,C.white);rect(title,16,ch-98,cw-32,46);title.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
  local st=text(f,state.Owned[id] and 'OWNED' or p.Reserved[id] and 'RESERVED' or eligible[id] and string.format('%.6f%%',100/math.max(1,#p.Items)) or 'NOT AVAILABLE',13,eligible[id] and C.gold or C.muted)
  rect(st,16,ch-49,cw-32,29);st.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
  local hit=make('TextButton',f,{Name='InspectContent_'..id,Text='',BackgroundTransparency=1,Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),ZIndex=f.ZIndex+45,AutoButtonColor=false})
  link(hit.Activated,function() inspectEffect(id,true) end,pageLinks)
 end
 s.CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,math.ceil(index/cols)*(ch+gap)+12)
 pagers(body,bh-104,#ids,pageSize)

 rect(b,6,bh-50,bw-12,48);b.TextSize=19
 disabled(b,busy or pending~=nil or not state.Ready or not state.RandomAllowed or not p.CanBuy)
end

local function inventory()
 local crates,effects=Model.Count(state)
 local filterName='ALL ITEMS';for _,f in ipairs(filters) do if f[1]==inventoryFilter then filterName=f[2] end end
 local choice=button(body,'InventoryFilter',filterName..'  v',C.cyan,filterMenu)

 local label=text(body,tostring(effects)..' effects / '..crates..' crates',bw<450 and 12 or 16,C.muted)
 rect(label,math.min(215,bw*.55)+22,1,bw-math.min(215,bw*.55)-28,48);label.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
 local rows=Model.Inventory(Catalog,state,inventoryFilter)
 local available=math.max(150,bh-119)
 local s=scroll(body,'UnifiedInventoryGrid',0,63,bw,available)
 local cols,gridRows,cw,ch,gap,pageSize=cardLayout(available)
 page=math.clamp(page,1,math.max(1,math.ceil(#rows/pageSize)))
 if focusId then
  for i,row in ipairs(rows) do if row.Id==focusId then page=math.ceil(i/pageSize);break end end
  focusId=nil
 end
 local index=0
 for i=(page-1)*pageSize+1,math.min(page*pageSize,#rows) do
  local row=rows[i];local color=row.Color or C.cyan
  local f=card(s,'Inventory_'..row.Key,row.Equipped and C.green or color,cw,ch)
  rect(f,6+(index%cols)*(cw+gap),6+math.floor(index/cols)*(ch+gap),cw,ch);index=index+1
  local art=math.min(cw-46,ch-138,196)
  if row.Kind=='Crate' then chest(f,row.Category,18,14,cw-36,art+8)
  elseif not row.Missing then preview(f,row.Id,(cw-art)/2,17,art,7)
  else local missing=text(f,'LEGACY EFFECT',18,C.muted);rect(missing,18,40,cw-36,art) end
  local title=text(f,row.Name,23,C.white);rect(title,18,ch-111,cw-36,47);title.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
  if row.Kind=='Crate' then
   local qty=text(f,'SEALED  x'..row.Count,13,C.gold);rect(qty,16,8,cw-32,23)
   local b=button(f,'Open_'..row.Crate.Id,row.RefundOnly and 'REFUND CRATE' or 'OPEN CRATE',C.green,function() storedAction(row.Crate,row.RefundOnly==true) end)
   rect(b,16,ch-56,cw-89,47);b.TextSize=19;disabled(b,busy or pending~=nil or not state.Ready or (not row.RefundOnly and row.Crate.Mode=='Random' and not state.RandomAllowed))
   local more=button(f,'CrateInfo_'..row.Crate.Id,'...',C.cyan,function() storedAction(row.Crate,true) end)

  else
   local b=button(f,'View_'..row.Id,row.Equipped and 'EQUIPPED • VIEW' or 'VIEW EFFECT',row.Equipped and C.green or color,function()
    if not row.Missing then inspectEffect(row.Id,false) else say('This saved effect is missing from the catalog: '..row.Id) end
   end)
   rect(b,16,ch-57,cw-32,47);b.TextSize=19
   local hit=make('TextButton',f,{Name='Inspect_'..row.Id,Text='',BackgroundTransparency=1,Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,-64),ZIndex=f.ZIndex+45,AutoButtonColor=false})
   link(hit.Activated,function() if not row.Missing then inspectEffect(row.Id,false) end end,pageLinks)
  end
 end

 if #rows==0 then
  local title=text(s,not state.Ready and 'LOADING YOUR INVENTORY...' or 'NO ITEMS IN THIS FILTER',22,C.white);rect(title,16,24,bw-32,70);title.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center

  end);rect(b,16,175,bw-32,49)

local function supplemental()
 local s=scroll(body,'GemsAndQuests',0,0,bw,bh)
 local y=6
 local function row(title,description,caption,color,fn,off,isGem)
  local rh=bw<580 and 242 or 190
  local f=card(s,'ShopOffer',color,bw-16,rh);rect(f,6,y,bw-16,rh)
  if isGem then local gem=T.Gem(f,bw<580 and 74 or 86);gem.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,bw<580 and 63 or 31) end
  local x=isGem and (bw<580 and 99 or 112) or 16
  local t=text(f,title,bw<580 and 20 or 27,color);rect(t,bw<580 and 16 or x,12,bw-(bw<580 and 55 or x+39),44)
  local d=text(f,description,bw<580 and 12 or 14,C.white);rect(d,x,60,bw-x-39,bw<580 and 85 or 46)
  local b=button(f,'Offer_'..y,caption,color,fn);rect(b,14,rh-59,bw-44,48);b.TextSize=17;disabled(b,off)
  y=y+rh+18;return b
 end
 if current=='QUESTS' then
  for _,q in ipairs(state.Quests or {}) do
   local allowed=state.Ready and q.Progress>=q.Target and not q.Claimed
   row(q.Title:upper(),q.Progress..' / '..q.Target..'   •   +'..q.Coins..' COINS   + '..q.Gems..' GEMS',q.Claimed and 'CLAIMED' or allowed and 'CLAIM REWARDS' or 'IN PROGRESS',C.gold,function() request('ClaimQuest',q.Id) end,busy or pending~=nil or not allowed,false)
  end
  if #(state.Quests or {})==0 then row('DAILY QUESTS','Your quest record is loading. Multiplayer quests award Gems.','REFRESH',C.gold,function() request('Sync') end,busy,false) end
 else
  row(fmt(state.Gems)..' GEMS','Gems buy crates for your inventory. Earn them from quests or buy a configured Gem pack.','EARN GEMS • QUESTS',C.cyan,function() current='QUESTS';page=1;render() end,false,true)
  if #(state.Products or {})==0 then
   row('GEM PACKS','Robux packs are not configured for this experience. Quest Gems still work.','VIEW QUESTS',C.violet,function() current='QUESTS';render() end,false,true)
  end
  for _,offer in ipairs(state.Products or {}) do
   local offerKey=offer.Key;local productId=offer.ProductId
   local cache=prices[productId]
   local caption=cache and cache.Price and ('BUY • R$ '..cache.Price) or cache and cache.Failed and 'PRICE UNAVAILABLE' or 'LOADING PRICE...'
   row(fmt(offer.Gems)..' GEMS • '..offer.Name, 'Added to your saved Gem balance after Roblox confirms your purchase.',caption,C.cyan,function() request('GemPrompt',offerKey) end,busy or pending~=nil or not state.Ready or not(cache and cache.Price),true)
   if not cache then
    prices[productId]={Loading=true}
    task.spawn(function()
     local ok,info=pcall(Marketplace.GetProductInfoAsync,Marketplace,productId,Enum.InfoType.Product)
     prices[productId]=ok and type(info)=='table' and type(info.PriceInRobux)=='number' and {Price=info.PriceInRobux} or {Failed=true}
     if alive and backdrop.Visible and current=='GEMS' then render() end
    end)
   end
  end
 end
 s.CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,y+6)
end
render=function()
 if not alive then return end
 clearBody();fit()
 local accent=({CRATES=C.violet,INVENTORY=C.gold,EFFECTS=C.green,GEMS=C.cyan,QUESTS=C.gold})[current] or C.cyan
 heading.Text=({CRATES='CRATES',INVENTORY='MY INVENTORY',GEMS='GEMS',QUESTS='QUESTS'})[current]
 gemsButton.Text=state.Ready and (fmt(state.Gems)..' GEMS +') or 'GEMS +'
 heading.TextColor3=accent
 balance.Text=state.Ready and (fmt(state.Coins)..' COINS     •     '..fmt(state.Gems)..' GEMS') or 'CONNECTING TO YOUR SAVED PROFILE...'
 for name,b in pairs(tabs) do b:SetAttribute('HussSelected',(name=='ROBUX' and current=='GEMS') or name==current) end
 resume.Visible=pending~=nil;disabled(resume,busy)
 if not loaded then local t=text(body,'LOADING YOUR COLLECTIONS...',24,C.white);rect(t,20,50,bw-40,90);return end
 if not backdrop.Visible then return end
 if current=='CRATES' and not category then overview()
 elseif current=='CRATES' then collection()
 elseif current=='INVENTORY' then inventory()
 else supplemental() end
end
revealReceipt=function(receipt,demo)
 if not loaded or not Catalog.Get(receipt.Item) then return end
 generation=generation+1;local g=generation
 local oldTab,oldCategory,oldSelected,oldPage=current,category,selected,page
 backdrop.Visible=false;clearBody()
 Reveal.Play(receipt,function()
  if not alive or g~=generation or me:GetAttribute('InRound')==true then return end
  if demo then current,category,selected,page=oldTab,oldCategory,oldSelected,oldPage
  else current='INVENTORY';category=nil;inventoryFilter='All';selected=receipt.Item;focusId=receipt.Item;page=1 end
  backdrop.Visible=true;me:SetAttribute('HABCollectionOpen',true);render();request('Sync')
 end,demo)
end
request=function(action,payload)
 if not loaded or busy or not alive then return end
 if pending and action~=pending.Action and action~='Sync' then say('Resume your pending transaction first.');return end
 busy=true;serial=serial+1;local token=serial;local g=generation
 if action~='Sync' then stopConfirm();say('Saving your change...');render() end
 task.delay(25,function()
  if alive and busy and token==serial then busy=false;serial=serial+1;render();say(pending and 'Save/connection delayed. RESUME keeps the same transaction ID.' or 'Connection delayed. Try again.') end
 end)
 task.spawn(function()
  local ok,result=pcall(API.InvokeServer,API,action,payload)
  if not alive or token~=serial then return end
  busy=false
  if not ok or type(result)~='table' then render();say('Connection interrupted. Use RESUME for a pending transaction.');return end
  local before=viewKey(state)
  if type(result.Profile)=='table' then
   state=Model.Accept(state,result.Profile)
  end
  if pending and action==pending.Action and result.Pending~=true and (result.Profile or result.Receipt) then pending=nil end
  if result.OK and result.Receipt and result.Receipt.Kind=='Buy' then current='INVENTORY';category=nil;inventoryFilter='All';page=1 end
  if action~='Sync' or viewKey(state)~=before then render() end
  if action~='Sync' or result.OK~=true then say(result.Message or 'Your inventory is ready.') end
  if action=='GemPrompt' and result.OK and type(result.ProductId)=='number' then
   local good,err=pcall(Marketplace.PromptProductPurchase,Marketplace,me,result.ProductId)
   if not good then say('Roblox purchase window unavailable: '..tostring(err)) end
  end
  local receipt=result.OK and result.Receipt
  if receipt and receipt.Kind=='Open' and Catalog.Get(receipt.Item) and not shown[receipt.Token] then
   if g==generation and backdrop.Visible and me:GetAttribute('InRound')~=true then shown[receipt.Token]=true;revealReceipt(receipt,false)
   else say('Opening completed. Your effect is in INVENTORY.') end
  end
 end)
end

end

 X.Action:FireServer(kind,{Seq=seq,Direction=aim,At=now})

HUD=require(X:WaitForChild('HABCombatHUD'))(send)
local function restore(p)
 for _,j in ipairs(p.Joints) do
  if j.Object.Parent and j.Applied and j.Object.Transform==j.Applied then j.Object.Transform=j.Before end
  j.Applied=nil
 end
end
pose=function(actor,stamp,kind,seq)
 local c=char(actor);if not c then return end
 local h=c:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid');if not h or h.Health<=0 then return end
 if poses[c] then restore(poses[c]) end
 local left=kind=='Swing' and (seq or 1)%2==0
 local joints={}
 for _,o in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
  local motor=o:IsA('Motor6D');local constraint=o:IsA('AnimationConstraint')
  if motor or constraint then
   local connected=motor and o.Part1 or (constraint and o.Attachment1 and o.Attachment1.Parent)
   local basis=motor and o.C0 or (constraint and o.Attachment0 and o.Attachment0.CFrame)
   if connected and basis then
    local name=o.Name:lower():gsub('%s','')
    local side=left and 'left' or 'right'
    local role=name:find(side..'shoulder',1,true) and 'Shoulder' or name:find(side..'elbow',1,true) and 'Elbow'
    if not role and constraint then
     local limb=left and 'Left' or 'Right'
     role=connected.Name==limb..'UpperArm' and 'Shoulder' or connected.Name==limb..'LowerArm' and 'Elbow'
    end
    if role then joints[#joints+1]={Object=o,Role=role,Axes=basis.Rotation} end
   end
  end
 end
 poses[c]={At=stamp,Kind=kind,Seq=seq,Joints=joints,Humanoid=h,Side=left and -1 or 1}
end
link(Run.PreAnimation,function() for _,p in pairs(poses) do restore(p) end end)
link(Run.PreSimulation,function()
 local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
 for c,p in pairs(poses) do
  local age=now-p.At;local total=p.Kind=='Swing' and Config.Swing.Cooldown or .48
  if not c.Parent or p.Humanoid.Health<=0 or age>total then restore(p);poses[c]=nil
  else
   local wind=Config.Swing.Windup
   local strike=math.clamp((age-wind)/.13,0,1)
   local recovery=1-math.clamp((age-wind-.17)/math.max(.05,total-wind-.17),0,1)
   local entry=math.clamp(age/math.max(.02,wind),0,1)
   local weight=entry*recovery
   for _,j in ipairs(p.Joints) do
    local joint=j.Object
    if joint.Parent then
     local turn
     if j.Role=='Elbow' then turn=CFrame.Angles(-.75*(1-strike)*weight,0,0)
     elseif p.Kind=='Throw' then turn=CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-110+75*strike)*weight,.18*weight,-.2*weight)
     else turn=CFrame.Angles((-.38-.85*strike)*weight,(-.35+.95*strike)*p.Side*weight,(.5-1.1*strike)*p.Side*weight) end
     j.Before=joint.Transform
     local delta=j.Axes:Inverse()*turn*j.Axes
     j.Applied=j.Before:Lerp(CFrame.identity,.65*weight)*delta
     joint.Transform=j.Applied
    end
   end
  end
 end
end)
local function removeProjectile(id)
 local m=missiles[id];if not m then return end
 for _,entry in ipairs(m.Hidden or {}) do if entry.Object.Parent then entry.Object[entry.Property]=entry.Value end end
 m.Part:Destroy();missiles[id]=nil
end
local function newProjectile(e)
 local p=Instance.new('Part');p.Name='CosmeticThrownBomb';p.Size=Vector3.new(2.25,2.25,2.25);p.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball
 p.Anchored=true;p.CanCollide=false;p.CanQuery=false;p.CanTouch=false;p.Color=Color3.fromRGB(28,30,39);p.CFrame=CFrame.new(e.Origin);p.Parent=folder
 local skin=Skins.ById[e.Skin] or Skins.ById[Skins.Defaults.Bombs]
 pcall(BombSkins.Apply,p,skin,{Preview=true})
 local locals={}
 for _,o in ipairs(p:GetDescendants()) do if o:IsA('BasePart') then locals[#locals+1]={o,p.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(o.CFrame)} end end
 local hidden={};local c=char(e.Actor);local carried=c and c:FindFirstChild('ActiveBomb')
 if carried then
  local function hide(o)
   local property=o:IsA('BasePart') and 'LocalTransparencyModifier' or o:IsA('BillboardGui') and 'Enabled' or nil
   if property then hidden[#hidden+1]={Object=o,Property=property,Value=o[property]};o[property]=property=='LocalTransparencyModifier' and 1 or false end
  end
  hide(carried);for _,o in ipairs(carried:GetDescendants()) do hide(o) end
 end
 missiles[e.Id]={Part=p,Locals=locals,Event=e,At=e.Time,FXAt=0,Hidden=hidden}
end
local function applyLocalAbility(e,c,r)
 if e.Actor~=me or e.Character~=c then return end
 local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
 if (e.Mechanic or e.Ability)=='Speed' and type(e.Until)=='number' and now<e.Until then
  -- This is the existing movement controller's modifier, populated ONLY after server approval.
  c:SetAttribute('HABSpeedUntil',e.Until);c:SetAttribute('HABSpeedBonus',math.clamp(tonumber(e.Bonus) or 6,0,6))
 elseif (e.Mechanic or e.Ability)=='Leap' and e.LaunchOnClient and e.Id~=lastLeap and now-e.Time<.65 then
  local h=c:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
  if not h or h.Health<=0 or r.Anchored or h.Sit then return end
  lastLeap=e.Id
  -- One owner-applied launch. Ordinary Jumping stays disabled; no server/client double impulse.
  h:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
  local v=r.AssemblyLinearVelocity
  r.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new(v.X,math.clamp(tonumber(e.Velocity) or 72,30,85),v.Z)
 end
end
link(X.FX.OnClientEvent,function(e)
 if type(e)~='table' or type(e.Kind)~='string' then return end
 if e.Kind=='ActionReply' then
  HUD.Reply(e)
  if type(e.ReadyAt)=='number' then nextLocal[e.Action]=e.ReadyAt elseif e.OK~=true then nextLocal[e.Action]=0 end
  if e.OK~=true and e.Action=='Swing' then
   local p=poses[me.Character]
   if p and p.Seq==e.Request then restore(p);poses[me.Character]=nil end
  end
  return
 end
 if e.Kind=='Notice' then HUD.Notice(tostring(e.Message or ''));return end
 if type(e.Time)~='number' or math.abs(workspace:GetServerTimeNow()-e.Time)>3 then return end
 if e.Kind=='ThrowEnd' then removeProjectile(e.Id);return end
 if e.Kind=='SwingEnd' then
  if e.Actor==me and e.Result~='HIT' and e.Result~='CANCELLED' then
   HUD.Notice(e.Result=='BLOCKED' and 'BLOCKED' or e.Result=='DODGED' and 'DODGED' or 'MISS',nil,.42)
  end
  return
 end
 if e.Kind=='TagHit' and e.Actor==me then HUD.Hit() end
 local c=char(e.Actor);local r=c and c:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
 if not r then return end
 -- Gameplay acknowledgements must run even when VFX are reduced, unavailable, or out of view.
 if e.Kind=='Ability' then applyLocalAbility(e,c,r) end
 local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera
 if not cam or ((r.Position-cam.CFrame.Position).Magnitude>180 and e.Actor~=me) then return end
 if e.Kind=='Swing' then
  if not(e.Actor==me and e.Request and predicted[e.Request]) then swingVisual(e.Actor,e.Time,e.Request or e.Id) end
 elseif e.Kind=='Throw' then pose(e.Actor,e.Time,'Throw',e.Request);sound('Throw',r);newProjectile(e)
 elseif e.Kind=='TagHit' then play('combat_00107',e.Position,3.2)
 elseif e.Kind=='ShieldBlock' then play('combat_00094',e.Position,4.7)
 elseif e.Kind=='Ability' then
  sound('Ability',r);play(e.Effect,r,e.Ability=='Shield' and 5.8 or 4.5,Vector3.new(0,-.5,0),true)
  if e.Ability=='Shield' and not low() then
   local orb=Instance.new('Part');orb.Name='PhaseGuardCosmetic';orb.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball;orb.Size=Vector3.new(6,6,6);orb.Material=Enum.Material.ForceField;orb.Transparency=.72
   orb.Color=Color3.fromRGB(94,226,255);orb.Anchored=true;orb.CanCollide=false;orb.CanTouch=false;orb.CanQuery=false;orb.Parent=folder
   shields[#shields+1]={Part=orb,Root=r,Character=c,Until=e.Until or e.Time+e.Duration}
  end
 end
end)
local function action(name,state)
 if state~=Enum.UserInputState.Begin or Input:GetFocusedTextBox() then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
 if name=='HABAbility' then
  if me:GetAttribute('InRound')~=true then openAbilityMenu() else send('Ability') end
 else send('Throw') end
 return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
end

CAS:BindActionAtPriority('HABThrow',action,false,2100,Enum.KeyCode.R,Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR1)

end)

link(Run.RenderStepped,function()
 local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
 if queued then
  local q=queued
  if q.Character~=me.Character or now>q.End then queued=nil
  elseif now>=q.At then queued=nil;send('Swing',true) end
 end
 for id,p in pairs(predicted) do if now-p.At>2 then predicted[id]=nil end end
 for id,m in pairs(missiles) do
  local e=m.Event;local age=now-e.Time
  if age>e.Duration+.25 or not m.Part.Parent then removeProjectile(id)
  else
   local pos=Rules.Projectile(e.Origin,e.Velocity,e.Gravity,math.max(0,age))
   m.Part.CFrame=CFrame.new(pos)*CFrame.Angles(age*12,age*8,0)
   for _,o in ipairs(m.Locals) do if o[1].Parent then o[1].CFrame=m.Part.CFrame*o[2] end end
   if not low() and now>m.FXAt then m.FXAt=now+.16;play(e.Effect,pos,2.2) end
  end
 end
 for i=#shields,1,-1 do
  local s=shields[i]
  if not s.Root.Parent or now>s.Until or (s.Character:GetAttribute('HABShieldCharge') or 0)==0 or low() then s.Part:Destroy();table.remove(shields,i)
  else s.Part.CFrame=s.Root.CFrame;s.Part.Transparency=.72+math.sin(now*7)*.045 end
 end
end)

local function clearPose(c)

 restore(p)
