 poses[c]=nil
end
local function dodging(c,now)
 local weave=c:GetAttribute('HABWeavePoseUntil')
 local weaveStart=c:GetAttribute('HABWeavePoseStartedAt')
 local record=dodgeState[c]
 if not record then record={Id=nil,Until=0,Started=0};dodgeState[c]=record end
 local id=c:GetAttribute('MovementActionId')
 if id~=record.Id then
  record.Id=id
  local action=c:GetAttribute('MovementAction')
  if action=='DiveEnd' then record.Until=0;record.Started=0
  elseif type(action)=='string' and action:sub(1,4)=='Dive' then
   record.Until=type(weave)=='number' and weave or now+.72
   record.Started=type(weaveStart)=='number' and weaveStart or record.Until-.72
  end
 end
 if type(weave)=='number' and weave>now then
  record.Until=weave;record.Started=type(weaveStart)=='number' and weaveStart or weave-.72
 end
 return now<record.Until
end
local function blocked(c,h,r,now,options,stamp)
 if not c.Parent or not h.Parent or h.Health<=0 or not r.Parent or r.Anchored or h.Sit or h.PlatformStand
  or c:GetAttribute('Ragdolled')==true or c:GetAttribute('IsRagdoll')==true then return true end
 local state=h:GetState()
 if state==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead or state==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or state==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll then return true end
 local owner=Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(c)
 local weaveActive=dodging(c,now)
 if weaveActive and options and options.Authoritative then
  local untilAt=tonumber(c:GetAttribute('HABWeavePoseUntil')) or (dodgeState[c] and dodgeState[c].Until) or 0
  local started=tonumber(c:GetAttribute('HABWeavePoseStartedAt')) or (dodgeState[c] and dodgeState[c].Started) or untilAt-.72
  weaveActive=(options.AcceptedAt or stamp or 0)<started
 end
 return weaveActive or c:GetAttribute('HussGamePaused')==true or workspace:GetAttribute('HussGamePaused')==true
  or (owner and (owner:GetAttribute('HussEmotePlaying')~=nil or owner:GetAttribute('HussGamePaused')==true))
end
pose=function(actor,stamp,kind,seq,options)
 local c=char(actor);if not c then return end
 local h=c:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid');local r=c:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
 local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
 if not h or not r or blocked(c,h,r,now,options,stamp) then return end
 local name,mirror=Animations.Resolve(kind,seq);if not name then return end

 if kind=='Swing' then options.Duration=Config.Swing.Cooldown;options.Contact=Config.Swing.Windup end
 local duration=Animations.Duration(name,options)
 if now-stamp>=duration then return end
 local previous=poses[c]
 if previous and Animations.Clips[previous.Name].Priority>Animations.Clips[name].Priority and previous.Until>now then return end
 clearPose(c)
 local p={Name=name,Kind=kind,Seq=seq,At=stamp,Until=stamp+duration,Options=options,Joints={},Seen={},Feet={},Humanoid=h,Root=r,R15=h.RigType==Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15}
 local function add(joint)
  if p.Seen[joint] then return end
  local info=Animations.JointInfo(joint)
  if info then
   p.Seen[joint]=true;p.Joints[#p.Joints+1]=info
   if info.Role=='root' and joint.Part0==r then p.RootJoint=joint end
   if info.Role=='leftAnkle' or info.Role=='rightAnkle' or not p.R15 and (info.Role=='leftHip' or info.Role=='rightHip') then p.Feet[#p.Feet+1]=joint.Part1 end
  end
 end
 for _,joint in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do add(joint) end
 p.Descendant=c.DescendantAdded:Connect(add)
 poses[c]=p;c:SetAttribute('HABActionPoseUntil',p.Until);c:SetAttribute('HABActionPoseName',name)
 c:SetAttribute('HABActionPoseStartedAt',options.AcceptedAt or stamp)
end

link(Run.PreSimulation,function()
 local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
 for c,p in pairs(poses) do
  local sample=Animations.Sample(p.Name,now-p.At,p.Options)
  if not sample or blocked(c,p.Humanoid,p.Root,now,p.Options,p.At) then clearPose(c)
  else
   local v=p.Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
   local moving=Vector3.new(v.X,0,v.Z).Magnitude>2
   local bases,targets={},{}
   for _,j in ipairs(p.Joints) do
    local joint=j.Object
    if joint.Parent and joint.Enabled then
     local weight=Animations.Weight(sample,j.Role,moving,low())*(p.Options.Strength or 1)
     local turn=Animations.Transform(sample,j.Role,p.R15,low())
     local target=j.Axes:Inverse()*turn*j.Axes
     bases[joint]=joint.Transform;targets[joint]=joint.Transform:Lerp(target,weight)
    end
   end
   local mode=p.Humanoid:GetState();local rootJoint=p.RootJoint
   if rootJoint and targets[rootJoint] and math.abs(v.Y)<4 and mode~=Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall and mode~=Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
    local baseline=Animations.FootHeight(p.Joints,p.Root,bases,p.Feet)
    local posed=Animations.FootHeight(p.Joints,p.Root,targets,p.Feet)
    if baseline and posed then
     local lift=math.clamp(baseline-posed,-.65,.65)
     local localUp=rootJoint.C0.Rotation:Inverse():VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0,lift,0))
     targets[rootJoint]=CFrame.new(localUp)*targets[rootJoint]
    end
   end
   for _,j in ipairs(p.Joints) do
    if targets[j.Object] then j.Before=bases[j.Object];j.Applied=targets[j.Object];j.Object.Transform=j.Applied end
   end
  end
 end
end)
-- Original Swing/TagHit packets do not include a Character identity. A respawn
-- timestamp rejects delayed previous-life packets without requiring a server protocol change.
local playerLinks={}
local function watchPlayer(p)
 if playerLinks[p] then return end
 if p.Character then born[p.Character]=-math.huge end
 local added=p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) born[c]=workspace:GetServerTimeNow() end)
 local removed=p.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(c) clearPose(c) end)
 playerLinks[p]={added,removed}
end
local function unwatchPlayer(p)
 local list=playerLinks[p];if list then for _,connection in ipairs(list) do connection:Disconnect() end end
 playerLinks[p]=nil
 if p.Character then clearPose(p.Character) end
end
link(Players.PlayerAdded,watchPlayer);link(Players.PlayerRemoving,unwatchPlayer)
for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do watchPlayer(p) end

 local c=char(actor)

 return c
end

   if property then hidden[#hidden+1]={Object=o,Property=property,Value=o[property]};o[property]=property=='LocalTransparencyModifier' and 1 or false end
  end
  hide(carried);for _,o in ipairs(carried:GetDescendants()) do hide(o) end
 end
 missiles[e.Id]={Part=p,Locals=locals,Event=e,At=e.Time,FXAt=0,Hidden=hidden}
end
local function applyLocalAbility(e,c,r)
 if e.Actor~=me or e.Character~=c then return end
 local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
 if (e.Mechanic or e.Ability)=='Speed' and type(e.Until)=='number' and now<e.Until then
  -- This is the existing movement controller's modifier, populated ONLY after server approval.
  c:SetAttribute('HABSpeedUntil',e.Until);c:SetAttribute('HABSpeedBonus',math.clamp(tonumber(e.Bonus) or 6,0,6))
 elseif (e.Mechanic or e.Ability)=='Leap' and e.LaunchOnClient and e.Id~=lastLeap and now-e.Time<.65 then
  local h=c:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
  if not h or h.Health<=0 or r.Anchored or h.Sit then return end
  lastLeap=e.Id
  -- One owner-applied launch. Ordinary Jumping stays disabled; no server/client double impulse.
  h:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
  local v=r.AssemblyLinearVelocity
  r.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new(v.X,math.clamp(tonumber(e.Velocity) or 72,30,85),v.Z)
 end
end
link(X.FX.OnClientEvent,function(e)
 if type(e)~='table' or type(e.Kind)~='string' then return end
 if e.Kind=='ActionReply' then
  HUD.Reply(e)
  if type(e.ReadyAt)=='number' then nextLocal[e.Action]=e.ReadyAt elseif e.OK~=true then nextLocal[e.Action]=0 end
  if e.OK~=true then
   local p=poses[me.Character]
   if p and p.Seq==e.Request then clearPose(me.Character) end
   predicted[e.Request]=nil
  end
  return
 end
 if e.Kind=='Notice' then HUD.Notice(tostring(e.Message or ''));return end
 if type(e.Time)~='number' or math.abs(workspace:GetServerTimeNow()-e.Time)>3 then return end
 if e.Kind=='ThrowEnd' then removeProjectile(e.Id);return end
 if e.Kind=='SwingEnd' then
  if e.Actor==me and e.Result~='HIT' and e.Result~='CANCELLED' then
   HUD.Notice(e.Result=='BLOCKED' and 'BLOCKED' or e.Result=='DODGED' and 'DODGED' or 'MISS',nil,.42)
  end
  return
 end
 if e.Kind=='TagHit' and e.Actor==me then HUD.Hit() end
 if e.Id~=nil then
  local token=e.Kind..':'..tostring(e.Id)
  if seenEvents[token] then return end
  seenEvents[token]=true;seenOrder[#seenOrder+1]=token
  if #seenOrder>256 then seenEvents[table.remove(seenOrder,1)]=nil end
 end
 local c=currentLife(e.Actor,e.Time,e.Character);local r=c and c:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
 if not r then return end
 -- Gameplay acknowledgements must run even when VFX are reduced, unavailable, or out of view.
 if e.Kind=='Ability' then applyLocalAbility(e,c,r) end
 local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera
 if not cam or ((r.Position-cam.CFrame.Position).Magnitude>180 and e.Actor~=me) then return end
 local prediction=e.Actor==me and e.Request and predicted[e.Request]
 if prediction and prediction.Character~=c then prediction=nil end
 local predictedPose=prediction and poses[c] and poses[c].Seq==e.Request and poses[c]
 if predictedPose then
  predictedPose.Options.Authoritative=true;predictedPose.Options.AcceptedAt=e.Time
  c:SetAttribute('HABActionPoseStartedAt',e.Time)
 end
 local accepted={Authoritative=true,AcceptedAt=e.Time}
 if e.Kind=='Swing' then
  if not(predictedPose and prediction.Kind=='Swing') then swingVisual(e.Actor,e.Time,e.Request or e.Id,accepted) end
 elseif e.Kind=='Throw' then
  accepted.Contact=.06
  if not(predictedPose and prediction.Kind=='Throw') then pose(e.Actor,e.Time-.06,'Throw',e.Request,accepted) end
  sound('Throw',r);newProjectile(e)
 elseif e.Kind=='TagHit' then
  if e.Target and currentLife(e.Target,e.Time) then pose(e.Target,e.Time,'Hit',e.Id,accepted) end
 elseif e.Kind=='ShieldBlock' then
  -- Original server sends Actor=defender and Position only. Never infer an attacker.
  pose(e.Actor,e.Time,'Block',e.Id,accepted)
 elseif e.Kind=='Ability' then
  if not(predictedPose and prediction.Kind=='Ability' and prediction.Ability==e.Ability) then pose(e.Actor,e.Time,e.Ability,e.Request,accepted) end
  sound('Ability',r)
  -- HABFunAbilityFXV16 owns every ability effect and shield shell once.
 end
end)

local function rect(o,x,y,w,h) o.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y);o.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(w,h) end

local function button(p,name,value,color,fn,bucket)

end

local function apiPrice(key,id)
 if id<=0 then return 'NOT CONFIGURED',false end
 local p=prices[id]
 if p then return p.Price and ('R$ '..p.Price) or p.Failed and 'UNAVAILABLE' or 'LOADING...',p.Price~=nil end
 prices[id]={}
 task.spawn(function()
  local ok,info=pcall(Market.GetProductInfoAsync,Market,id,Enum.InfoType.GamePass)
  prices[id]=ok and type(info)=='table' and info.IsForSale and type(info.PriceInRobux)=='number' and {Price=info.PriceInRobux} or {Failed=true}
  if not dead and backdrop.Visible then render() end
 end)
 return 'LOADING...',false
end
local function preview(p,id,x,y,w,h,ability)
 local frame=make('Frame',p,{BackgroundColor3=C.ink,BackgroundTransparency=.05,BorderSizePixel=0,ClipsDescendants=true,ZIndex=p.ZIndex+16})
 rect(frame,x,y,w,h);T.Rounded(frame,10)
 local ok,handle=pcall(FX.Mount,frame,id,6,ability and {Ability=true} or nil)
 if ok and handle then previews[#previews+1]=handle end
end
local function bombView(p,skin,x,y,w,h)
 local view=make('ViewportFrame',p,{BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,Ambient=Color3.fromRGB(175,185,209),LightColor=C.white,LightDirection=Vector3.new(-1,-1,-1),ZIndex=p.ZIndex+16})

 local world=make('WorldModel',view);local cam=make('Camera',view,{FieldOfView=35,CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(5,3.5,7),Vector3.new(0,.35,0))});view.CurrentCamera=cam
 local model=make('Model',world);local ball=make('Part',model,{Name='Bomb',Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball,Size=Vector3.new(2.25,2.25,2.25),Anchored=true,CanCollide=false,CFrame=CFrame.identity})
 Builder.Apply(ball,Skins.ById[skin],{Preview=true});model.PrimaryPart=ball
 views[#views+1]=model
end
request=function(action,key)
 if busy then return end;busy=true
 task.spawn(function()
  local ok,res=pcall(X.Api.InvokeServer,X.Api,action,key)
  busy=false;if dead then return end
  if ok and type(res)=='table' then
   if res.Profile then state=res.Profile end
   notice.Text=res.Message or ''
   if res.OK and res.PassId then
    local passOk,why=pcall(Market.PromptGamePassPurchase,Market,me,res.PassId)
    if not passOk then notice.Text='Purchase prompt unavailable: '..tostring(why) end
   end
  else notice.Text='Connection interrupted. Try again.' end
  if backdrop.Visible then render() end
 end)
end

local function loadTrack(name, id, primary)
    local asset = Instance.new("Animation")
    asset.Name = "HAB_" .. name
    asset.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. id
    local ok, track = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(asset) end)
    asset:Destroy()

        warn("[HAB Motion] " .. name .. " " .. id .. ": " .. tostring(track))
        return

    if not running then releaseTrack(track); return end
    track.Looped = true
    track.Priority = (name == "Idle" or name == "Sit") and Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle or Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement
    records[name][primary and "primary" or "fallback"] = track

    end

    local row = records[name]
    if not row then return nil end
    if row.primary and row.primary.Length > 0 then return row.primary end
    if row.fallback and row.fallback.Length > 0 then return row.fallback end
    return nil

    current, currentName, currentRate = nil, nil, nil
end

    local track = choose(name) or choose("Idle")
    if not track then return end
    if current ~= track or not track.IsPlaying then
        stop(); current, currentName = track, name
        track:Play(0.16, 1, rate); currentRate = rate
        character:SetAttribute("HABAnimationState", name)
    elseif not currentRate or math.abs(rate - currentRate) > 0.025 then
        track:AdjustSpeed(rate); currentRate = rate
    end
end

    if action == "DiveEnd" then dodgeUntil = 0
    elseif type(action) == "string" and action:sub(1,4) == "Dive" then
        dodgeUntil = os.clock() + 0.72
    end

    local state = humanoid:GetState()
    if humanoid.PlatformStand or character:GetAttribute("Ragdolled") == true
        or character:GetAttribute("IsRagdoll") == true or state == HS.Physics
        or state == HS.Ragdoll or state == HS.Dead then stop(); return end
    -- Emotes and DodgeWeaveV5 own their own visual pose; do not fight them.
    if player:GetAttribute("HussEmotePlaying") ~= nil
        or (workspace:GetAttribute("HussDodgeV5") == true and os.clock() < dodgeUntil) then
        stop(); return
    end
    if root.Anchored then play("Idle",1); return end
    if state == HS.Climbing then
        play("Climb", math.clamp(math.abs(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y) / 10, 0, 1.8)); return
    end
    if humanoid.Sit or state == HS.Seated then play("Sit",1); return end
    if state == HS.Freefall or state == HS.FallingDown or state == HS.Jumping then
        play("Fall",1); return
    end
    local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    local speed = Vector3.new(velocity.X,0,velocity.Z).Magnitude
    local moving = humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.035 and speed > 0.7
    if not moving then play("Idle",1)
    elseif character:GetAttribute("MovementState") == "Sprint" or speed > 27 then
        play("Run", math.clamp(speed / (r6 and 32 or 28), 0.65, 1.8))
    else play("Walk", math.clamp(speed / (r6 and 24 or 16), 0.65, 1.65)) end
end

    for _, c in ipairs(links) do c:Disconnect() end
    stop()
    for _, record in pairs(records) do
        releaseTrack(record.primary); releaseTrack(record.fallback)
    end
end)

local function flashDamage()
	local flash = Instance.new("Frame")
	flash.Size = UDim2.new(1, 20, 1, 20)
	flash.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
	flash.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	flash.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
	flash.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
	flash.BorderSizePixel = 0
	flash.ZIndex = 20
	flash.Parent = container

	TweenService:Create(flash, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1
	}):Play()
	game.Debris:AddItem(flash, 0.35)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- SHAKE EFFECT (position + rotation, decaying)
-- Shadow + text-shadow are children of container, so they
-- shake automatically — no manual syncing needed anymore.
------------------------------------------------------------
local shakeConnection = nil

local function shakeUI()
	if shakeConnection then
		shakeConnection:Disconnect()
		shakeConnection = nil
	end

	local duration = 0.35
	local elapsed = 0
	local posMagnitude = 10
	local rotMagnitude = 8

	shakeConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		elapsed += dt
		if elapsed >= duration then
			container.Position = basePosition
			container.Rotation = 0
			if shakeConnection then
				shakeConnection:Disconnect()
				shakeConnection = nil
			end
			return
		end

		local decay = 1 - (elapsed / duration)
		local offsetX = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * posMagnitude * decay
		local offsetY = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * posMagnitude * decay
		local rot = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * rotMagnitude * decay

		container.Position = basePosition + UDim2.new(0, offsetX, 0, offsetY)
		container.Rotation = rot
	end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- HEALTH UPDATE LOGIC
------------------------------------------------------------
local lastHealth = 100

local function updateHealth(humanoid)
	local health = math.max(humanoid.Health, 0)
	local maxHealth = math.max(humanoid.MaxHealth, 1)
	local pct = health / maxHealth

	local filledCount = math.ceil(pct * SEGMENT_COUNT)

	for i, seg in ipairs(segments) do
		if i <= filledCount and health > 0 then
			local color
			if pct > 0.5 then
				color = Color3.fromRGB(230, 40, 40)
			elseif pct > 0.25 then
				color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 30)
			else
				color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
			end
			seg.BackgroundColor3 = color
		else
			seg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
		end
	end

	percentLabel.Text = math.floor(pct * 100) .. "%"
	percentShadow.Text = percentLabel.Text

	local heartColor = pct <= 0.25 and Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90) or Color3.fromRGB(230, 40, 40)
	for _, px in ipairs(heartCells) do
		px.BackgroundColor3 = heartColor
	end

	if health < lastHealth then
		flashDamage()
		shakeUI()
	end

	lastHealth = health
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- CONNECTION MANAGEMENT
------------------------------------------------------------
local healthConnection = nil

local function onCharacterAdded(char)
	if healthConnection then
		healthConnection:Disconnect()
		healthConnection = nil
	end

	local humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	lastHealth = humanoid.Health

	healthConnection = humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function()
		updateHealth(humanoid)
	end)

	updateHealth(humanoid)
end

if player.Character then

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS        = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local Player  = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera  = workspace.CurrentCamera

local Character = Player.Character or Player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local Humanoid  = Character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local RootPart  = Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

-- =============================================
-- CONFIG
-- =============================================
local CONFIG = {
	-- Walk bob
	WalkBobHeight    = 0.009,   -- up/down amount while walking
	WalkBobSide      = 0.05,   -- left/right amount while walking
	WalkBobFreq      = 7,      -- steps per second while walking

	-- Run bob
	RunBobHeight     = 0.009,   -- up/down amount while running
	RunBobSide       = 0.05,   -- left/right amount while running
	RunBobFreq       = 15,     -- steps per second while running

	-- Crouch bob
	CrouchBobHeight  = 0.009,
	CrouchBobSide    = 0.05,
	CrouchBobFreq    = 5,

	-- Idle sway (breathing effect)
	IdleSwayHeight   = 0.012,  -- very subtle up/down while idle
	IdleSwayFreq     = 0.9,    -- slow breathing rate

	-- Pitch tilt from bobbing (looks like head nodding)
	BobPitchScale    = 0.6,    -- how much the camera pitches with Y bob
	BobRollScale     = 0.8,    -- how much the camera rolls with X bob

	-- Strafe sway (camera leans when moving sideways)
	StrafeSway       = 0.06,   -- how much camera rolls when strafing
	MaxStrafeSway    = 0.08,

	-- Mouse look tilt (camera rolls slightly when turning)
	MouseTilt        = 0.18,
	MaxMouseTilt     = 3.5,    -- max degrees

	-- Landing impact
	LandingBob       = 0.18,   -- how far camera dips on landing
	LandingDuration  = 0.25,   -- seconds to recover from landing

	-- Smoothing (lower = smoother but slower)
	BobSmoothing     = 0.14,
	IdleSmoothing    = 0.025,
	SwaySmoothing    = 0.10,
	TiltSmoothing    = 0.18,
	ReturnSmoothing  = 0.08,   -- how fast bob returns to 0 when stopping

	-- Sprint speed threshold (match your crouch script CONFIG.SprintSpeed)
	SprintThreshold  = 20,
}

-- =============================================
-- STATE
-- =============================================
local bobTimer   = 0   -- accumulates time, drives the sin/cos wave

-- Current smoothed values
local curBobY    = 0
local curBobX    = 0
local curIdleY   = 0
local curRollB   = 0   -- roll from bobbing
local curPitch   = 0   -- pitch from bobbing
local curStrafeSway = 0
local curMouseTilt  = 0

-- Landing impact state
local landingOffset  = 0
local wasOnGround    = true
local landingTimer   = 0

local function lerp(a, b, t)
	return a + (b - a) * t
end

local function sign(x)
	return x > 0 and 1 or (x < 0 and -1 or 0)
end

-- =============================================
-- MAIN LOOP
-- =============================================
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	if not RootPart or not Humanoid then return end
	if Humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end

	dt = math.min(dt, 0.1) -- clamp dt so nothing explodes on lag

	local vel        = RootPart.Velocity
	local horizSpeed = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z).Magnitude
	local isOnGround = Humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
	local isCrouching = RootPart:GetAttribute("IsCrouching") or false
	local isMoving   = horizSpeed > 1.0
	local isSprinting = Humanoid.WalkSpeed >= CONFIG.SprintThreshold

	-- ---- Pick parameters based on state ----
	local targetHeight, targetSide, freq

	if not isMoving or not isOnGround then
		targetHeight = 0
		targetSide   = 0
		freq         = 0
	elseif isCrouching then
		targetHeight = CONFIG.CrouchBobHeight
		targetSide   = CONFIG.CrouchBobSide
		freq         = CONFIG.CrouchBobFreq
	elseif isSprinting then
		targetHeight = CONFIG.RunBobHeight
		targetSide   = CONFIG.RunBobSide
		freq         = CONFIG.RunBobFreq
	else
		targetHeight = CONFIG.WalkBobHeight
		targetSide   = CONFIG.WalkBobSide
		freq         = CONFIG.WalkBobFreq
	end

	-- ---- Advance bob timer only when moving on ground ----
	-- This keeps the wave continuous and prevents snapping
	if isMoving and isOnGround then
		bobTimer = bobTimer + dt * freq
	else
		-- Smoothly wind timer back toward nearest zero crossing
		-- so bob fades out at a natural point
		bobTimer = bobTimer + dt * freq * 0.3
	end

	-- ---- Raw bob values from timer ----
	-- Y uses sin (goes up then down = one full step cycle)
	-- X uses cos at half frequency (sways left/right once per two steps)
	local rawBobY = math.sin(bobTimer) * targetHeight
	local rawBobX = math.cos(bobTimer * 0.5) * targetSide

	-- ---- Smooth bob values ----
	local bobAlpha = isMoving and isOnGround
		and (CONFIG.BobSmoothing * (dt * 60))
		or  (CONFIG.ReturnSmoothing * (dt * 60))

	curBobY = lerp(curBobY, rawBobY, math.min(bobAlpha, 1))
	curBobX = lerp(curBobX, rawBobX, math.min(bobAlpha, 1))

	-- ---- Idle breathing (always present, very subtle) ----
	local idleTarget = math.sin(tick() * CONFIG.IdleSwayFreq) * CONFIG.IdleSwayHeight
	curIdleY = lerp(curIdleY, idleTarget, CONFIG.IdleSmoothing * (dt * 60))

	-- ---- Landing impact ----
	local isNowOnGround = isOnGround
	if isNowOnGround and not wasOnGround then
		-- Just landed — punch the camera down
		local fallSpeed = math.abs(math.min(vel.Y, 0))
		landingOffset = -math.min(fallSpeed * 0.012, CONFIG.LandingBob)
		landingTimer  = CONFIG.LandingDuration
	end
	wasOnGround = isNowOnGround

	if landingTimer > 0 then
		landingTimer = landingTimer - dt
		landingOffset = lerp(landingOffset, 0, (dt / CONFIG.LandingDuration) * 3)
	else
		landingOffset = 0
	end

	-- ---- Strafe sway ----
	-- Project velocity into camera-local space to get sideways component
	local localVel = Camera.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z))
	local strafeTarget = math.clamp(
		-localVel.X * CONFIG.StrafeSway,
		-CONFIG.MaxStrafeSway,
		CONFIG.MaxStrafeSway
	)
	curStrafeSway = lerp(curStrafeSway, strafeTarget, CONFIG.SwaySmoothing * (dt * 60))

	-- ---- Mouse tilt ----
	local mouseDelta  = UIS:GetMouseDelta()
	local tiltTarget  = math.clamp(
		mouseDelta.X * CONFIG.MouseTilt,
		-CONFIG.MaxMouseTilt,
		CONFIG.MaxMouseTilt
	)
	curMouseTilt = lerp(curMouseTilt, tiltTarget, CONFIG.TiltSmoothing * (dt * 60))

	-- ---- Derived rotations from bob ----
	-- Pitch: camera nods forward/back in sync with vertical bob
	local targetPitch = -curBobY * CONFIG.BobPitchScale
	curPitch = lerp(curPitch, targetPitch, math.min(CONFIG.BobSmoothing * (dt * 60), 1))

	-- Roll: camera tilts side to side in sync with horizontal bob
	local targetRollBob = curBobX * CONFIG.BobRollScale
	curRollB = lerp(curRollB, targetRollBob, math.min(CONFIG.BobSmoothing * (dt * 60), 1))

	-- ---- Compose final offset ----
	local totalY = curBobY + curIdleY + landingOffset
	local totalX = curBobX

	-- Position offset (moves camera physically up/down/side)
	local posOffset = CFrame.new(totalX, totalY, 0)

	-- Rotation offset:
	-- pitch = nodding (X axis rotation)
	-- roll  = tilting (Z axis rotation) from bob + strafe + mouse
	local totalRoll = math.rad(
		curRollB * 8             -- bob roll in degrees
			+ curStrafeSway * 15     -- strafe lean
		- curMouseTilt           -- mouse turn tilt
	)
	local totalPitch = math.rad(curPitch * 6)  -- nod in degrees

	local rotOffset = CFrame.Angles(totalPitch, 0, totalRoll)

	-- Apply both together
	Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame * posOffset * rotOffset
end)

-- RESPAWN
-- =============================================

	landingOffset = 0
	wasOnGround   = true
	landingTimer  = 0

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Remotes = {}

local REMOTE_FOLDER_NAME = "BombTagRemotes"

local REMOTE_NAMES = {
	"RoundState",
	"BombState",
}

local remoteFolder = nil

------------------------------------------------------------
-- INIT
------------------------------------------------------------

function Remotes.Init()
	if RunService:IsServer() then

		local existingFolder =
			ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(REMOTE_FOLDER_NAME)

		if existingFolder and existingFolder:IsA("Folder") then
			remoteFolder = existingFolder
		else
			if existingFolder then
				existingFolder:Destroy()
			end

			remoteFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
			remoteFolder.Name = REMOTE_FOLDER_NAME
			remoteFolder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
		end

		for _, remoteName in ipairs(REMOTE_NAMES) do

			local existing =
				remoteFolder:FindFirstChild(remoteName)

			if not existing then
				local remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
				remote.Name = remoteName
				remote.Parent = remoteFolder
			end
		end

	else

		remoteFolder =
			ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild(REMOTE_FOLDER_NAME)

		for _, remoteName in ipairs(REMOTE_NAMES) do
			remoteFolder:WaitForChild(remoteName)
		end
	end
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- GET
------------------------------------------------------------

function Remotes.Get(remoteName)

	assert(
		remoteFolder,
		"Remotes.Init() must run before Remotes.Get()"
	)

	local remote =
		remoteFolder:FindFirstChild(remoteName)

	assert(
		remote and remote:IsA("RemoteEvent"),
		"Remote does not exist: " .. tostring(remoteName)
	)

	return remote
end

]==],[ [==[disabled]==] ]=nil},{[ [==[path]==] ]=[==[ReplicatedStorage/BombSkinBuilderV12]==],[ [==[class]==] ]=[==[ModuleScript]==],[ [==[old]==] ]=[==[--!nonstrict
-- Shared, deterministic bomb sculptures for the carrier and the stand's 3D preview.
-- All extras are welded cosmetic geometry. The gameplay collision sphere is unchanged.
local Builder={}
local V,CF,A=Vector3.new,CFrame.new,CFrame.Angles
local RGB=Color3.fromRGB
local BALL,CYL=Enum.PartType.Ball,Enum.PartType.Cylinder
local METAL,NEON,GLASS=Enum.Material.Metal,Enum.Material.Neon,Enum.Material.Glass
local DARK,WHITE,GOLD=RGB(25,29,40),RGB(255,245,211),RGB(255,203,49)
local GREEN=RGB(79,165,65)

function Builder.Apply(bomb,skin,options)
 if not bomb or not bomb:IsA('BasePart') or type(skin)~='table' or skin.category~='Bombs' then return nil end
 local preview=type(options)=='table' and options.Preview==true
 local old=bomb:FindFirstChild('HussBombSkin');if old then old:Destroy() end
 local folder=Instance.new('Folder');folder.Name='HussBombSkin';folder.Parent=bomb
 local color=RGB(table.unpack(skin.color));local id=skin.visualBase or skin.id
 bomb.Color=color;bomb.Material=METAL;bomb.Reflectance=.16;bomb.Transparency=0
 bomb.CanCollide=false;bomb.CanTouch=false;bomb.CanQuery=false;bomb.Massless=true
 if preview then bomb.Anchored=true end
 if bomb:IsA('Part') then bomb.Shape=BALL end
 bomb:SetAttribute('HussBombId',skin.id);bomb:SetAttribute('HussBombSculptureVersion',12)
 local count=0
 local function part(name,pos,size,tint,shape,material,rotation,transparency)
  local p=Instance.new(shape=='Wedge' and 'WedgePart' or 'Part')
  p.Name=name;if p:IsA('Part') then p.Shape=shape or Enum.PartType.Block end
  p.Size=size;p.Color=tint or color;p.Material=material or METAL;p.Reflectance=p.Material==METAL and .12 or 0
  p.Transparency=transparency or 0;p.Massless=true;p.CanCollide=false;p.CanTouch=false;p.CanQuery=false;p.CastShadow=false;p.Anchored=preview
  p.CFrame=bomb.CFrame*CF(pos)*(rotation or CFrame.identity);p.Parent=folder
  if not preview then local w=Instance.new('WeldConstraint');w.Name='CosmeticWeld';w.Part0=bomb;w.Part1=p;w.Parent=p end
  count+=1;return p
 end
 local function ball(name,pos,size,tint,material,rotation,transparency)
  return part(name,pos,type(size)=='number' and V(size,size,size) or size,tint,BALL,material,rotation,transparency)
 end
 -- Roblox cylinders use their X axis for length. The default disk lies in XZ.
 local function disk(name,pos,diameter,thickness,tint,rotation,material)
  return part(name,pos,V(thickness,diameter,diameter),tint,CYL,material,rotation or A(0,0,math.pi/2))
 end
 local function rod(name,a,b,width,tint,material)
  local delta=b-a;local up=math.abs(delta.Unit:Dot(Vector3.yAxis))>.98 and Vector3.xAxis or Vector3.yAxis
  return part(name,(a+b)/2,V(width,width,delta.Magnitude),tint,nil,material,CF():ToObjectSpace(CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero,delta,up)))
 end
 local function leaf(name,pos,size,tint,rotation)
  return ball(name,pos,size,tint or GREEN,METAL,rotation or A(0,0,.4))
 end
 local function ring(name,tint,radius,rotation,center,segments,width,material)
  local axis=rotation or CFrame.identity;center=center or Vector3.zero;segments=segments or 10;width=width or .12
  local chord=2*radius*math.sin(math.pi/segments)*1.06
  for n=0,segments-1 do local a=(n+.5)*math.pi*2/segments
   local offset=axis:VectorToWorldSpace(V(math.cos(a)*radius,0,math.sin(a)*radius))
   part(name..tostring(n+1),center+offset,V(width,width,chord),tint,nil,material or METAL,axis*A(0,-a,0))
  end
 end
 local function star(name,pos,size,tint,material)
  disk(name..'Center',pos,size*.55,.09,tint,A(0,math.pi/2,0),material)
  for n=0,4 do local a=n*math.pi*.4
   part(name..'Point'..n,pos+V(math.sin(a)*size*.25,math.cos(a)*size*.25,0),V(size*.22,size*.5,.1),tint,'Wedge',material,A(0,0,-a))
  end
 end
 local function particles(name,host,tint,rate,kind)
  if preview then return end
  local at=Instance.new('Attachment');at.Name=name..'Origin';at.Parent=host
  local emitter=Instance.new('ParticleEmitter');emitter.Name=name
  emitter.Texture=kind=='smoke' and 'rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds' or 'rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds'
  emitter.Color=ColorSequence.new(tint,tint:Lerp(WHITE,.55));emitter.Rate=rate;emitter.Lifetime=NumberRange.new(.28,.6)
  emitter.Speed=NumberRange.new(.3,1.25);emitter.SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(35,35);emitter.EmissionDirection=Enum.NormalId.Top
  emitter.Acceleration=V(0,.7,0);emitter.Drag=2;emitter.LightEmission=kind=='smoke' and .25 or .65;emitter.LightInfluence=.4
  emitter.Size=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,kind=='smoke' and .2 or .09),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.3,kind=='smoke' and .35 or .14),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0)})
  emitter.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,.25),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.7,.55),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)})
  emitter.Rotation=NumberRange.new(0,360);emitter.RotSpeed=NumberRange.new(-45,45);emitter.LockedToPart=false;emitter.Parent=at
 end
 local function glow(host,tint)
  if preview then return end
  local light=Instance.new('PointLight');light.Name='SkinGlow';light.Color=tint;light.Range=4;light.Brightness=.35;light.Shadows=false;light.Parent=host
 end

	Effects: the 50 Halloween effects, by theme. HalloweenVFX reads everything from here.

	label     the display name
	theme     the effect's group
	type      Slash, Impact or Build (sets the play time)
	lifetime  seconds per play at speed 1
	colour    image id of the colour flipbook (Body and Glow)
	mono      image id of the mono sheet (the dark Backing layer). Optional: "" plays without it
	fit       keeps the art's size (the art was shrunk to fit its cells); don't change
	base      the lowest point the art ever reaches, 0 = top of the frame, 1 = bottom (for grounded)
	glow      the effect's main colour (tints the Backing)

	If you upload the textures yourself (see UPLOADING THE TEXTURES in the Read Me), paste the new ids
	into colour and mono. Textures/<Name>.png is colour, Textures/Backing/<Name>.png is mono.
]]

local CAP=Input.TouchEnabled and 36 or 72
local RESERVE=6

local function fade(alpha)
    return NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,alpha),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.82,alpha),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)})
end
function R.Preload(id)
    if Native.Has(id) then Native.Preload(id);return end
    local effect=Effects[id]
    if not effect or fetched[id]=='ready' or fetched[id]=='loading' or os.clock()<(retryAt[id] or 0) or inFlight>=3 then return end
    fetched[id]='loading';inFlight=inFlight+1
    task.spawn(function()
        local assets={'rbxassetid://'..effect.colour}
        if effect.mono~='' then assets[#assets+1]='rbxassetid://'..effect.mono end
        local failed=false
        local ok=pcall(function()
            Content:PreloadAsync(assets,function(asset,status)
                if status~=Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then
                    failed=true
                    warn('[HAB Pack] Texture could not load: '..asset..'. Check permissions for this experience.')
                end
            end)
        end)
        fetched[id]=ok and not failed and 'ready' or 'unavailable'
        if fetched[id]=='unavailable' then retryAt[id]=os.clock()+60 end
        inFlight=inFlight-1
    end)
end
function R.Status(id) return Native.Has(id) and Native.Status(id) or fetched[id] end
function R.Play(id,where,size,offset,follow,opacity,priority)
    if Native.Has(id) then return Native.Play(id,where,size,offset,follow,opacity,priority) end
    local effect=Effects[id]
    if not effect or reduced() then return nil end
    local now=os.clock()
    for i=#live,1,-1 do
        local h=live[i]
        if not h.Attachment or not h.Attachment.Parent or h.End<=now then h:Stop();table.remove(live,i) end
    end
    if priority then
        while #live>=CAP do
            local index=1
            for i,h in ipairs(live) do if not h.Priority then index=i;break end end
            table.remove(live,index):Stop()
        end
    elseif #live>=CAP-RESERVE then return nil end
    R.Preload(id)
    local host,attachment
    if typeof(where)=='Instance' and where:IsA('BasePart') and where.Parent then
        attachment=Instance.new('Attachment');attachment.Name='HABPack_'..id
        attachment.Position=offset or Vector3.zero;attachment.Parent=where
    else
        local cf=typeof(where)=='CFrame' and where or typeof(where)=='Vector3' and CFrame.new(where) or nil
        if not cf then return nil end
        host=Instance.new('Part');host.Name='HABPackBurst';host.Size=Vector3.new(.1,.1,.1);host.CFrame=cf
        host.Transparency=1;host.Anchored=true;host.CanCollide=false;host.CanTouch=false;host.CanQuery=false;host.CastShadow=false;host.Parent=folder
        attachment=Instance.new('Attachment');attachment.Name='HABPack_'..id;attachment.Parent=host
    end
    local width=math.clamp(size or 3,.5,priority and 19 or 12)/math.max(.1,effect.fit)
    local life=effect.lifetime
    local emitters={}
    local function layer(name,asset,scale,colour,emission,alpha,z,brightness)
        if asset=='' then return end
        local e=Instance.new('ParticleEmitter');e.Name=name;e.Texture='rbxassetid://'..asset
        e.Rate=0;e.Enabled=false;e.Lifetime=NumberRange.new(life);e.Speed=NumberRange.new(0)
        e.SpreadAngle=Vector2.zero;e.Rotation=NumberRange.new(0);e.RotSpeed=NumberRange.new(0)
        e.FlipbookLayout=Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayout.Grid4x4;e.FlipbookMode=Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.OneShot
        e.FlipbookStartRandom=false;e.FlipbookBlendFrames=true;e.Orientation=Enum.ParticleOrientation.FacingCamera
        e.Size=NumberSequence.new(width*scale);e.LightInfluence=0;e.LightEmission=emission;e.Brightness=brightness
        e.Color=ColorSequence.new(colour);e.Transparency=fade(math.max(alpha,opacity or 0));e.ZOffset=z
        e.LockedToPart=follow==true;e.Parent=attachment
        emitters[#emitters+1]=e
    end
    local hue,saturation=effect.glow:ToHSV()
    layer('Backing',effect.mono,1.03,Color3.fromHSV(hue,math.max(saturation,.35),.07),0,.65,-.2,1)
    layer('Body',effect.colour,1,Color3.new(1,1,1),.5,0,.12,1.7)
    layer('Glow',effect.colour,1.04,Color3.new(1,1,1),1,.67,.18,1.0)
    local handle={Attachment=attachment,Host=host,End=now+life+4,Priority=priority==true}
    function handle:Stop()
        if self.Attachment then self.Attachment:Destroy();self.Attachment=nil end
        if self.Host then self.Host:Destroy();self.Host=nil end
    end
    live[#live+1]=handle
    task.spawn(function()
        local deadline=os.clock()+3
        while fetched[id]=='loading' and os.clock()<deadline and handle.Attachment do task.wait(.05) end
        handle.End=os.clock()+life+.2
        if handle.Attachment and handle.Attachment.Parent and not reduced() then
            for _,e in ipairs(emitters) do if e.Parent then e:Emit(1) end end
        end
    end)
    return handle
end
Run.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    local now=os.clock();local off=reduced()
    for i=#live,1,-1 do
        local h=live[i]
        if off or now>=h.End or not h.Attachment or not h.Attachment.Parent then h:Stop();table.remove(live,i) end
    end
end)

 Orientation='ParticleOrientation',Shape='ParticleEmitterShape',ShapeInOut='ParticleEmitterShapeInOut',
 ShapeStyle='ParticleEmitterShapeStyle',TextureMode='TextureMode'}

local sequences={Size=true,Transparency=true,Squash=true,WidthScale=true}
local scaled={Size=true,Speed=true,Acceleration=true,ZOffset=true,Width0=true,Width1=true,CurveSize0=true,CurveSize1=true,TextureLength=true,MaxLength=true,MinLength=true}

local function warnOnce(key,message)
 if not issues[key] then issues[key]=true;warn('[HAB Pack] '..message) end
end
local function convert(key,value,scale)
 local multiplier=scaled[key] and scale or 1
 if enumKinds[key] then
  for _,item in ipairs(Enum[enumKinds[key]]:GetEnumItems()) do if item.Value==value then return item end end
  error('Unknown enum value for '..key)
 end
 if key=='Color' then
  local keys={}
  for _,v in ipairs(value) do keys[#keys+1]=ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(v[1],Color3.new(v[2],v[3],v[4])) end
  return ColorSequence.new(keys)
 end
 if sequences[key] then
  local keys={}
  for _,v in ipairs(value) do keys[#keys+1]=NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(v[1],v[2]*multiplier,v[3]*multiplier) end
  return NumberSequence.new(keys)
 end
 if ranges[key] then
  if type(value)=='table' then return NumberRange.new(value[1]*multiplier,value[2]*multiplier) end
  return value*multiplier -- Trail.Lifetime is a scalar, not ParticleEmitter.Lifetime
 end
 if key=='Acceleration' then return Vector3.new(value[1],value[2],value[3])*scale end
 if key=='SpreadAngle' then return Vector2.new(value[1],value[2]) end
 if type(value)=='number' then return value*multiplier end
 return value
end
local function apply(o,props,scale)
 -- Layout is set before flipbook details. A bad optional property must not kill the shop.
 if props.FlipbookLayout~=nil then
  local ok,err=pcall(function() o.FlipbookLayout=convert('FlipbookLayout',props.FlipbookLayout,scale) end)
  if not ok then warnOnce('layout',tostring(err)) end
 end
 for key,value in pairs(props) do
  if key~='FlipbookLayout' then
   local ok,err=pcall(function() o[key]=convert(key,value,scale) end)
   if not ok then warnOnce(o.ClassName..key,o.ClassName..'.'..key..': '..tostring(err)) end
  end
 end
end
local function frame(values,scale,center,limit)
 center=center or Vector3.zero
 local p=(Vector3.new(values[1],values[2],values[3])-center)*scale
 -- Imported demonstrations sometimes retain coordinates hundreds of studs from their root.
 limit=limit or 18
 if p.Magnitude>limit then p=p.Unit*limit end
 return CFrame.new(p)*CFrame.new(0,0,0,table.unpack(values,4,12))
end
local fits={}
local function fitted(t)
 if fits[t] then return fits[t] end
 local entries,x,y,z={}, {},{},{}
 for _,entry in ipairs(t.Entries) do
  local class,props=table.unpack(Data.Properties[entry[2]])
  local minAlpha=1
  for _,k in ipairs(props.Transparency or {{0,0,0}}) do minAlpha=math.min(minAlpha,k[2]-(k[3] or 0)) end
  local visible=(props.Texture and props.Texture~='') or class=='Beam' or class=='Trail'
  if visible and minAlpha<.995 then
   local size=0
   for _,k in ipairs(props.Size or {}) do size=math.max(size,k[2]+(k[3] or 0)) end
   if class~='ParticleEmitter' then size=math.max(props.Width0 or 0,props.Width1 or 0,.2) end
   if size>.005 then
    entries[#entries+1]=entry
    x[#x+1]=entry[3][1];y[#y+1]=entry[3][2];z[#z+1]=entry[3][3]
   end
  end
 end
 local function median(v) table.sort(v);return v[math.max(1,math.ceil(#v*.5))] or 0 end
 local center=Vector3.new(median(x),median(y),median(z))
 local radii={}
 for _,entry in ipairs(entries) do
  local props=Data.Properties[entry[2]][2];local size=0
  for _,k in ipairs(props.Size or {}) do size=math.max(size,k[2]+(k[3] or 0)) end
  local dist=(Vector3.new(table.unpack(entry[3],1,3))-center).Magnitude
  radii[#radii+1]=dist+size*.5
  if entry[1]~=1 then radii[#radii+1]=(Vector3.new(table.unpack(entry[4],1,3))-center).Magnitude end
 end
 table.sort(radii)
 local radius=math.clamp(radii[math.max(1,math.ceil(#radii*.85))] or 3,3,150)
 local f={Entries=entries,Center=center,Radius=radius};fits[t]=f;return f
end
local function beginPreload(id)
 local t=Data.Templates[id]
 if not t or status[id]=='ready' or status[id]=='loading' or os.clock()<(retry[id] or 0) then return end
 status[id]='loading';queue[#queue+1]=id
end
function R.Preload(id) beginPreload(id) end
function R.Status(id) return status[id] or 'not loaded' end
function R.Has(id) return Data.Templates[id]~=nil end
function R.Info(id) return Data.Templates[id] end
local function pump()
 while workers<2 and #queue>0 do
  local id=table.remove(queue,1);workers=workers+1
  task.spawn(function()
   local all,seen={},{}
   for _,e in ipairs(Data.Templates[id].Entries) do
    local p=Data.Properties[e[2]][2];local asset=p.Texture
    if asset and asset~='' and not seen[asset] then seen[asset]=true;all[#all+1]=asset end
   end
   local bad=false
   local ok,err=pcall(function()
    Content:PreloadAsync(all,function(asset,result)
     if result~=Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then bad=true;warnOnce(asset,'Asset unavailable: '..asset..'. Grant this experience access or replace it with an authorized upload.') end
    end)
   end)
   status[id]=ok and not bad and 'ready' or 'asset unavailable'
   if not ok then warnOnce('load_'..id,tostring(err)) end
   retry[id]=os.clock()+45;workers=workers-1
  end)
 end
end

   o.Brightness=math.clamp(o.Brightness*1.25,.9,2.4)
   o.LightInfluence=math.min(o.LightInfluence,.3)
   local speedCap=math.max(3,(size or 7)*1.2)
   o.Speed=NumberRange.new(math.clamp(o.Speed.Min,-speedCap,speedCap),math.clamp(o.Speed.Max,-speedCap,speedCap))
   if follow then o.LockedToPart=true end
   local keys={}
   for _,k in ipairs(o.Transparency.Keypoints) do
    local a=math.clamp(k.Value<.995 and k.Value*.76 or k.Value,0,1)
    keys[#keys+1]=NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(k.Time,a,math.max(0,math.min(k.Envelope,a,1-a)))
   end
   o.Transparency=NumberSequence.new(keys)
   o.Lifetime=NumberRange.new(math.min(o.Lifetime.Min,5),math.min(o.Lifetime.Max,5))
   o.Parent=attachment(frame(entry[3],scale,fit.Center,math.max(1,(size or 7)*(follow and .7 or 1))))
   h.Jobs[#h.Jobs+1]={Object=o,At=delay,Amount=math.clamp(math.ceil((attrs.EmitCount or 6)*1.35),1,32),Duration=duration}
  else
   o.Attachment0=attachment(frame(entry[3],scale,fit.Center,math.max(1,(size or 7)*(follow and .7 or 1))));o.Attachment1=attachment(frame(entry[4],scale,fit.Center,math.max(1,(size or 7)*(follow and .7 or 1))));o.Parent=host
   h.Jobs[#h.Jobs+1]={Object=o,At=delay,Duration=math.max(.15,duration),Amount=0}
  end
  h.Objects[#h.Objects+1]=o;h.Layers=h.Layers+1;layerCount=layerCount+1
 end

 return h
end
Run.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
 pump()
 local now=os.clock()
 for i=#active,1,-1 do
  local h=active[i]
  if h.Stopped or reduced() or not h.Host or not h.Host.Parent or now>=h.End or (h.Subject and not h.Subject.Parent) then
   h:Stop();table.remove(active,i)
  else
   if h.Subject then h.Host.CFrame=h.Subject.CFrame*CFrame.new(h.Offset) end
   if not h.Started and (status[h.Id]=='ready' or status[h.Id]=='asset unavailable' or now-h.Born>4) then
    h.Started=now;h.End=now+math.min(Data.Templates[h.Id].Duration,5)+.4
   end
   if h.Started then
    local age=now-h.Started
    for _,job in ipairs(h.Jobs) do
     if not job.Fired and age>=job.At then
      job.Fired=true;job.Until=age+job.Duration
      if job.Object:IsA('ParticleEmitter') then
       local amount=math.min(job.Amount,math.max(0,h.CountBudget))
       h.CountBudget=h.CountBudget-amount
       if amount>0 then job.Object:Emit(amount) end
       job.Object.Enabled=job.Duration>0
      else job.Object.Enabled=true end
     end
     if job.Fired and age>=job.Until then job.Object.Enabled=false end
    end
   end
  end
 end
end)
return R

local function mean(v,default)
 if finite(v) then return v end
 if type(v)=='table' and finite(v[1]) and finite(v[2]) then return (v[1]+v[2])*.5 end
 return default
end
local function number(keys,t,default)
 if finite(keys) then return keys end
 if type(keys)~='table' or #keys==0 then return default end
 if t<=keys[1][1] then return keys[1][2] end
 for i=2,#keys do
  local a,b=keys[i-1],keys[i]

end
local function extrema(keys,maximum,default)
 if finite(keys) then return keys end
 if type(keys)~='table' or #keys==0 then return default end
 local n=maximum and -math.huge or math.huge
 for _,k in ipairs(keys) do if type(k)=='table' and finite(k[2]) then n=maximum and math.max(n,k[2]) or math.min(n,k[2]) end end
 return finite(n) and n or default
end

end

function F.Mount(parent,id,layerLimit)
 local sound=script.Parent:FindFirstChild('HABKillSounds')
 if sound and require(sound).ById[id] then return require(script.Parent.HABKillSoundPlayer).Mount(parent,id) end

 local item=Catalog.Get(id)
 if not item then return nil end
 local sourceId=item.SourceId or id
 local h={Parent=parent,Id=id,Sprites={},Time=0,Paused=false,Stopped=false,Age=0,Status='LOADING',Tint=item.Tint}
 local label=Instance.new('TextLabel');label.Name='PreviewStatus';label.BackgroundTransparency=1
 label.Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,42);label.Position=UDim2.new(0,6,.5,-21)
 label.TextWrapped=true;label.TextSize=12;label.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;label.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(232,240,255)
 label.ZIndex=parent.ZIndex+35;label.Parent=parent;h.Label=label
 local t=Data.Templates[sourceId]
 if not t then
  local e=Catalog.Effects[sourceId]
  if e and e.colour and tostring(e.colour)~='' then
   local m,i=sprites(parent,'rbxassetid://'..e.colour,4,parent.ZIndex+2)
   m.Size=UDim2.fromScale(.96,.96)
   h.Sprites[1]={Mask=m,Image=i,Atlas=true,Life=math.max(.2,e.lifetime or 1)}
   if item.Tint then i.ImageColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1):Lerp(item.Tint,.7) end
  end
 else
  local candidates,seen={},{}
  -- Select usable visible layers FIRST. Empty helper layers cannot consume the preview budget.
  for order,entry in ipairs(t.Entries or {}) do
   local definition=Data.Properties[entry[2]]
   local p=definition and definition[2]
   if type(p)=='table' and type(p.Texture)=='string' and p.Texture~='' then
    local alpha=extrema(p.Transparency,false,0)
    local maximum=extrema(p.Size,true,mean(p.Width0,2))
    if alpha<.995 and maximum>0 then
     local key=tostring(entry[2])
     if not seen[key] then
      seen[key]=true
      local a=(entry[1]==1 and entry[4] or entry[5]) or {}
      candidates[#candidates+1]={P=p,Entry=entry,Order=order,Kind=definition[1],Max=maximum,
       Score=maximum*(1-alpha),Delay=math.clamp(a.EmitDelay or 0,0,.5)}
     end
    end
   end
  end
  table.sort(candidates,function(a,b) if a.Score==b.Score then return a.Order<b.Order end;return a.Score>b.Score end)
  local cap=math.clamp(layerLimit or 10,1,12)
  local count=math.min(cap,#candidates)
  local radius=math.max(1,t.Radius or 4)
  local maxSize=0
  for i=1,count do maxSize=math.max(maxSize,candidates[i].Max) end
  maxSize=math.max(.1,maxSize)
  -- Broad layers behind detailed ones.
  for n=1,count do
   local c=candidates[n];local p=c.P;local grid=gridValues[p.FlipbookLayout] or 1
   local m,i=sprites(parent,p.Texture,grid,parent.ZIndex+1+n)
   local cf=c.Entry[3] or {0,0,0}
   h.Sprites[#h.Sprites+1]={Mask=m,Image=i,P=p,Grid=grid,Max=c.Max,Normalize=maxSize,
    Life=math.clamp(mean(p.Lifetime,1)/math.max(.1,p.TimeScale or 1),.35,3),Delay=c.Delay,
    X=math.clamp((cf[1] or 0)/radius*.15,-.16,.16),Y=math.clamp(-(cf[2] or 0)/radius*.15,-.16,.16),
    Spin=mean(p.RotSpeed,0),Rotation=mean(p.Rotation,0),Order=n,Beam=c.Kind~='ParticleEmitter'}
  end
 end
 function h:Stop()
  if self.Stopped then return end;self.Stopped=true
  for _,s in ipairs(self.Sprites) do s.Mask:Destroy() end
  self.Label:Destroy()
 end
 function h:Retry()
  self.Age=0;showStatus(self,'LOADING','Loading preview...')
  for _,s in ipairs(self.Sprites) do local image=s.Image.Image;s.Image.Image='';s.Image.Image=image end
 end
 showStatus(h,'LOADING',#h.Sprites==0 and 'No preview texture in this preset' or 'Loading preview...')
 if #h.Sprites==0 then showStatus(h,'NO_TEXTURE','No preview texture in this preset') end
 live[#live+1]=h
 return h
end
local function step(h,dt,low)
 h.Age=h.Age+dt;h.Time=h.Time+dt
 local loaded=0
 for _,s in ipairs(h.Sprites) do
  if s.Image.IsLoaded then loaded=loaded+1 end
  if s.Atlas then
   local frame=low and 7 or math.floor(((h.Time+s.Life*.32)/s.Life)*16)%16
   s.Image.Position=UDim2.fromScale(-(frame%4),-math.floor(frame/4))
  else
   -- Start on a useful frame instead of a transparent first frame; loop the real curves.
   local cycle=s.Life+.14
   local age=low and s.Life*.34 or ((h.Time+s.Life*.34)%cycle)
   local t=math.clamp(age/s.Life,0,1)
   local size=math.clamp(number(s.P.Size,t,s.Max)/s.Normalize*.88,.12,.96)
   local squash=math.clamp(number(s.P.Squash,t,0),-.65,1)
   s.Mask.Size=UDim2.fromScale(math.min(1.1,size*(1+math.max(0,squash))),math.min(1.1,size*(1+math.max(0,-squash))))
   s.Mask.Position=UDim2.fromScale(.5+s.X,.5+s.Y)
   -- Atlas clip parents always remain axis-aligned.
   s.Mask.Rotation=0;s.Image.Rotation=s.Grid>1 and 0 or s.Rotation+(low and 0 or s.Spin*age)
   s.Image.ImageColor3=tint(s.P.Color,t)
   if h.Tint then s.Image.ImageColor3=s.Image.ImageColor3:Lerp(h.Tint,.70) end
   s.Image.ImageTransparency=age>s.Life and 1 or math.clamp(number(s.P.Transparency,t,0),0,1)
   local frame=s.Grid==1 and 0 or math.min(s.Grid*s.Grid-1,math.floor(t*s.Grid*s.Grid))
   s.Image.Position=UDim2.fromScale(-(frame%s.Grid),-math.floor(frame/s.Grid))
  end
 end
 if #h.Sprites>0 then
  if loaded>0 then showStatus(h,loaded==#h.Sprites and 'READY' or 'PARTIAL',nil)
  elseif h.Age>12 then
   showStatus(h,'UNAVAILABLE','Preview unavailable\nItem ownership is unchanged')
   if not warned[h.Id] then
    warned[h.Id]=true
    warn('[HAB Preview] Artwork did not load for '..h.Id..'. Check its texture access/moderation. This is not an inventory deletion.')
   end
  end
 end
end
Run.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
 elapsed=elapsed+math.min(dt,.1);if elapsed<1/30 then return end
 local stepTime=elapsed;elapsed=0
 local player=Players.LocalPlayer
 local low=player:GetAttribute('HussReducedMotion')==true or workspace:GetAttribute('HussReducedMotion')==true
 for i=#live,1,-1 do
  local h=live[i]
  if h.Stopped or not h.Parent.Parent then h:Stop();table.remove(live,i)
  elseif not h.Paused and visible(h.Parent) then
   local ok,err=pcall(step,h,stepTime,low)
   if not ok then
    for _,s in ipairs(h.Sprites) do s.Mask.Visible=false end
    showStatus(h,'ERROR','Preview unavailable');h.Paused=true
    warn('[HAB Preview] '..h.Id..': '..tostring(err))
   end
  end
 end
end)
return F

function F.Mount(parent,id,layerLimit,options)
 local sound=script.Parent:FindFirstChild('HABKillSounds')
 if sound and require(sound).ById[id] then return require(script.Parent.HABKillSoundPlayer).Mount(parent,id) end

 local item=Catalog.Get(id)
 local ability=type(options)=='table' and options.Ability==true and abilityArt[id]==true
 if not item or (item.Category~='Trail' and item.Category~='Aura' and not ability) then return nil end
 local sourceId=item.SourceId or id
 local h={Parent=parent,Id=id,Sprites={},Time=0,Paused=false,Stopped=false,Age=0,Status='LOADING',Tint=item.Tint}
 local label=Instance.new('TextLabel');label.Name='PreviewStatus';label.BackgroundTransparency=1
 label.Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,42);label.Position=UDim2.new(0,6,.5,-21)
 label.TextWrapped=true;label.TextSize=12;label.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;label.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(232,240,255)
 label.ZIndex=parent.ZIndex+35;label.Parent=parent;h.Label=label
 local t=Data.Templates[sourceId]
 if not t then
  local e=Catalog.Effects[sourceId]
  if e and e.colour and tostring(e.colour)~='' then
   local m,i=sprites(parent,'rbxassetid://'..e.colour,4,parent.ZIndex+2)
   m.Size=UDim2.fromScale(.96,.96)
   h.Sprites[1]={Mask=m,Image=i,Atlas=true,Life=math.max(.2,e.lifetime or 1)}
   if item.Tint then i.ImageColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1):Lerp(item.Tint,.7) end
  end
 else
  local candidates,seen={},{}
  -- Select usable visible layers FIRST. Empty helper layers cannot consume the preview budget.
  for order,entry in ipairs(t.Entries or {}) do
   local definition=Data.Properties[entry[2]]
   local p=definition and definition[2]
   if type(p)=='table' and type(p.Texture)=='string' and p.Texture~='' then
    local alpha=extrema(p.Transparency,false,0)
    local maximum=extrema(p.Size,true,mean(p.Width0,2))
    if alpha<.995 and maximum>0 then
     local key=tostring(entry[2])
     if not seen[key] then
      seen[key]=true
      local a=(entry[1]==1 and entry[4] or entry[5]) or {}
      candidates[#candidates+1]={P=p,Entry=entry,Order=order,Kind=definition[1],Max=maximum,
       Score=maximum*(1-alpha),Delay=math.clamp(a.EmitDelay or 0,0,.5)}
     end
    end
   end
  end
  table.sort(candidates,function(a,b) if a.Score==b.Score then return a.Order<b.Order end;return a.Score>b.Score end)
  local cap=math.clamp(layerLimit or 10,1,12)
  local count=math.min(cap,#candidates)
  local radius=math.max(1,t.Radius or 4)
  local maxSize=0
  for i=1,count do maxSize=math.max(maxSize,candidates[i].Max) end
  maxSize=math.max(.1,maxSize)
  -- Broad layers behind detailed ones.
  for n=1,count do
   local c=candidates[n];local p=c.P;local grid=gridValues[p.FlipbookLayout] or 1
   local m,i=sprites(parent,p.Texture,grid,parent.ZIndex+1+n)
   local cf=c.Entry[3] or {0,0,0}
   h.Sprites[#h.Sprites+1]={Mask=m,Image=i,P=p,Grid=grid,Max=c.Max,Normalize=maxSize,
    Life=math.clamp(mean(p.Lifetime,1)/math.max(.1,p.TimeScale or 1),.35,3),Delay=c.Delay,
    X=math.clamp((cf[1] or 0)/radius*.15,-.16,.16),Y=math.clamp(-(cf[2] or 0)/radius*.15,-.16,.16),
    Spin=mean(p.RotSpeed,0),Rotation=mean(p.Rotation,0),Order=n,Beam=c.Kind~='ParticleEmitter'}
  end
 end
 function h:Stop()
  if self.Stopped then return end;self.Stopped=true
  for _,s in ipairs(self.Sprites) do s.Mask:Destroy() end
  self.Label:Destroy()
 end
 function h:Retry()
  self.Age=0;showStatus(self,'LOADING','Loading preview...')
  for _,s in ipairs(self.Sprites) do local image=s.Image.Image;s.Image.Image='';s.Image.Image=image end
 end
 showStatus(h,'LOADING',#h.Sprites==0 and 'No preview texture in this preset' or 'Loading preview...')
 if #h.Sprites==0 then showStatus(h,'NO_TEXTURE','No preview texture in this preset') end
 live[#live+1]=h
 return h
end
local function step(h,dt,low)
 h.Age=h.Age+dt;h.Time=h.Time+dt
 local loaded=0
 for _,s in ipairs(h.Sprites) do
  if s.Image.IsLoaded then loaded=loaded+1 end
  if s.Atlas then
   local frame=low and 7 or math.floor(((h.Time+s.Life*.32)/s.Life)*16)%16
   s.Image.Position=UDim2.fromScale(-(frame%4),-math.floor(frame/4))
  else
   -- Start on a useful frame instead of a transparent first frame; loop the real curves.
   local cycle=s.Life+.14
   local age=low and s.Life*.34 or ((h.Time+s.Life*.34)%cycle)
   local t=math.clamp(age/s.Life,0,1)
   local size=math.clamp(number(s.P.Size,t,s.Max)/s.Normalize*.88,.12,.96)
   local squash=math.clamp(number(s.P.Squash,t,0),-.65,1)
   s.Mask.Size=UDim2.fromScale(math.min(1.1,size*(1+math.max(0,squash))),math.min(1.1,size*(1+math.max(0,-squash))))
   s.Mask.Position=UDim2.fromScale(.5+s.X,.5+s.Y)
   -- Atlas clip parents always remain axis-aligned.
   s.Mask.Rotation=0;s.Image.Rotation=s.Grid>1 and 0 or s.Rotation+(low and 0 or s.Spin*age)
   s.Image.ImageColor3=tint(s.P.Color,t)
   if h.Tint then s.Image.ImageColor3=s.Image.ImageColor3:Lerp(h.Tint,.70) end
   s.Image.ImageTransparency=age>s.Life and 1 or math.clamp(number(s.P.Transparency,t,0),0,1)
   local frame=s.Grid==1 and 0 or math.min(s.Grid*s.Grid-1,math.floor(t*s.Grid*s.Grid))
   s.Image.Position=UDim2.fromScale(-(frame%s.Grid),-math.floor(frame/s.Grid))
  end
 end
 if #h.Sprites>0 then
  if loaded>0 then showStatus(h,loaded==#h.Sprites and 'READY' or 'PARTIAL',nil)
  elseif h.Age>12 then
   showStatus(h,'UNAVAILABLE','Preview unavailable\nItem ownership is unchanged')
   if not warned[h.Id] then
    warned[h.Id]=true
    warn('[HAB Preview] Artwork did not load for '..h.Id..'. Check its texture access/moderation. This is not an inventory deletion.')
   end
  end
 end
end
Run.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
 elapsed=elapsed+math.min(dt,.1);if elapsed<1/30 then return end
 local stepTime=elapsed;elapsed=0
 local player=Players.LocalPlayer
 local low=player:GetAttribute('HussReducedMotion')==true or workspace:GetAttribute('HussReducedMotion')==true
 for i=#live,1,-1 do
  local h=live[i]
  if h.Stopped or not h.Parent.Parent then h:Stop();table.remove(live,i)
  elseif not h.Paused and visible(h.Parent) then
   local ok,err=pcall(step,h,stepTime,low)
   if not ok then
    for _,s in ipairs(h.Sprites) do s.Mask.Visible=false end
    showStatus(h,'ERROR','Preview unavailable');h.Paused=true
    warn('[HAB Preview] '..h.Id..': '..tostring(err))
   end
  end
 end
end)
return F

M.Crates = {
 Aura={Name="Aura Chest",Label="AURAS",Description="Surround your character with an animated aura."},
 Trail={Name="Trail Chest",Label="TRAILS",Description="Leave an animated effect behind you as you move."},
 BombFX={Name="Bomb Chest",Label="BOMB EFFECTS",Description="Add an effect to the bomb without replacing its skin."},
 KillFX={Name="Finisher Chest",Label="FINISHERS",Description="An explosion effect credited to the last bomb giver."},
 DodgeFX={Name="Dodge Chest",Label="DODGES",Description="A burst of style when you dodge."},
}
function M.Apply(catalog)
 for _,item in ipairs(catalog.Items) do
  local name=M.Items[item.Id]
  if name then
   item.SourceName=item.SourceName or item.Name
   item.Name=name
   item.Description=M.Crates[item.Category] and M.Crates[item.Category].Description or "Cosmetic effect."
  end
 end
 for category,info in pairs(M.Crates) do
  local crate=catalog.Crates[category]
  if crate then crate.Name=info.Name;crate.Label=info.Label;crate.Description=info.Description end
 end
 -- Do NOT sort catalog pools here. Their IDs/order and prices are preserved.
 return catalog
end
return M

]==],[ [==[disabled]==] ]=nil},{[ [==[path]==] ]=[==[ReplicatedStorage/HABHalloween/CollectionViewModel]==],[ [==[class]==] ]=[==[ModuleScript]==],[ [==[old]==] ]=[==[--!nonstrict
-- HAB_COLLECTIONS_6. Read-only UI projection of SERVER snapshots. Never grants ownership.
local M={}
local MAX=2000000000
local function finite(n) return type(n)=='number' and n==n and n>-math.huge and n<math.huge end
local function amount(n) return finite(n) and math.clamp(math.floor(n),0,MAX) or 0 end
local function copy(t)
 local o={};if type(t)=='table' then for k,v in pairs(t) do o[k]=v end end;return o
end
function M.Empty()
 return {Ready=false,CanOpen=false,Gems=0,Coins=0,Owned={},Equipped={},StoredCrates={},StoredCounts={},Pools={},Products={},Quests={},Revision=0,RandomAllowed=false,HasInventory=false}
end
function M.Owned(values)
 local out={}
 if type(values)~='table' then return out end
 local count=0
 for k,v in pairs(values) do
  count=count+1;if count>4096 then break end
  if type(k)=='string' and v==true then out[k]=true
  elseif type(k)=='number' then
   local id=type(v)=='string' and v or type(v)=='table' and (v.Id or v.id)
   if type(id)=='string' and #id<=128 then out[id]=true end
  end
 end
 return out
end
function M.Accept(previous,snapshot)
 if type(snapshot)~='table' then return previous,false end
 -- A late request must not erase a newer ownership/equipment snapshot.
 if finite(snapshot.Revision) and finite(previous.Revision) and snapshot.Revision<previous.Revision and previous.HasInventory then
  return previous,false
 end
 local out=copy(previous)
 for _,key in ipairs({'Ready','CanOpen','RandomAllowed','PolicyMessage','SaveStatus','ApiVersion','InventoryVersion','ServerState','ServerIssue','LastOpening','Products','Quests','ResetsAt'}) do
  if snapshot[key]~=nil then out[key]=snapshot[key] end
 end
 out.Ready=snapshot.Ready==true
 out.RandomAllowed=snapshot.RandomAllowed==true
 if snapshot.Gems~=nil then out.Gems=amount(snapshot.Gems) end
 if snapshot.Coins~=nil then out.Coins=amount(snapshot.Coins) end
 if finite(snapshot.Revision) then out.Revision=amount(snapshot.Revision) end
 -- Do not replace a previously received inventory with absent fields on a loading response.
 if type(snapshot.Owned)=='table' and (snapshot.Ready==true or not previous.HasInventory or next(snapshot.Owned)~=nil) then out.Owned=M.Owned(snapshot.Owned);out.HasInventory=true end
 if type(snapshot.Equipped)=='table' then out.Equipped=copy(snapshot.Equipped) end
 if type(snapshot.Pools)=='table' then out.Pools=snapshot.Pools end
 if type(snapshot.StoredCrates)=='table' and (snapshot.Ready==true or not previous.HasInventory or next(snapshot.StoredCrates)~=nil) then
  out.StoredCrates={};out.StoredCounts={}
  local count=0
  for k,v in pairs(snapshot.StoredCrates) do
   count=count+1;if count>500 then break end
   if type(v)=='table' and type(v.Category)=='string' then
    local id=v.Id or (type(k)=='string' and k)
    if type(id)=='string' then
     local c=copy(v);c.Id=id;c.Cost=amount(c.Cost);c.At=amount(c.At)
     out.StoredCrates[#out.StoredCrates+1]=c
     out.StoredCounts[c.Category]=(out.StoredCounts[c.Category] or 0)+1
    end
   end
  end
  table.sort(out.StoredCrates,function(a,b) if a.At==b.At then return a.Id<b.Id end;return a.At<b.At end)
 end
 out.Products=type(out.Products)=='table' and out.Products or {}
 out.Quests=type(out.Quests)=='table' and out.Quests or {}
 return out,true
end
function M.Pool(state,category)
 local p=state.Pools[category]
 if type(p)~='table' then return {Items={},Reserved={},RandomStored=0,CanBuy=false} end
 return {Items=type(p.Items)=='table' and p.Items or {},Reserved=type(p.Reserved)=='table' and p.Reserved or {},RandomStored=amount(p.RandomStored),CanBuy=p.CanBuy==true}
end
function M.Contains(list,id)
 for _,v in ipairs(list) do if v==id then return true end end;return false
end
function M.Odds(count)
 if count<1 then return 'No available rewards.' end
 return string.format('Available rewards: %.6f%% each (1/%d).',100/count,count)
end
function M.Count(state)
 local catalog=require(script.Parent.Catalog)
 local effects=0;for id,owned in pairs(state.Owned) do if owned==true and not(catalog.ById[id] and catalog.ById[id].RetiredFinisher) then effects=effects+1 end end
 return #state.StoredCrates,effects
end
function M.Inventory(catalog,state,filter,query)
 filter=filter or 'All';query=tostring(query or ''):lower()
 local rows,groups={},{}
 local rank={};for i,cat in ipairs(catalog.Order) do rank[cat]=i end
 local function matches(name,cat,kind,oldName)
  if filter~='All' and filter~='Effects' and filter~='Crates' and filter~=cat then return false end
  if filter=='Crates' and kind~='Crate' then return false end
  if filter=='Effects' and kind~='Effect' then return false end
  return query=='' or (name..' '..cat..' '..tostring(oldName or '')):lower():find(query,1,true)~=nil
 end
 for _,c in ipairs(state.StoredCrates) do
  local crate=catalog.Crates[c.Category]
  local name=crate and crate.Name or 'Stored crate'
  local key=c.Category..'|'..tostring(c.Mode)..'|'..tostring(c.Choice or '')..'|'..tostring(c.Cost)
  if matches(name,c.Category,'Crate') then
   local g=groups[key]
   if not g then
    g={Kind='Crate',Key=key,Name=name,Category=c.Category,Count=0,Crate=c,Color=crate and crate.Color}
    groups[key]=g;rows[#rows+1]=g
   end
   g.Count=g.Count+1
  end
 end
 for id,owned in pairs(state.Owned) do
  if owned==true then
   local item=catalog.ById[id]
   local name=item and item.Name or 'Legacy effect'
   local cat=item and item.Category or 'Unknown'
   if not(item and item.RetiredFinisher) and matches(name,cat,'Effect',item and item.SourceName or id) then
    rows[#rows+1]={Kind='Effect',Key=id,Id=id,Name=name,Category=cat,Item=item,Missing=item==nil,Color=item and item.Color,Equipped=state.Equipped[cat]==id}
   end
  end
 end
 table.sort(rows,function(a,b)
  if a.Kind~=b.Kind then return a.Kind=='Crate' end
  if a.Kind=='Crate' and (rank[a.Category] or 99)~=(rank[b.Category] or 99) then return (rank[a.Category] or 99)<(rank[b.Category] or 99) end
  if a.Kind=='Effect' and a.Equipped~=b.Equipped then return a.Equipped==true end
  if a.Name~=b.Name then return a.Name<b.Name end
  return a.Key<b.Key
 end)
 return rows
end
return M

function M.Inventory(catalog,state,filter,query)
 filter=filter or 'All';query=tostring(query or ''):lower()
 local rows,groups={},{}
 local rank={};for i,cat in ipairs(catalog.Order) do rank[cat]=i end
 local function matches(name,cat,kind,oldName)
  if filter~='All' and filter~='Effects' and filter~='Crates' and filter~=cat then return false end
  if filter=='Crates' and kind~='Crate' then return false end
  if filter=='Effects' and kind~='Effect' then return false end
  return query=='' or (name..' '..cat..' '..tostring(oldName or '')):lower():find(query,1,true)~=nil
 end
 for _,c in ipairs(state.StoredCrates) do
  local crate=catalog.Crates[c.Category]
  local retired=catalog.DisabledVisualCategories and catalog.DisabledVisualCategories[c.Category]==true
  local name=(crate and crate.Name or 'Stored crate')..(retired and ' • REFUND ONLY' or '')
  local key=c.Category..'|'..tostring(c.Mode)..'|'..tostring(c.Choice or '')..'|'..tostring(c.Cost)
  if matches(name,c.Category,'Crate') then
   local g=groups[key]
   if not g then
    g={Kind='Crate',Key=key,Name=name,Category=c.Category,Count=0,Crate=c,Color=crate and crate.Color,RefundOnly=retired}
    groups[key]=g;rows[#rows+1]=g
   end
   g.Count=g.Count+1
  end
 end
 for id,owned in pairs(state.Owned) do
  if owned==true then
   local item=catalog.ById[id]
   local name=item and item.Name or 'Legacy effect'

-- HAB_FUN_9]==],[ [==[disabled]==] ]=nil},{[ [==[path]==] ]=[==[ReplicatedStorage/HABExpansion/CombatRules]==],[ [==[class]==] ]=[==[ModuleScript]==],[ [==[old]==] ]=[==[--!nonstrict
-- HAB_PLAY_POLISH_8: bounded, swept melee geometry. No client target is trusted.
local R={}
local V=Vector3.new
function R.Finite(v)
 return typeof(v)=='Vector3' and v.X==v.X and v.Y==v.Y and v.Z==v.Z and v.Magnitude<1000000
end
function R.Flat(v) return V(v.X,0,v.Z) end
function R.Direction(v,fallback)
 if not R.Finite(v) then return fallback or V(0,0,-1) end
 local f=R.Flat(v)
 return f.Magnitude>.001 and f.Unit or fallback or V(0,0,-1)
end
function R.SegmentDistance(point,a,b)
 local d=b-a
 local t=d:Dot(d)>1e-8 and math.clamp((point-a):Dot(d)/d:Dot(d),0,1) or 0
 return (point-(a+d*t)).Magnitude,t
end
function R.Turn(from,to,maxAngle)
 from=R.Direction(from);to=R.Direction(to,from)
 local angle=math.atan2(from:Cross(to).Y,math.clamp(from:Dot(to),-1,1))
 local n=math.clamp(angle,-maxAngle,maxAngle)
 -- Y-axis rotation using the same handedness as Vector3:Cross.
 local c,s=math.cos(n),math.sin(n)
 return V(from.X*c+from.Z*s,0,-from.X*s+from.Z*c)
end
function R.Swing(a,b,direction,settings,radius,halfHeight)
 local d=b-a;local flat=R.Flat(d)
 radius=math.clamp(radius or 1.05,.85,1.25)
 halfHeight=math.clamp(halfHeight or 1.6,1.2,2)
 if math.abs(d.Y)>settings.Vertical+halfHeight then return nil end
 if flat.Magnitude>settings.Range+radius then return nil end
 local forward=flat:Dot(direction)
 -- A body overlapping the shoulder can be tagged; a target behind the user cannot.
 if forward<-.15 then return nil end
 local side=math.sqrt(math.max(0,flat:Dot(flat)-forward*forward))
 local angle=math.rad(settings.HalfAngle)
 if side>math.max(.2,forward)*math.tan(angle)+radius then return nil end
 return flat.Magnitude+side*.12
end
function R.Swept(a0,a1,b0,b1,d0,d1,settings,radius,height)
 local travel=((b1-b0)-(a1-a0)).Magnitude
 local steps=math.clamp(math.ceil(travel/.45),1,16)
 local best
 for i=0,steps do
  local t=i/steps
  local a=a0:Lerp(a1,t);local b=b0:Lerp(b1,t)
  local dir=R.Direction(d0:Lerp(d1,t),d1)
  local score=R.Swing(a,b,dir,settings,radius,height)
  if score and (not best or score<best.Score) then best={Score=score,A=a,B=b,Alpha=t} end
 end
 return best
end
function R.Projectile(origin,velocity,gravity,t)
 return origin+velocity*t+V(0,-.5*gravity*t*t,0)
end
return R

 draw=function()
  if not live or not cover.Visible then return end
  clearPage()
  local screen=cover.AbsoluteSize;if screen.X<1 then screen=V2(1280,720) end
  fit.Scale=math.min(1,math.max(.45,screen.Y/620))
  width=math.min(980,(screen.X-24)/fit.Scale);height=math.min(720,(screen.Y-24)/fit.Scale)
  window.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(width,height)
  rect(title,24,20,width-110,43);title.TextSize=width<500 and 24 or 32
  rect(close,width-76,19,52,50)
  hint.Text=tostring(state.Coins or 0)..' COINS  •  '..tostring(state.Gems or 0)..' GEMS  •  ONE EQUIPPED'
  rect(hint,24,69,width-48,42);hint.TextSize=width<490 and 12 or 15
  rect(body,16,125,width-32,height-205);rect(footer,24,height-56,width-48,39)
  local bw=width-46;local cols=bw>=640 and 2 or 1;local gap=20;local cw=(bw-gap*(cols-1))/cols
  local pages=math.max(1,math.ceil(#Config.Abilities/cols));abilityPage=math.clamp(abilityPage,1,pages)
  local first=(abilityPage-1)*cols+1;local ch=346
  for index=first,math.min(#Config.Abilities,first+cols-1) do
   local a=Config.Abilities[index];local owned=a.Currency=='Free' or (state.Abilities and state.Abilities[a.Key]==true)
   local equipped=(me:GetAttribute('HABAbility') or state.Ability)==a.Key
   local f=T.Panel(body,'AbilityCard_'..a.Key,cw-8,ch,28,a.Color);round(f,26);rect(f,6+(index-first)*(cw+gap),6,cw-8,ch)
   local name=label(f,'Name',a.Name,23,a.Color);rect(name,16,14,cw-40,37);name.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
   art(f,a,(cw-150)/2,61,142,100)
   local details=label(f,'Description',a.Description,14,C.white);rect(details,20,171,cw-48,80);details.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
   local cd=label(f,'Cooldown',a.Cooldown..'s COOLDOWN  •  '..(owned and 'UNLOCKED' or a.Currency=='Robux' and 'PERMANENT PASS' or 'PERMANENT UNLOCK'),11,C.gold)
   rect(cd,16,254,cw-40,23);cd.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
   local caption,disabled,passId='EQUIP',false,nil
   if equipped then caption='EQUIPPED';disabled=true
   elseif not owned then
    if a.Currency=='Robux' then
     for _,pass in ipairs(Config.Passes) do if pass.Key==a.PassKey then passId=pass.Id end end
     if not passId or passId<=0 then caption='PASS NOT CONFIGURED';disabled=true
     else
      local cache=abilityPrices[passId]
      caption=cache and cache.price and ('UNLOCK  R$ '..cache.price) or 'LOADING PRICE...'
      disabled=not(cache and cache.price)
      if not cache then
       abilityPrices[passId]={loading=true}
       task.spawn(function()
        local ok,data=pcall(Market.GetProductInfoAsync,Market,passId,Enum.InfoType.GamePass)
        abilityPrices[passId]=ok and data.IsForSale and type(data.PriceInRobux)=='number' and {price=data.PriceInRobux} or {failed=true}
        if live and cover.Visible then draw() end
       end)
      elseif cache.failed then caption='PRICE UNAVAILABLE' end
     end
    else
     caption=(armedAbility==a.Key and 'CONFIRM  ' or 'UNLOCK  ')..a.Cost..' '..a.Currency:upper()
     disabled=(tonumber(state[a.Currency]) or 0)<a.Cost
     if disabled then caption='NEED '..a.Cost..' '..a.Currency:upper() end
    end
   end
   local buy=button(f,'SelectAbility_'..a.Key,caption,equipped and C.green or a.Color,function()
    if busy or not state.Ready then return end
    if owned then request('SelectAbility',a.Key)
    elseif a.Currency=='Robux' then request('PassPrompt',a.PassKey)
    elseif armedAbility~=a.Key then armedAbility=a.Key;footer.Text='Confirm this permanent unlock. Gems/Coins are saved together with ownership.';draw()
    else armedAbility=nil;request('BuyAbility',a.Key) end
   end,pageLinks)
   rect(buy,16,289,cw-40,48);buy.TextSize=width<480 and 15 or 18
   buy:SetAttribute('HussSelected',equipped);buy:SetAttribute('HussDisabled',disabled or busy or not state.Ready)
  end
  local previous=button(body,'PreviousAbilities','< BACK',C.violet,function() abilityPage-=1;armedAbility=nil;draw() end,pageLinks)
  rect(previous,6,ch+23,(bw-20)/2,46);previous:SetAttribute('HussDisabled',abilityPage<=1)
  local next=button(body,'NextAbilities','MORE  '..abilityPage..'/'..pages..' >',C.cyan,function() abilityPage+=1;armedAbility=nil;draw() end,pageLinks)
  rect(next,16+(bw-20)/2,ch+23,(bw-20)/2,46);next:SetAttribute('HussDisabled',abilityPage>=pages)
  body.CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,ch+78)
 end
 request=function(action,key)
  if busy or not live then return end
  busy=true;seq=seq+1;local token=seq
  if action~='Sync' or not state.Ready then footer.Text=action=='SelectAbility' and 'Saving your ability...' or 'Loading your loadout...';draw() end
  task.delay(12,function()
   if live and busy and token==seq then busy=false;seq=seq+1;footer.Text='Loadout is unavailable. Reopen to retry.';draw() end
  end)
  task.spawn(function()
   local ok,res=pcall(X.Api.InvokeServer,X.Api,action,key)
   if not live or token~=seq then return end
   busy=false
   local priorAbility,priorReady=state.Ability,state.Ready
   local oldOwned=state.Abilities or {};local oldCoins,oldGems=state.Coins,state.Gems
   if ok and type(res)=='table' then
    if type(res.Profile)=='table' then state=res.Profile end
    if res.OK and res.PassId then
     local ok,why=pcall(Market.PromptGamePassPurchase,Market,me,res.PassId)
     if not ok then footer.Text='Purchase window unavailable: '..tostring(why) end
    end
    footer.Text=res.Message or (state.Ready and 'Equipped ability is saved. Use Q / Y during a round.' or 'Waiting for your saved profile. The default ability works in a round.')
   else footer.Text='Connection interrupted. Reopen this menu to retry.' end
   local changed=false
   for _,a in ipairs(Config.Abilities) do if (state.Abilities or {})[a.Key]~=oldOwned[a.Key] then changed=true;break end end
   if action~='Sync' or state.Ability~=priorAbility or state.Ready~=priorReady or changed or oldCoins~=state.Coins or oldGems~=state.Gems then draw() end
  end)
 end

  if not cover.Visible then return end
  cover.Visible=false;clearPage()
  me:SetAttribute('HABAbilityMenuOpen',false)
  me:SetAttribute('HABExpansionOpen',false)
 end

  if active() then return end
  -- Existing menus listen to this shared modal flag, so inventory does not overlap the picker.
  me:SetAttribute('HABExpansionOpen',true);me:SetAttribute('HABAbilityMenuOpen',true)
  cover.Visible=true;draw();syncAt=os.clock()+5;request('Sync')
 end

 end
 function Hud.Pending(kind,untilAt) pending[kind]=untilAt end
 function Hud.Reply(e)
  pending[e.Action]=nil
  if e.OK~=true and e.Message then Hud.Notice(e.Message,C.gold,1.2) end
 end
 function Hud.Hit() Hud.Notice('TAGGED!',C.green,.65) end

 end)

 link(me:GetAttributeChangedSignal('HABAbility'),draw)
