]==]},{[ [==[path]==] ]=[==[ServerScriptService/Services/HABGemPurchases]==],[ [==[class]==] ]=[==[ModuleScript]==],[ [==[old]==] ]=[==[
--!nonstrict
-- HAB_CRATE_UPGRADE_2. This is the ONE ProcessReceipt owner for configured Gem products.
local Marketplace=game:GetService('MarketplaceService')
local Players=game:GetService('Players')
local Settings=require(game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'):WaitForChild('HABHalloween'):WaitForChild('Settings'))
local S={};local started=false;local configured=false
function S.Init(Economy)
    if started then return configured end
    started=true
    local known={};local count=0
    for _,p in ipairs(Settings.GemProducts) do
        assert(type(p.ProductId)=='number' and p.ProductId>=0 and p.ProductId%1==0,'Invalid Developer Product ID')
        assert(type(p.Gems)=='number' and p.Gems>0 and p.Gems%1==0,'Invalid Gem amount')
        if p.ProductId>0 then
            assert(not known[p.ProductId],'Duplicate Gem product ID')
            known[p.ProductId]=true;count=count+1
        end
    end
    if count==0 then
        print('[HAB Gems] Quest Gems active; no Robux products configured. Receipt callback not changed.')
        return false
    end
    configured=true
    Marketplace.ProcessReceipt=function(info)
        if type(info)~='table' or not known[info.ProductId] then
            warn('[HAB Gems] Unknown receipt product. Not acknowledged; configure its product handler.')
            return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
        end
        local player=Players:GetPlayerByUserId(info.PlayerId)
        if not player then return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet end
        -- Allow the profile loader to finish, without spending a receipt on an empty profile.
        local untilAt=os.clock()+12
        while player.Parent==Players and player:GetAttribute('HussEconomyReady')~=true and os.clock()<untilAt do task.wait(.2) end
        local ok,confirmed=pcall(Economy.HABProcessGemReceipt,info)
        if ok and confirmed then
            return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
        end
        if not ok then warn('[HAB Gems] Receipt retry required: '..tostring(confirmed)) end
        return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
    end
    print('[HAB Gems] '..count..' Robux products configured; grants require saved receipts.')
    return true
end
-- HAB_CRATES_REPAIR_3
return S


]==],[ [==[disabled]==] ]=nil},{[ [==[path]==] ]=[==[ServerScriptService/Services/HABCrateInventoryRules]==],[ [==[class]==] ]=[==[ModuleScript]==],[ [==[old]==] ]=[==[--!nonstrict
-- HAB_COLLECTIONS_5 | Pure, server-side crate inventory rules. No network/data-store calls.
local R={}
local slots={Aura=true,Trail=true,BombFX=true,KillFX=true,DodgeFX=true}
local modes={Random=true,Guaranteed=true}
local kinds={Buy=true,Open=true,Refund=true}
local MAX=2000000000
R.MaxStored=250
R.MaxReceipts=4096
local function integer(n,max)
 return type(n)=='number' and n==n and n>=0 and n%1==0 and n<=(max or MAX)
end
function R.Token(s)
 return type(s)=='string' and #s>=12 and #s<=64 and s:match('^[%w%-]+$')~=nil
end
function R.Fresh() return {v=1,Stored={},Receipts={}} end
function R.Valid(v)
 if v==nil then return true end -- An older profile is migrated, not reset.
 if type(v)~='table' or v.v~=1 or type(v.Stored)~='table' or type(v.Receipts)~='table' then return false end
 local n=0
 for id,c in pairs(v.Stored) do
  n=n+1
  if n>R.MaxStored or not R.Token(id) or type(c)~='table' or not slots[c.Category]
   or not modes[c.Mode] or not integer(c.Cost) or c.Cost<1 or not integer(c.At)
   or (c.Mode=='Guaranteed' and (type(c.Choice)~='string' or #c.Choice<1 or #c.Choice>64))
   or (c.Mode=='Random' and c.Choice~=nil) then return false end
 end
 n=0
 for id,t in pairs(v.Receipts) do
  n=n+1
  if n>R.MaxReceipts or not R.Token(id) or type(t)~='table' or not kinds[t.Kind]
   or not R.Token(t.Crate) or not slots[t.Category] or not integer(t.Cost) or not integer(t.At)
   or (t.Kind=='Open' and (type(t.Item)~='string' or #t.Item<1 or #t.Item>64)) then return false end
 end
 if v.LastOpen~=nil and (not R.Token(v.LastOpen) or not v.Receipts[v.LastOpen] or v.Receipts[v.LastOpen].Kind~='Open') then return false end
 return true
end
function R.Pool(data,catalog,category)
 local crate=catalog.Crates[category]
 if not crate then return {},0,{} end
 local owned=data.HABHalloween.Owned
 local reserved={};local randomCount=0
 for _,stored in pairs(data.HABCrateInventory.Stored) do
  if stored.Category==category then
   if stored.Mode=='Guaranteed' then reserved[stored.Choice]=true else randomCount=randomCount+1 end
  end
 end
 local pool={}
 for _,id in ipairs(crate.Items) do
  if not owned[id] and not reserved[id] then pool[#pool+1]=id end
 end
 return pool,randomCount,reserved
end
function R.PlanBuy(data,catalog,category,choice,randomAllowed)
 local crate=type(category)=='string' and catalog.Crates[category]
 if not crate or not integer(crate.Price) or crate.Price<1 then return nil,'Unknown crate or invalid price.' end
 local total=0;for _ in pairs(data.HABCrateInventory.Stored) do total=total+1 end
 if total>=R.MaxStored then return nil,'Your crate inventory is full. Open or refund a stored crate first.' end
 local pool,randomCount=R.Pool(data,catalog,category)
 if #pool<=randomCount then return nil,'You already own or have stored enough crates to finish this collection.' end
 local mode,cost='Random',crate.Price
 if choice~=nil then
  local found=false
  if type(choice)=='string' then for _,id in ipairs(pool) do if id==choice then found=true;break end end end
  if not found then return nil,'Select an unowned, unreserved effect for a guaranteed crate.' end
  mode='Guaranteed';cost=math.ceil(crate.Price*(#pool+1)/2)
 elseif randomAllowed~=true then
  return nil,'Random crates are unavailable for this account. Choose a guaranteed effect.'
 end
 if data.Gems<cost then return nil,'Not enough Gems. Claim quests or visit the Gems shop.' end
 return {Category=category,Mode=mode,Choice=choice,Cost=cost,Pool=#pool}
end
function R.Snapshot(data,catalog)
 local inv=data.HABCrateInventory
 local list,counts,pools={},{},{}
 for _,category in ipairs(catalog.Order) do counts[category]=0 end
 for id,c in pairs(inv.Stored) do
  list[#list+1]={Id=id,Category=c.Category,Mode=c.Mode,Choice=c.Choice,Cost=c.Cost,At=c.At}
  counts[c.Category]=(counts[c.Category] or 0)+1
 end
 table.sort(list,function(a,b) if a.At==b.At then return a.Id<b.Id end;return a.At<b.At end)
 for _,category in ipairs(catalog.Order) do
  local ids,random,reserved=R.Pool(data,catalog,category)
  pools[category]={Items=ids,RandomStored=random,Reserved=reserved,CanBuy=#ids>random}
 end
 return list,counts,pools
end
return R

local function shieldOrDodge(candidate,now,a,b)

function S.Tick(actors,now)
 local previous=samples;local current={}
 for _,p in ipairs(actors) do
  local rr,hh,cc=root(p)
  if rr then current[p]={Position=rr.Position,Direction=Rules.Direction(rr.CFrame.LookVector),Character=cc,At=now,Root=rr,Humanoid=hh} end
 end

 if not owner or now>=fuse then endAttack('CANCELLED');return end

 local rec=record(carrier)
 if rec.Queue then
  local q=rec.Queue
  if now>q.Until or q.Character~=c then rec.Queue=nil
  elseif now>=q.At and not attack then rec.Queue=nil;swing(carrier,q.Value,true) end
 end
 if not player(carrier) and not attack then
  -- Practice NPCs can swing; real players always need an input.
  for _,p in ipairs(actors) do local x=current[p]
   if x and p~=carrier and Rules.Swing(r.Position,x.Position,owner.Direction,Config.Swing) then swing(carrier);break end
  end
 end
 if not attack then return end
 local a=attack
 if a.Character~=c or now<lock or (r.Position-a.Origin).Magnitude>90 then endAttack('CANCELLED');return end
 if now<a.Start then return end
 local rp=paramsFor(actors);local contacts={}
 if a.Kind=='Swing' then
  if now>a.End then endAttack(a.BlockedBy or 'MISS');return end
  local dt=math.clamp(now-(a.LastTick or now),0,.08)
  local desired=a.Direction
  if owner.Direction:Dot(a.ServerFacing)<.999 then desired=Rules.Turn(a.Initial,owner.Direction,math.rad(85)) end
  local direction=Rules.Turn(a.Direction,desired,math.rad(540)*dt)
  local prevOwner=previous[carrier]
  for _,p in ipairs(actors) do
   local candidate=current[p]
   if p~=carrier and candidate and not a.Hit[p] and not(p.UserId==protectedId and now<protectedUntil) then
    local torso=candidate.Character:FindFirstChild('UpperTorso') or candidate.Character:FindFirstChild('Torso') or candidate.Root
    local radius=math.clamp(torso.Size.X*.5+.1,.85,1.25)
    local height=math.clamp(torso.Size.Y*.65,1.2,2)
    local result
    local prev=previous[p]
    if prevOwner and prev and prevOwner.Character==c and prev.Character==candidate.Character
     and now-prev.At<=.085 and now-prevOwner.At<=.085
     and (candidate.Position-prev.Position).Magnitude<10 and (owner.Position-prevOwner.Position).Magnitude<10 then
     local start=math.clamp((a.Start-prev.At)/math.max(.001,now-prev.At),0,1)
     result=Rules.Swept(prevOwner.Position:Lerp(owner.Position,start),owner.Position,prev.Position:Lerp(candidate.Position,start),candidate.Position,
      a.Direction,direction,Config.Swing,radius,height)
    else
     local score=Rules.Swing(owner.Position,candidate.Position,direction,Config.Swing,radius,height)
     if score then result={Score=score,A=owner.Position,B=candidate.Position} end
    end
    -- No wall tags: require both the sampled segment and CURRENT bodies to have clear sight.
    if result and (candidate.Position-owner.Position).Magnitude<Config.Swing.Range+radius+1.5
     and lineClear(owner.Position,candidate.Position,rp) and lineClear(result.A,result.B,rp) then
     contacts[#contacts+1]={p,result.Score,candidate.Position}
    end
   end
  end
  a.Direction=direction;a.LastTick=now
 else
  local t=math.min(now-a.Start,Config.Throw.Lifetime)
  local pos=Rules.Projectile(a.Origin,a.Velocity,Config.Throw.Gravity,t)
  local wall=(pos-a.Last).Magnitude>.001 and workspace:Raycast(a.Last,pos-a.Last,rp) or nil
  if wall then pos=wall.Position end
  for _,p in ipairs(actors) do
   local candidate=current[p]
   if p~=carrier and candidate and not(p.UserId==protectedId and now<protectedUntil) and not a.Hit[p] then
    local d,alpha=Rules.SegmentDistance(candidate.Position,a.Last,pos)
    if d<Config.Throw.Radius and lineClear(pos,candidate.Position,rp) then contacts[#contacts+1]={p,alpha,candidate.Position} end
   end
  end
  a.Last=pos
  if #contacts==0 and (wall or now>=a.End) then endAttack('MISS');return end
 end
 table.sort(contacts,function(x,y) if x[2]==y[2] then return x[1].UserId<y[1].UserId end;return x[2]<y[2] end)
 for _,entry in ipairs(contacts) do
  local p,position=entry[1],entry[3]
  local guard=shieldOrDodge(p,now,r.Position,position)
  if guard=='Shield' then endAttack('BLOCKED');return end
  if guard=='Dodge' then a.Hit[p]=true;a.BlockedBy='DODGED'
  else
   emit('TagHit',carrier,{Id=a.Id,Request=a.Request,Target=p,Position=position})
   endAttack('HIT');return p
  end
 end
 if a.Kind=='Throw' and now>=a.End then endAttack('MISS') end
end
function S.Init()
 if started then return end;started=true
 Passes.Init()
 local function setup(p)

]==],[ [==[disabled]==] ]=nil},{[ [==[path]==] ]=[==[ServerScriptService/Services/HABPassService]==],[ [==[class]==] ]=[==[ModuleScript]==],[ [==[old]==] ]=[==[--!nonstrict
-- HAB EXPANSION 7. The server verifies game-pass entitlements; Gems retain ONE receipt handler.
local Players=game:GetService('Players')

local X=RS:WaitForChild('HABExpansion')
local Config=require(X.Config)

local S={};local started=false;local states={};local nextAt={};local offers={}
for _,v in ipairs(Config.Passes) do offers[v.Key]={Definition=v,Kind='Pass'} end
for _,v in ipairs(Config.Bundles) do offers[v.Key]={Definition=v,Kind='Bundle'} end
local function idValid(n) return type(n)=='number' and n==n and n>0 and n%1==0 and n<=9007199254740991 end
function S.Has(p,key)
 local s=states[p];return s and s.Owned[key]==true or false
end
local function deliver(p,key)
 for _,a in ipairs(Config.Abilities) do if a.PassKey==key and a.Currency=='Robux' then return Economy.HABGrantAbilityPass(p,a.Key) end end
 if key=='VIP' then return Economy.HABGrantVIP(p) end

 if offer and offer.Kind=='Bundle' then return Economy.HABGrantBundle(p,key) end

end
local function refresh(p)
 local s=states[p]
 if not s or s.Busy then return end
 s.Busy=true
 for key,offer in pairs(offers) do
  if not p.Parent or states[p]~=s then break end
  local id=offer.Definition.Id
  if idValid(id) then
   local ok,owned=pcall(Market.UserOwnsGamePassAsync,Market,p.UserId,id)
   if ok and owned then s.Owned[key]=true end
   -- On a network failure retain a previously verified entitlement for this server.
   if s.Owned[key] then
    p:SetAttribute('HABPass'..key,true)
    local granted,why=deliver(p,key)
    if not granted then s.Pending=true end
   end
  end
 end
 s.Busy=false;s.Checked=true;p:SetAttribute('HABPassesChecked',true)
end
local function snapshot(p)

function M.ValidArchive(a)

------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------

local function validDirection(
	direction
)

	if typeof(direction)
		~= "Vector3" then

		return false
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- NAN CHECK
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if direction.X ~= direction.X
		or direction.Y ~= direction.Y
		or direction.Z ~= direction.Z then

		return false
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- SHOULD BE MOSTLY HORIZONTAL
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if math.abs(direction.Y)
		> 0.15 then

		return false
	end

	local magnitude =
		Vector3.new(
			direction.X,
			0,
			direction.Z
		).Magnitude

	if magnitude < 0.5
		or magnitude > 1.5 then

		return false
	end

	return true
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- VALIDATE REQUEST
------------------------------------------------------------

local function canGrantIFrame(
	player,
	direction
)

	if not validDirection(
		direction
		) then

		return false
	end

	local character =
		player.Character

	if not character then
		return false
	end

	local humanoid =
		character:FindFirstChildOfClass(
			"Humanoid"
		)

	local root =
		character:FindFirstChild(
			"HumanoidRootPart"
		)

	if not humanoid
		or not root then

		return false
	end

	if humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return false
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- NO I-FRAMES DURING ROUND COUNTDOWN
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if root.Anchored then
		return false
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- DODGE MUST START ON GROUND
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if humanoid.FloorMaterial
		== Enum.Material.Air then

		return false
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- SERVER COOLDOWN
	--------------------------------------------------------

	local now =
		workspace:GetServerTimeNow()

	local previous =
		lastRequest[player]
		or -math.huge

	if now - previous
		< MIN_REQUEST_INTERVAL then

		return false
	end

	lastRequest[player] =
		now

	return true
end

------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------

local function grantIFrames(
	player
)

	local character =
		player.Character

	if not character then
		return
	end

	-- Carrier still dodges and replicates its effects, but receives no immunity.
 if character:GetAttribute('HussBombCarrier')==true then
  character:SetAttribute('BombTagIFrameUntil',0)
  character:SetAttribute('BombTagIFrameActive',false)
  removeIFrameHighlight(character)
  return
 end
	local now =
		workspace:GetServerTimeNow()

	local immunityEnds =
		now
		+ IFRAME_DURATION

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- AUTHORITATIVE TIMESTAMP
	--------------------------------------------------------

	character:SetAttribute(
		"BombTagIFrameUntil",
		immunityEnds
	)

	character:SetAttribute(
		"BombTagIFrameActive",
		true
	)

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- WHITE FLASH / HIGHLIGHT
	--------------------------------------------------------

	showIFrameHighlight(
		character
	)

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- END I-FRAMES
	--------------------------------------------------------

	task.delay(
		IFRAME_DURATION,
		function()

			------------------------------------------------
			-- MAKE SURE IT IS STILL THE SAME CHARACTER
			------------------------------------------------

			if player.Character
				~= character then

				return
			end

			local storedEnd =
				character:GetAttribute(
					"BombTagIFrameUntil"
				) or 0

			------------------------------------------------
			-- ONLY REMOVE IF IMMUNITY ACTUALLY EXPIRED
			------------------------------------------------

			if workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
				>= storedEnd then

				character:SetAttribute(
					"BombTagIFrameActive",
					false
				)

				removeIFrameHighlight(
					character
				)
			end
		end
	)
end

	end

end
local function frame(x,y,z,rx,ry,rz)
	return CF(x,y,z)*CFrame.Angles(rad(rx),rad(ry),rad(rz))
end
function A.Sample(action, elapsed, r15, reducedMotion)
	local direction=A.Directions[action]
	if not direction or type(elapsed)~="number" or elapsed~=elapsed or elapsed<0 or elapsed>=A.Duration then
		return {Weight=0, Poses={}}
	end
	local w,load,drive,turn,reach,plant,recoil=table.unpack(channels(elapsed))
	local side,front=direction[1],direction[2]
	local lateral=math.abs(side)
	local forward,back=math.max(front,0),math.max(-front,0)
	local lead=side~=0 and (side>0 and 1 or -1) or 1
	local intensity=reducedMotion and .72 or 1
	-- Forward rolls a shoulder past the carrier; side dodges power-step; back dodges brace.
	local pitch=(-49*forward+27*back-22*lateral)*drive+8*recoil-9*load*(1-math.abs(drive))
	local roll=(-37*side-22*forward*(1-lateral)+8*back*(1-lateral))*drive
	local yaw=(24*side-25*forward*(1-lateral)+12*back*(1-lateral))*turn
	pitch,roll,yaw=pitch*intensity,roll*intensity,yaw*intensity
	local p={}
	local rootShare=r15 and .44 or 1
	p.root=frame(side*.26*drive,0,-forward*.17*drive+back*.08*drive,
		pitch*rootShare,yaw*.72,roll*(r15 and .56 or 1))
	p.waist=frame(0,0,0,pitch*.56,yaw*.28,roll*.44)
	-- Head stays on the opponent while the shoulder passes underneath.
	p.neck=frame(0,0,0,-pitch*.78,-yaw*.82,-roll*.72)
	for _,entry in ipairs({{"left",-1},{"right",1}}) do
		local name,sign=entry[1],entry[2]
		local leading=sign==lead and 1 or -1
		local guard=load*(45+38*back)
		local pump=(-leading*57*forward+leading*14*lateral)*drive
		local armPitch=14+guard+pump+18*plant*leading-12*recoil
		local armYaw=sign*(12*load+20*forward*turn)-yaw*.2
		local armRoll=sign*(16+22*load+19*lateral*drive)-side*15*drive
		p[name.."Arm"]=frame(0,0,0,armPitch,armYaw,armRoll)
		p[name.."Elbow"]=frame(0,0,0,36+49*load+18*back*drive,0,0)
		-- R6 has rigid legs: counter-bank the hip, then reach and cross-step at recovery.
		local counterPitch=-pitch*(r15 and .44 or .92)
		local hipPitch=counterPitch+(r15 and 31*load or 0)
			+leading*(forward*34-back*25)*reach-leading*18*plant
		local hipRoll=-roll*(r15 and .48 or .86)+sign*(7*load+19*lateral*reach)
		p[name.."Hip"]=frame(0,0,0,hipPitch,-yaw*.28+leading*5*turn,hipRoll)
		p[name.."Knee"]=frame(0,0,0,-(45+leading*12)*load-18*math.max(leading*reach,0),0,0)
		p[name.."Ankle"]=frame(0,0,0,24*load+7*plant,0,-hipRoll*.35)
	end
	return {Weight=w, Poses=p}
end

-- Bind axes differ between R6 shoulders/hips and R15 joints. Author poses in body axes.
function A.JointTransform(joint, pose)
	local axes=joint.C0.Rotation
	return axes:Inverse()*pose*axes
end

-- Forward kinematics only: never move an actual BasePart. This keeps the lowest foot
-- on its normal plane as the torso ducks, including rotated R6 hip bind frames.
function A.FootHeight(joints, root, transforms, feet)
	local frames={[root]=CFrame.new()}
	for _=1,7 do
		local advanced=false
		for _,record in ipairs(joints) do
			local j=record.motor
			if j.Parent and j.Enabled and j.Part0 and j.Part1 and frames[j.Part0] and not frames[j.Part1] then
				frames[j.Part1]=frames[j.Part0]*j.C0*(transforms and transforms[j] or CFrame.new())*j.C1:Inverse()
				advanced=true
			end
		end
		if not advanced then break end
	end
	local lowest
	for _,foot in ipairs(feet) do
		local cf=frames[foot]
		if cf and foot.Parent then
			local half=foot.Size*.5
			local extent=math.abs(cf.RightVector.Y)*half.X+math.abs(cf.UpVector.Y)*half.Y+math.abs(cf.LookVector.Y)*half.Z
			local y=cf.Position.Y-extent
			lowest=lowest and math.min(lowest,y) or y
		end
	end
	return lowest
end
return A

local function finite(v) return type(v)=="number" and v==v and math.abs(v)<math.huge end
local function smooth(v) return v*v*(3-2*v) end
local function mirrorRole(role) return role:gsub("right","_LEFT_"):gsub("left","right"):gsub("_LEFT_","left") end
function A.Resolve(kind,sequence)
 if kind~="Swing" then return clips[kind] and kind or nil,false end
 local n=finite(sequence) and math.max(1,math.floor(sequence)) or 1
 return n%3==0 and "Hammer" or "Swing",n%3==2
end
function A.Duration(kind,options)
 local c=clips[kind];if not c then return 0 end
 local d=options and options.Duration
 return finite(d) and math.clamp(d,.24,2) or c.Duration
end
function A.Sample(kind,age,options)
 local c=clips[kind];if not c or not finite(age) or age<0 then return nil end
 options=options or {};local duration=A.Duration(kind,options)
 if age>=duration then return nil end
 local t=age*c.Duration/duration
 -- Keep strike contact aligned to the authoritative hit window, including changed tuning.
 if c.Contact and finite(options.Contact) then
  local at=math.clamp(options.Contact,.025,duration-.08)
  if age<=at then t=age/at*c.Contact else t=c.Contact+(age-at)/(duration-at)*(c.Duration-c.Contact) end
 end
 local a,b=c.Frames[1],c.Frames[#c.Frames]
 for i=2,#c.Frames do if t<=c.Frames[i].Time then a,b=c.Frames[i-1],c.Frames[i];break end end
 local u=math.clamp((t-a.Time)/math.max(.0001,b.Time-a.Time),0,1)
 if b.Ease=="out" then u=1-(1-u)^3 elseif b.Ease~="linear" then u=smooth(u) end
 local envelope=smooth(math.clamp(age/.045,0,1))*smooth(math.clamp((duration-age)/.16,0,1))
 local sample={Name=kind,Weight=envelope,Pose={},Priority=c.Priority,LegWeight=c.LegWeight,Duration=duration}
 for _,role in ipairs(roles) do
  local from,to=a.Pose[role],b.Pose[role];local values={}
  for n=1,6 do values[n]=from[n]+(to[n]-from[n])*u end
  local outputRole=role
  if options.Mirror then outputRole=mirrorRole(role);values[2]=-values[2];values[3]=-values[3];values[4]=-values[4] end
  sample.Pose[outputRole]=values
 end
 return sample
end
function A.JointInfo(joint)
 if not (joint:IsA("Motor6D") or joint:IsA("AnimationConstraint")) then return nil end
 local child=joint.Part1;local basis=joint.C0
 if not child and joint:IsA("AnimationConstraint") then
  local attachment=joint.Attachment1;child=attachment and attachment.Parent
  local origin=joint.Attachment0;basis=origin and origin.CFrame
 end
 local role=child and A.JointRoles[child.Name]
 if not role or not basis then return nil end
 return {Object=joint,Role=role,Axes=basis.Rotation}
end
function A.Transform(sample,role,r15,reduced)
 local values=sample.Pose[role] or ZERO
 local x,y,z,tx,ty,tz=table.unpack(values)
 if role=="root" and r15 then x*=.38;y*=.45;z*=.42
 elseif role=="waist" and r15 then x*=.62;y*=.55;z*=.58
 elseif role=="root" then
  -- R6 has no waist: merge the authored upper torso contribution into its sole torso joint.
  local upper=sample.Pose.waist or ZERO
  x=x*.38+upper[1]*.62;y=y*.45+upper[2]*.55;z=z*.42+upper[3]*.58
 end
 if sample.Name=="Jester" and role=="root" then
  -- The spin belongs to the cosmetic root, not the physical HumanoidRootPart or camera.
  -- Preserve the complete turn; a 360-degree finish is exactly the locomotion orientation.
  y=reduced and math.sin(math.rad(values[2]))*14 or values[2]
 end
 return CFrame.new(tx,ty,tz)*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(x),math.rad(y),math.rad(z))
end
function A.Weight(sample,role,moving,reduced)
 local w=sample.Weight
 if role:find("Hip") or role:find("Knee") or role:find("Ankle") then w*=moving and sample.LegWeight or math.max(.35,sample.LegWeight) end
 if reduced then w*=.55 end
 return w
end
-- Evaluate the joint chain without moving a part. Grounded actions keep the lowest
-- foot at the live Animator's plane while airborne abilities retain their leg tuck.
function A.FootHeight(joints,root,transforms,feet)
 local frames={[root]=CFrame.identity}
 for _=1,7 do
  local changed=false
  for _,record in ipairs(joints) do
   local joint=record.Object
   if joint.Parent and joint.Enabled and joint.Part0 and joint.Part1 and frames[joint.Part0] and not frames[joint.Part1] then
    frames[joint.Part1]=frames[joint.Part0]*joint.C0*(transforms[joint] or CFrame.identity)*joint.C1:Inverse()
    changed=true
   end
  end
  if not changed then break end
 end
 local lowest
 for _,foot in ipairs(feet) do
  local cf=frames[foot]
  if cf and foot.Parent then
   local half=foot.Size*.5
   local extent=math.abs(cf.RightVector.Y)*half.X+math.abs(cf.UpVector.Y)*half.Y+math.abs(cf.LookVector.Y)*half.Z
   local height=cf.Position.Y-extent
   lowest=lowest and math.min(lowest,height) or height
  end
 end
 return lowest
end
return A

local function part(s,parent,name,x,y,z,w,h,d,color,collide,material,rotation,class)

local function terrace(s,p,name,x,z,w,d,h,axis,run,color)

  ramp:SetAttribute("HABRampV16",true);ramp:SetAttribute("Width",rw);ramp:SetAttribute("Rise",h);ramp:SetAttribute("Run",run)
  ramp:SetAttribute("Start",start);ramp:SetAttribute("End",target)
  -- Flush painted approach marks do not introduce a curb at the ramp foot.
  local foot=start+delta.Unit*2
  detail(s,g,"Ramp approach stripe",foot.X,.025,foot.Z,axis=="X" and 1 or rw,.035,axis=="X" and rw or 1,paper)

   detail(s,g,"Rail color",x+side*(w/2-.6),h+3.23,z,1.25,.15,d-1,s.Entry.Accent)
  end
 end

local function triangle(s,p,a,b,c,thickness,color,collide,name)
 local ab,ac,bc=b-a,c-a,c-b
 if ab:Dot(ab)>ac:Dot(ac) and ab:Dot(ab)>bc:Dot(bc) then c,a=a,c
 elseif ac:Dot(ac)>bc:Dot(bc) then a,b=b,a end
 ab,ac,bc=b-a,c-a,c-b
 local right=ac:Cross(ab).Unit;local back=bc.Unit;local up=bc:Cross(right).Unit
 local height=math.abs(ab:Dot(up))
 for i,info in ipairs({{(a+b)/2,right,back,math.abs(ab:Dot(back))},{(a+c)/2,-right,-back,math.abs(ac:Dot(back))}}) do
  if info[4]>.005 then
   local q=info[1];local o=part(s,p,name,q.X,q.Y,q.Z,thickness,height,info[4],color,collide,nil,nil,"WedgePart")
   o.CFrame=CFrame.fromMatrix(q,info[2],up,info[3]);o:SetAttribute("HABGroundV16",true)
  end
 end
end
local function inside(poly,x,z,margin)
 local yes=false;local j=#poly
 for i,a in ipairs(poly) do
  local b=poly[j]
  if (a.Z>z)~=(b.Z>z) and x<(b.X-a.X)*(z-a.Z)/(b.Z-a.Z)+a.X then yes=not yes end
  local edge=b-a;local q=V(x,0,z)-a;local t=math.clamp(q:Dot(edge)/edge:Dot(edge),0,1)
  if (q-edge*t).Magnitude<(margin or 0) then return false end
  j=i
 end
 return yes
end
local function foundation(s,m)
 local e=s.Entry;local ground=folder(m,"Arena foundation","Model")
 local ref=part(s,m,"Floor",0,-2,0,e.W,4,e.D,e.Ground,false);ref.Transparency=1;ref.CastShadow=false;m.PrimaryPart=ref
 for i,a in ipairs(s.Polygon) do
  local b=s.Polygon[i%#s.Polygon+1]
  -- The dark lower shell ends below the colored floor: no coplanar surfaces.
  triangle(s,ground,V(0,-2.48,0),a-V(0,2.48,0),b-V(0,2.48,0),4.6,ink,false,"Bold foundation")
  triangle(s,ground,V(0,-1.4,0),a-V(0,1.4,0),b-V(0,1.4,0),2.8,e.Ground,true,"Continuous floor")

local LayoutKeys={"Orbital","Pirate","Neon","Emerald","Sky","Ember","Clockwork","Frost","Crystal","Sunset","Sunstone","Stardust","Fuse","Detonator","Payload"}

-- Theme-specific silhouettes and restrained surface detail. These are authored
-- around the large, already-clear routes; small trim never becomes collision.
local function roof(s,p,x,z,w,d,base,rise,color)
 for _,side in ipairs({-1,1}) do
  for layer=0,1 do
   local rw,rd=w+2.5-layer*.55,d+2.5-layer*.55
   part(s,p,layer==0 and "Roof ink edge" or "Pitched roof",x,base+rise/2+layer*.22,z+side*rd/4,rw,rise,rd/2,layer==0 and ink or color,false,nil,CFrame.Angles(0,side<0 and 0 or math.pi,0),"WedgePart")
  end
 end
 beam(s,p,"Roof ridge",V(x-w/2-1,base+rise+.28,z),V(x+w/2+1,base+rise+.28,z),.6,.6,ink,false)
end
local function gear(s,p,x,y,z,radius,color)
 -- A real 3D cog outline with twelve broad teeth, not a texture billboard.
 local face=part(s,p,"Gear hub",x,y,z,2,radius*2,radius*2,ink,false,nil,CFrame.Angles(0,math.pi/2,0));face.Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder
 local inner=part(s,p,"Gear enamel",x,y,z+.08,2.2,radius*1.62,radius*1.62,color,false,nil,CFrame.Angles(0,math.pi/2,0));inner.Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder
 for i=0,11 do local a=i*math.pi/6
  detail(s,p,"Cog tooth",x+math.cos(a)*radius,y+math.sin(a)*radius,z,3.6,4.5,2.6,ink,nil,CFrame.Angles(0,0,a-math.pi/2))
 end
 local axle=part(s,p,"Gear axle",x,y,z+.15,3,radius*.45,radius*.45,ink,false,nil,CFrame.Angles(0,math.pi/2,0));axle.Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder
end
local function flowerbed(s,p,x,z,w,d,c)
 local bed=cover(s,p,x,z,w,d,R(101,161,116),1.1)
 for i=-2,2 do
  local bx=x+i*w/6
  detail(s,bed,"Flower stem",bx,1.8,z,.25,1.4,.25,ink)
  ball(s,bed,"Round blossom",bx,2.7,z,1.8,c,false)
  ball(s,bed,"Flower center",bx,3.1,z+.4,.65,gold,false)
 end
end
local function arch(s,p,x,z,w,h,color)
 for _,side in ipairs({-1,1}) do
  block(s,p,"Arch pillar",x+side*w/2,h/2,z,3.4,h,4.8,ink)
  detail(s,p,"Pillar enamel",x+side*w/2,h/2,z,2.7,h-.6,5,color)
 end
 detail(s,p,"Arch lintel",x,h,z,w+4,3.8,5.6,ink)
 detail(s,p,"Arch colored inset",x,h+.3,z,w+3.3,2.9,5.9,color)
end
local function themes(s,p,key)
 local e=s.Entry
 if key=="Orbital" then
  -- A wide radar dish at the far edge and soft, rounded airlock roofs.
  for _,x in ipairs({-70,70}) do
   local cap=ball(s,p,"Rounded pressure dome",x,18,-46,25,e.Trim,false);cap.Size=V(27,9,24)
   for _,offset in ipairs({-8,8}) do detail(s,p,"Airlock rib",x+offset,15,-32,1.2,13,1,paper) end
  end
  block(s,p,"Radar pedestal",0,7,-84,4,14,4,ink)
  local dish=ball(s,p,"Radar dish",0,15,-84,23,paper,false);dish.Size=V(25,6,25)
  detail(s,p,"Radar antenna",0,21,-84,.75,13,.75,e.Accent);ball(s,p,"Radar tip",0,27,-84,2.4,e.Trim,false)
  for _,x in ipairs({-31,31}) do
   for _,z in ipairs({-63,63}) do detail(s,p,"Airlock direction tile",x,.04,z,4,.06,12,e.Accent) end
  end
 elseif key=="Pirate" then
  for _,side in ipairs({-1,1}) do
   detail(s,p,"Ship gunwale",-32+side*18,11.6,-4,1.5,1.7,69,ink)
   for z=-26,18,22 do
    local ring=part(s,p,"Brass porthole",-32+side*19.1,5.4,z,.45,4.6,4.6,gold,false);ring.Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder
    local pane=part(s,p,"Porthole glass",-32+side*19.4,5.4,z,.25,3.4,3.4,ink,false);pane.Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder
   end
  end
  roof(s,p,59,-46,31,25,16.2,6,e.Trim)
  for _,q in ipairs({{74,64},{-94,-18},{-85,70}}) do
   local rock=ball(s,p,"Beach boulder",q[1],1.6,q[2],8,R(198,180,139),false);rock.Size=V(10,3.3,8)
  end
  -- Native water inlays are flush walkable visual sandbars, never kill pits.
  disc(s,p,"Tidal pool ink",78,.025,-1,18,.035,ink,false)
  disc(s,p,"Tidal blue",78,.05,-1,16.9,.03,e.Trim,false)

local function spawnClear(s,x,z)
 if not inside(s.Polygon,x,z,9) then return false end
 for _,o in ipairs(s.Solids) do
  if not o:GetAttribute("HABGroundV16") and not o:GetAttribute("HABBoundaryV16") then
   local localPoint=o.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(V(x,2,z))
   -- Conservatively avoid all ramp footprints, cover and architecture; no
   -- world raycast is needed while models are detached in ServerStorage.
   if math.abs(localPoint.X)<o.Size.X/2+4 and math.abs(localPoint.Z)<o.Size.Z/2+4 and o.Position.Y+o.Size.Y/2>.2 then return false end
  end
 end
 for _,q in ipairs(s.SpawnPositions) do if (V(x,0,z)-q).Magnitude<13 then return false end end
 return true
end
local function spawns(s,m)
 local f=folder(m,"Spawns")
 for i=1,16 do
  local chosen
  local base=(i-1)*math.pi*2/16
  for _,radius in ipairs({.80,.73,.86,.65,.57,.49}) do
   for _,offset in ipairs({0,.055,-.055,.11,-.11,.17,-.17,.24,-.24,.30,-.30}) do
    local a=base+offset;local x=math.cos(a)*s.Entry.W*.5*radius;local z=math.sin(a)*s.Entry.D*.5*radius
    if spawnClear(s,x,z) then chosen=V(x,0,z);break end
   end
   if chosen then break end
  end
  assert(chosen,"No clear spawn sector "..i.." in "..s.Entry.Name)
  table.insert(s.SpawnPositions,chosen)
  local marker=part(s,f,string.format("Spawn%02d",i),chosen.X,.2,chosen.Z,4,.4,4,paper,false)
  marker.Transparency=1;marker.CastShadow=false;marker.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(chosen+V(0,.2,0),V(0,.2,0))
  marker:SetAttribute("HABSpawnV16",true)
  disc(s,m,"Flush spawn rim",chosen.X,.025,chosen.Z,5.4,.04,ink:Lerp(s.Entry.Ground,.6),false)
  disc(s,m,"Flush spawn pad",chosen.X,.055,chosen.Z,4.7,.035,s.Entry.Ground:Lerp(paper,.35),false)
 end
end
function Builder.Build(name,parent,origin)
 local entry,index
 for i,e in ipairs(Catalog) do if e.Name==name then entry,index=e,i;break end end
 assert(entry,"Unknown HAB map: "..tostring(name))
 assert(parent==nil or typeof(parent)=="Instance","Build parent must be an Instance or nil")
 origin=origin or V(0,0,0);assert(typeof(origin)=="Vector3","Build origin must be Vector3")
 local model=folder(nil,name,"Model")
 local ok,err=pcall(function()
  model:SetAttribute("HABMapVersion",16);model:SetAttribute("HABWorldVersion",16);model:SetAttribute("DisplayName",name);model:SetAttribute("VotedMap",name)
  model:SetAttribute("NoJumpRequired",true);model:SetAttribute("RouteDescription",entry.Route)
  model:SetAttribute("MapWidth",entry.W);model:SetAttribute("MapDepth",entry.D)
  local s={Entry=entry,Solids={},Polygon=polygon(entry),SpawnPositions={}}
  foundation(s,model)
  local geometry=folder(model,"Themed architecture","Model")
  Layouts[LayoutKeys[index]](s,geometry)
  themes(s,geometry,LayoutKeys[index])
  spawns(s,model)
  model:SetAttribute("DeckCenter",V(s.Deck.X,s.Deck.Height,s.Deck.Z))
  model:SetAttribute("DeckAxis",s.Deck.Axis)
  local count=0;for _,d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("BasePart") then count+=1 end end
  assert(count<=400,"Map part budget exceeded: "..name.." ("..count..")")
  model:SetAttribute("BasePartCount",count)
  -- PrimaryPart top is the anchor contract used by unmodified map voting.
  if origin.Magnitude>0 then model:PivotTo(model:GetPivot()+origin) end
 end)
 if not ok then model:Destroy();error("[HAB Maps V16 / "..name.."] "..tostring(err),2) end
 model.Parent=parent;return model
end
function Builder.BuildAll(parent)
 local staging=folder(nil,"MapLibrary")
 local ok,err=pcall(function() for _,e in ipairs(Catalog) do Builder.Build(e.Name,staging) end end)
 if not ok then staging:Destroy();error(err,2) end
 staging:SetAttribute("HABMapVersion",16);staging:SetAttribute("HABWorldVersion",16);staging.Parent=parent;return staging
end
function Builder.BuildArchive(options)
 options=options or {}
 local root=folder(nil,"HABMapsV16Staging")
 local ok,err=pcall(function()
  local maps=Builder.BuildAll(root)
  local previews=folder(root,"BombTagV6Previews")
  for _,m in ipairs(maps:GetChildren()) do local c=m:Clone();c.Parent=previews end
  local legacy=folder(root,"BombTagPreviewGalleryV5")
  for _,name in ipairs({"Sky Garden","Sunset Docks","Neon District","Crystal Cavern"}) do local c=maps:FindFirstChild(name):Clone();c.Parent=legacy end
  local active=folder(root,"Maps")
  local name=options.VotedMap or "Sunset Docks"
  local template=maps:FindFirstChild(name);assert(template,"Active voted map missing: "..tostring(name))
  local c=template:Clone();c.Name=options.MapName or "Sky Garden"
  local origin=options.Anchor or V(0,-27,-190)
  c:PivotTo(c:GetPivot()+origin);c:SetAttribute("DisplayName",name);c:SetAttribute("VotedMap",name);c.Parent=active
  for _,f in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do f:SetAttribute("HABWorldVersion",16) end
 end)
 if not ok then root:Destroy();error("[HAB Maps V16 archive] "..tostring(err),2) end
 return root
end
return Builder

end)()

local function model(parent,name)
 local o=Instance.new('Model');o.Name=name;o.Parent=parent;return o
end
local function part(parent,name,x,y,z,w,h,d,color,solid,rotation,kind)
 local o=Instance.new(kind or 'Part');o.Name=name;o.Size=V(w,h,d);o.CFrame=CF(x,y,z)*(rotation or CFrame.identity)
 o.Color=color;o.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic;o.Anchored=true;o.CanCollide=solid==true
 o.CanTouch=false;o.CanQuery=solid==true;o.CastShadow=solid==true
 o.TopSurface=Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth;o.BottomSurface=Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth;o.Parent=parent;return o
end
local function disc(parent,name,x,y,z,w,h,d,color,solid)
 local o=part(parent,name,x,y,z,h,w,d,color,solid,CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.pi/2));o.Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder;return o
end
local function ball(parent,name,x,y,z,w,h,d,color)
 local o=part(parent,name,x,y,z,w,h,d,color,false);o.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball;return o
end
local function rounded(parent,name,x,y,z,w,h,d,r,color,solid)
 local g=model(parent,name)
 part(g,'Center',x,y,z,w-2*r,h,d,color,solid)
 part(g,'Cross',x,y,z,w,h+.002,d-2*r,color,solid)
 local i=0
 for _,sx in ipairs({-1,1}) do for _,sz in ipairs({-1,1}) do
  i+=1;disc(g,'Soft corner',x+sx*(w/2-r),y,z+sz*(d/2-r),2*r,h+.004+i*.002,2*r,color,solid)
 end end
 return g
end

 local board=part(parent,title,x,y,z,w,h,.3,ink,false,rotation)
 local gui=Instance.new('SurfaceGui');gui.Name='HABSignV16';gui.Face=Enum.NormalId.Back
 gui.SizingMode=Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.PixelsPerStud;gui.PixelsPerStud=72;gui.LightInfluence=0;gui.MaxDistance=220;gui.Parent=board
 local body=Instance.new('Frame');body.Name='Body';body.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1);body.BackgroundColor3=tone;body.BorderSizePixel=0;body.Parent=gui
 local corner=Instance.new('UICorner');corner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(.12,0);corner.Parent=body
 local outline=Instance.new('UIStroke');outline.Color=ink;outline.Thickness=4;outline.Parent=body
 local gloss=Instance.new('Frame');gloss.Name='Gloss';gloss.Size=UDim2.fromScale(.96,.3);gloss.Position=UDim2.fromScale(.02,.04);gloss.BackgroundColor3=R(255,255,255);gloss.BackgroundTransparency=.82;gloss.BorderSizePixel=0;gloss.Parent=body
 for i,text in ipairs({title,subtitle}) do
  local label=Instance.new('TextLabel');label.Name=i==1 and 'Heading' or 'Subtitle';label.BackgroundTransparency=1
  label.Position=UDim2.fromScale(.04,i==1 and .08 or .62);label.Size=UDim2.fromScale(.92,i==1 and .52 or .28)
  label.Text=text;label.TextScaled=true;label.TextColor3=R(255,255,255);label.TextStrokeColor3=ink;label.TextStrokeTransparency=.05
  label.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;label.Parent=body
 end
 return board
end
local function beam(parent,name,a,b,width,height,color,solid)
 local center=(a+b)/2
 return part(parent,name,center.X,center.Y,center.Z,width,height,(b-a).Magnitude,color,solid,CFrame.lookAt(a,b).Rotation)
end
local function rail(parent,a,b)
 -- A low visual rail leaves players visible below; the invisible wall stops a weave escape.
 beam(parent,'Low viewing rail',a+V(0,2.6,0),b+V(0,2.6,0),.42,.42,gold,false)
 local glass=beam(parent,'Clear guard',a+V(0,1.35,0),b+V(0,1.35,0),.24,2.7,cyan,false);glass.Material=Enum.Material.Glass;glass.Transparency=.78
 local blocker=beam(parent,'Invisible safety boundary',a+V(0,45,0),b+V(0,45,0),.6,90,ink,true);blocker.Transparency=1;blocker.CanQuery=false;blocker.CastShadow=false
 local n=math.ceil((b-a).Magnitude/24)
 for i=0,n do local p=a:Lerp(b,i/n);part(parent,'Rail post',p.X,p.Y+1.35,p.Z,.6,2.7,.6,stone,true) end
end
local function planter(parent,x,z)
 local g=model(parent,'Corner garden')
 disc(g,'Planter',x,2.5,z,11,2,11,stone,true)
 disc(g,'Cream rim',x,3.56,z,11.3,.15,11.3,cream,false)
 disc(g,'Soil',x,3.65,z,9.8,.08,9.8,ink,false)
 part(g,'Trunk',x,6,z,1.1,5,1.1,wood,false).Material=Enum.Material.Wood
 ball(g,'Canopy',x,10,z,9,8,9,leaf);ball(g,'Crown',x+1,12,z,6,5,6,sage)
end
local function bench(parent,x,z,rotation)
 local g=model(parent,'Courtyard bench');local cf=CF(x,1.5,z)*CFrame.Angles(0,rotation,0)
 for _,v in ipairs({{'Seat',0,1.6,0,9,.4,2.7,wood},{'Back',0,2.4,-1.2,9,1.6,.35,wood},{'Leg',-3,.8,0,.5,1.6,2.4,ink},{'Leg',3,.8,0,.5,1.6,2.4,ink}}) do
  local o=part(g,v[1],v[2],v[3],v[4],v[5],v[6],v[7],v[8],true);o.CFrame=cf*o.CFrame
 end
end
local function utility(parent,name,title,subtitle,x,tone,panel)
 local g=model(parent,name);local cf=yaw(x,1.5,155,180)
 part(g,'Counter',0,1.8,0,16,3.6,5,stone,true)
 part(g,'Counter top',0,3.8,0,17,.4,5.8,cream,false)
 for _,s in ipairs({-1,1}) do part(g,'Canopy support',s*7,7.5,-3,.9,15,.9,wood,true) end
 part(g,'Canopy',0,15,-.5,18,.65,10,cream,false)
 for i=-3,3 do part(g,'Canopy stripe',i*2.4,15.36,-.5,1.2,.05,10,tone,false) end
 sign(g,title,subtitle,0,11.3,3.4,15,4.1,tone)
 local anchor=part(g,'BrowseStand',0,4,5.5,1,1,1,tone,false);anchor.Transparency=1
 local prompt=Instance.new('ProximityPrompt');prompt.Name='BrowseUtilities';prompt.ActionText='Browse';prompt.ObjectText=title
 prompt.KeyboardKeyCode=Enum.KeyCode.E;prompt.GamepadKeyCode=Enum.KeyCode.ButtonX;prompt.RequiresLineOfSight=false;prompt.MaxActivationDistance=12;prompt.HoldDuration=0
 prompt:SetAttribute('HABOpenPanel',panel);prompt:SetAttribute('HABOffer','');prompt.Parent=anchor
 for _,o in ipairs(g:GetDescendants()) do if o:IsA('BasePart') then o.CFrame=cf*o.CFrame end end
 return g
end
function B.Build(parent)
 local root=model(parent,'HABLobbyLayoutV16');root:SetAttribute('HABLobbyLayoutVersion',16)
 local terraces=model(root,'Open spectator terrace')
 -- Same five-stud terrace height as the original. The viewing footprint is a broad capsule.
 rounded(terraces,'Terrace foundation',0,4,0,148,5,80,10,stone,true)
 rounded(terraces,'Terrace paving',0,6.53,0,147,.04,79,9.5,cream,false)
 -- An unobstructed 128-stud front edge, with two short rounded corner segments.
 local front={V(-74,6.5,0),V(-74,6.5,-28),V(-71,6.5,-35),V(-64,6.5,-39.7),V(64,6.5,-39.7),V(71,6.5,-35),V(74,6.5,-28),V(74,6.5,0)}
 for i=1,#front-1 do rail(terraces,front[i],front[i+1]) end
 for _,s in ipairs({-1,1}) do
  rail(terraces,V(s*74,6.5,0),V(s*74,6.5,40))
  rail(terraces,V(s*.4,6.5,40),V(s*39,6.5,40))
  rail(terraces,V(s*69,6.5,40),V(s*74,6.5,40))
  local ramp=part(terraces,'Broad no-jump ramp',s*54,4,52,28,5,24,cream,true,CFrame.Angles(0,math.pi,0),'WedgePart')
  ramp:SetAttribute('NoJumpRoute',true);ramp:SetAttribute('Rise',5);ramp:SetAttribute('Run',24)
 end
 local inlays=model(terraces,'Spectator floor accents')
 part(inlays,'Gold arrival inlay',0,6.565,31,104,.025,.3,gold,false)
 for _,side in ipairs({-1,1}) do
  local x=side*63
  disc(inlays,'Bomb emblem rim',x,6.57,14,10,.025,10,side<0 and cyan or gold,false)
  disc(inlays,'Bomb emblem',x,6.59,14,8.8,.025,8.8,ink,false)
  part(inlays,'Fuse inlay',x+3,6.61,9.5,.65,.025,3,cream,false,CFrame.Angles(0,-.5,0))
 end
 local walks=model(root,'Organized market walks')
 -- Same cream paving as the original. Dedicated shop approaches stay out of the center runway.
 part(walks,'West shopping walk',-73,1.58,97,20,.06,138,cream,false)
 part(walks,'East bundle walk',73,1.58,88,20,.06,120,cream,false)
 part(walks,'Utility approach',48,1.59,144,68,.06,14,cream,false)
 part(walks,'Rear board walk',0,1.57,168.5,146,.04,12,cream,false)
 local gardens=model(root,'Light courtyard planting')
 for _,s in ipairs({-1,1}) do planter(gardens,s*88,173);planter(gardens,s*89,14);bench(gardens,s*48,113,-s*math.pi/2) end
 local edge=model(root,'Perimeter')
 for _,s in ipairs({-1,1}) do
  part(edge,'Original-style side wall',s*101,4.5,Z0,2,6,188,stone,true)
  part(edge,'Cream coping',s*101,7.55,Z0,2.5,.4,188,cream,false)
  local boundary=part(edge,'Side invisible boundary',s*102,46.5,Z0,1,90,188,ink,true);boundary.Transparency=1;boundary.CanQuery=false;boundary.CastShadow=false
  -- Join outer wall to the raised terrace: no opening around the spectator edge.
  local join=part(edge,'North wing boundary',s*88,46.5,-7.34,28,90,1,ink,true);join.Transparency=1;join.CanQuery=false;join.CastShadow=false
  part(edge,'North wing wall',s*88,4.5,-6.34,28,6,2,stone,true)
 end
 part(edge,'Arrival wall',0,4.5,179.66,200,6,2,stone,true)
 part(edge,'Arrival coping',0,7.55,179.66,200,.4,2.5,cream,false)
 local rear=part(edge,'Arrival invisible boundary',0,46.5,180.66,204,90,1,ink,true);rear.Transparency=1;rear.CanQuery=false;rear.CastShadow=false
 local utilities=model(root,'Utilities row')
 utility(utilities,'Abilities booth','ABILITIES','CHOOSE YOUR PLAYSTYLE',48,cyan,'ABILITIES')
 utility(utilities,'Passes booth','PASSES','PERMANENT PERKS',70,gold,'PASSES')
 return root
end
local function find(root,path)
 local node=root
 for name in path:gmatch('[^/]+') do
  local found
  for _,c in ipairs(node:GetChildren()) do if c.Name==name then assert(not found,'Duplicate '..path);found=c end end
  assert(found,'Missing '..root:GetFullName()..'/'..path);node=found
 end
 return node
end
local function close(a,b)
 local aa,bb={a:GetComponents()},{b:GetComponents()}
 for i=1,12 do if math.abs(aa[i]-bb[i])>.002 then return false end end
 return true
end
function B.Plan(lobby,arenaAnchor)
 assert(lobby and lobby:IsA('Model'),'Workspace/Lobby missing')
 assert(not lobby:FindFirstChild('HABPolishedLobbyV15'),'V16 targets HABWAS or V16; restore HABWAS before installing')
 local floor=find(lobby,'Floor');local spawn=find(lobby,'LobbySpawn')
 assert(floor:IsA('BasePart') and floor.Size==V(204,6,188) and close(floor.CFrame,CF(0,-1.5,Z0)),'Unrecognized lobby floor')
 assert(spawn:IsA('SpawnLocation') and close(spawn.CFrame,CF(0,2,150.66000366210938)),'Unrecognized LobbySpawn')
 assert(arenaAnchor and arenaAnchor:IsA('BasePart'),'ActiveArenaAnchor missing')
 local previous=lobby:FindFirstChild('HABLobbyLayoutV16')
 if previous then assert(previous:IsA('Model') and previous:GetAttribute('HABLobbyLayoutVersion')==16,'Unknown V16 lobby root') end
 local expectedArena=previous and CF(0,-27,-190) or CF(0,-27,-245)
 assert(close(arenaAnchor.CFrame,expectedArena),'ActiveArenaAnchor moved unexpectedly')
 local moves={}
 for _,entry in ipairs(layouts()) do
  local obj=find(lobby,entry.Path);assert(obj:IsA('Model'),'Expected booth Model '..entry.Path)
  local anchor=find(obj,entry.Anchor);assert(anchor:IsA('BasePart'),'Missing anchor '..entry.Path)
  assert(close(anchor.CFrame,previous and entry.New or entry.Old),'Booth layout differs at '..entry.Path..'; stopping before modification')
  if not previous then table.insert(moves,{Model=obj,Delta=entry.New*anchor.CFrame:Inverse(),Path=entry.Path}) end
 end
 local archives={}
 if not previous then for _,path in ipairs(ARCHIVES) do local o=find(lobby,path);assert(o:IsA('Model'),'Expected original architecture Model');table.insert(archives,o) end end
 local texts={}
 for _,row in ipairs(SIGN_CHANGES) do
  local label=find(lobby,row[1]);assert(label:IsA('TextLabel'),'Expected original world sign '..row[1])
  assert(label.Text==row[2] or label.Text==row[3],'World sign text differs at '..row[1])
  if label.Text~=row[3] then table.insert(texts,{Label=label,Path=row[1],Before=label.Text,After=row[3]}) end
 end
 return {Lobby=lobby,Previous=previous,Moves=moves,Archives=archives,Texts=texts,Arena=arenaAnchor,ArenaBefore=arenaAnchor.CFrame}
end
function B.Apply(lobby,backup,arenaAnchor)
 assert(backup and backup:IsA('Folder') and backup:IsDescendantOf(game:GetService('ServerStorage')),'Provide a ServerStorage backup Folder')
 local plan=B.Plan(lobby,arenaAnchor)
 local staged=B.Build(nil)
 local moved,transforms,clones={},{},{}
 local journal
 local function restore()
  for i=#transforms,1,-1 do
   local row=transforms[i]
   for _,p in ipairs(row.Parts) do p[1].CFrame=p[2] end
   for _,p in ipairs(row.Pivots) do p[1].WorldPivot=p[2] end
   for _,a in ipairs(row.Attributes) do a[1]:SetAttribute(a[2],a[3]) end
  end
  arenaAnchor.CFrame=plan.ArenaBefore
  for _,row in ipairs(plan.Texts) do row.Label.Text=row.Before end
  for i=#moved,1,-1 do moved[i][1].Parent=moved[i][2] end
 end
 local ok,err=pcall(function()
  journal=Instance.new('Folder');journal.Name='LobbyTransformJournalV16';journal.Parent=backup;table.insert(clones,journal)
  local originalArena=Instance.new('CFrameValue');originalArena.Name='OriginalActiveArenaAnchor';originalArena.Value=plan.ArenaBefore;originalArena.Parent=journal
  for _,row in ipairs(plan.Texts) do
   local saved=Instance.new('StringValue');saved.Name='OriginalSignText';saved.Value=row.Before;saved:SetAttribute('OriginalPath','Workspace/Lobby/'..row.Path);saved.Parent=journal
   row.Label.Text=row.After
  end
  for _,move in ipairs(plan.Moves) do
   local clone=move.Model:Clone();assert(clone,'Cannot back up non-archivable booth '..move.Path);clone.Name='Original '..move.Model.Name;clone:SetAttribute('OriginalPath','Workspace/Lobby/'..move.Path);clone.Parent=backup;table.insert(clones,clone)
   local snapshot={Parts={},Pivots={},Attributes={}};table.insert(transforms,snapshot)
   local all={move.Model};for _,o in ipairs(move.Model:GetDescendants()) do table.insert(all,o) end
   for _,o in ipairs(all) do
    if o:IsA('BasePart') then table.insert(snapshot.Parts,{o,o.CFrame})
    elseif o:IsA('Model') then table.insert(snapshot.Pivots,{o,o:GetPivot()}) end
    for name,value in pairs(o:GetAttributes()) do if typeof(value)=='CFrame' then table.insert(snapshot.Attributes,{o,name,value}) end end
   end
   for _,p in ipairs(snapshot.Parts) do p[1].CFrame=move.Delta*p[2] end
   for _,p in ipairs(snapshot.Pivots) do p[1].WorldPivot=move.Delta*p[2] end
   for _,a in ipairs(snapshot.Attributes) do a[1]:SetAttribute(a[2],move.Delta*a[3]) end
  end
  for _,o in ipairs(plan.Archives) do table.insert(moved,{o,o.Parent});o.Parent=backup end
  if plan.Previous then table.insert(moved,{plan.Previous,plan.Previous.Parent});plan.Previous.Parent=backup end
  arenaAnchor.CFrame=CF(0,-27,-190)
  staged.Parent=lobby
 end)
 if not ok then
  staged:Destroy();restore();for _,o in ipairs(clones) do o:Destroy() end
  error('V16 lobby rolled back: '..tostring(err))
 end
 local undone=false
 return staged,{Moves=#transforms,Archived=#moved,Undo=function()
  if undone then return end
  assert(staged.Parent==lobby,'Lobby changed after this transaction')
  staged:Destroy();restore();for _,o in ipairs(clones) do o:Destroy() end;undone=true
 end}
end
return B

end)()
local World=(function()
-- Geometry transaction only. All gameplay controllers keep their original paths.
local W={Version=16}
local roots={
 {Path='ServerStorage/MapLibrary',Name='MapLibrary',Kind='library'},
 {Path='ReplicatedStorage/BombTagV6Previews',Name='BombTagV6Previews',Kind='previews'},
 {Path='ReplicatedStorage/BombTagPreviewGalleryV5',Name='BombTagPreviewGalleryV5',Kind='legacy'},
 {Path='Workspace/Maps',Name='Maps',Kind='active'},
}
local legacyNames={'Sky Garden','Sunset Docks','Neon District','Crystal Cavern'}
local function one(parent,name)
 local found
 for _,o in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do if o.Name==name then assert(not found,'Duplicate '..parent:GetFullName()..'/'..name);found=o end end
 assert(found,'Missing '..parent:GetFullName()..'/'..name);return found
end
local function path(name)
 local parts=string.split(name,'/');local o=game:GetService(parts[1])
 for i=2,#parts do o=one(o,parts[i]) end
 return o
end
local function close(a,b)
 local aa,bb={a:GetComponents()},{b:GetComponents()}
 for i=1,12 do if math.abs(aa[i]-bb[i])>.002 then return false end end
 return true
end
local function geometryOnly(root)
 for _,o in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
  assert(not o:IsA('LuaSourceContainer'),'Unexpected script inside archived geometry: '..o:GetFullName())
 end
end
local function catalogNames()
 local names={}
 for _,entry in ipairs(Maps.Catalog) do assert(not names[entry.Name],'Duplicate map catalog entry');names[entry.Name]=true end
 return names
end
local function validateMap(model,installed,playable)
 assert(model:IsA('Model'),'Expected arena Model: '..model:GetFullName())
 if installed then
  assert(model:GetAttribute('HABMapVersion')==16 and model:GetAttribute('HABWorldVersion')==16,'Unknown map version at '..model:GetFullName())
  assert(model:GetAttribute('NoJumpRequired')==true,'Missing no-jump route contract at '..model:GetFullName())
 end
 if playable or installed then
  local floor=one(model,'Floor');local spawns=one(model,'Spawns')
  assert(floor:IsA('BasePart') and floor.Anchored,'Invalid arena Floor: '..model:GetFullName())
  if installed then
   -- Floor is the invisible voting/pivot reference; polygon tiles provide the
   -- playable collision so each arena can have a different outline.
   local ground=0
   for _,o in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do if o:IsA('BasePart') and o:GetAttribute('HABGroundV16')==true and o.Anchored and o.CanCollide then ground+=1 end end
   assert(ground>0,'V16 arena has no solid foundation: '..model:GetFullName())
  end
  assert(model.PrimaryPart==floor,'Arena PrimaryPart must remain Floor: '..model:GetFullName())
  assert(spawns:IsA('Folder'),'Arena Spawns must be a Folder: '..model:GetFullName())
  local children=spawns:GetChildren();assert(#children>=2,'Arena has too few spawns: '..model:GetFullName())
  if installed then assert(#children==16,'V16 arena must have sixteen spawn markers: '..model:GetFullName()) end
  local names={}
  for _,o in ipairs(children) do
   assert(o:IsA('BasePart') and o.Anchored and not names[o.Name],'Invalid or duplicate spawn in '..model:GetFullName());names[o.Name]=true
   if installed then assert(o:GetAttribute('HABSpawnV16')==true,'Missing V16 spawn marker at '..o:GetFullName()) end
  end
 end
end
local function validateRoot(folder,kind,installed,activeName)
 assert(folder:IsA('Folder'),'Expected map Folder: '..folder:GetFullName());geometryOnly(folder)
 assert((folder:GetAttribute('HABWorldVersion')==16)==installed,'Mixed original/V16 world at '..folder:GetFullName()..'; restore a complete backup first')
 local wanted=kind=='legacy' and {} or catalogNames()
 if kind=='legacy' then for _,name in ipairs(legacyNames) do wanted[name]=true end end
 if kind=='active' then wanted={[activeName]=true} end
 for _,model in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
  assert(wanted[model.Name],'Unexpected or duplicate map '..model:GetFullName());wanted[model.Name]=nil
  validateMap(model,installed,kind=='library' or kind=='active')
  if not installed and (kind=='library' or kind=='previews' or kind=='active') then
   assert(model:GetAttribute('BombTagGenerated')=='HussWorld11','Unrecognized original arena at '..model:GetFullName())
  end
 end
 for name in pairs(wanted) do error('Missing map '..folder:GetFullName()..'/'..name) end
end
function W.Plan(version)
 assert(version==nil or version==16,'V16 requires the original HABWAS place or this V16 update')
 local lobby=path('Workspace/Lobby');local anchor=path('Workspace/ActiveArenaAnchor')
 local lobbyPlan=Lobby.Plan(lobby,anchor)
 local installed=version==16
 assert((lobbyPlan.Previous~=nil)==installed,'Lobby/version marker disagree; restore a complete original or V16 backup first')
 local active=path('Workspace/Maps');local children=active:GetChildren()
 assert(#children==1 and children[1]:IsA('Model'),'Workspace/Maps must contain one active arena')
 local activeModel=children[1]
 local voted=activeModel:GetAttribute('VotedMap') or activeModel:GetAttribute('DisplayName')
 assert(catalogNames()[voted],'Active arena has an unknown VotedMap')
 assert(workspace:GetAttribute('CurrentVotedMap')==voted,'CurrentVotedMap disagrees with active arena')
 local out={Installed=installed,Lobby=lobby,LobbyPlan=lobbyPlan,Anchor=anchor,Roots={},ActiveName=activeModel.Name,VotedMap=voted}
 for _,entry in ipairs(roots) do
  local o=path(entry.Path);validateRoot(o,entry.Kind,installed,out.ActiveName)
  table.insert(out.Roots,{Object=o,Parent=o.Parent,Path=entry.Path,Name=entry.Name,Kind=entry.Kind})
 end
 local floor=one(activeModel,'Floor')
 local top=floor.Position+Vector3.new(0,floor.Size.Y/2,0)
 assert((top-anchor.Position).Magnitude<.01,'Active arena Floor does not match ActiveArenaAnchor')
 geometryOnly(lobby)
 for _,move in ipairs(lobbyPlan.Moves) do
  assert(move.Model.Archivable,'Booth must be Archivable: '..move.Path)
  for _,o in ipairs(move.Model:GetDescendants()) do assert(o.Archivable,'Booth descendant must be Archivable: '..o:GetFullName()) end
 end
 assert(lobby.Archivable,'Lobby must be Archivable for an independent backup')
 for _,o in ipairs(lobby:GetDescendants()) do assert(o.Archivable,'Lobby descendant must be Archivable: '..o:GetFullName()) end
 out.Changed=not installed or #lobbyPlan.Moves>0 or #lobbyPlan.Archives>0 or #lobbyPlan.Texts>0
 return out
end
function W.Stage(plan,staging)
 local state={Plan=plan,Staging=staging,NewRoots={},NewLobby=nil,Undo=nil}
 if not plan.Changed then return state end
 if not plan.Installed then
  local archive=Maps.BuildArchive({MapName=plan.ActiveName,VotedMap=plan.VotedMap,Anchor=Vector3.new(0,-27,-190)})
  archive.Parent=staging;state.Archive=archive
  assert(#archive:GetChildren()==#roots,'Map builder returned an incomplete archive')
  for _,entry in ipairs(plan.Roots) do
   local o=one(archive,entry.Name);validateRoot(o,entry.Kind,true,plan.ActiveName)
   table.insert(state.NewRoots,{Object=o,Parent=entry.Parent,Original=entry.Object,Path=entry.Path})
  end
 end
 -- Exercise geometry construction while no originals have been touched.
 local preview=Lobby.Build(nil);preview.Parent=staging
 assert(preview.Name=='HABLobbyLayoutV16' and preview:GetAttribute('HABLobbyLayoutVersion')==16,'Lobby builder returned an unknown root')
 geometryOnly(preview);preview:Destroy()
 return state
end
function W.Backup(state,folder)
 if not state.Plan.Changed then return end
 state.Backup=folder
 local plan=state.Plan;local lp=plan.LobbyPlan
 local maps=Instance.new('Folder');maps.Name='OriginalMapRoots';maps.Parent=folder;state.MapBackup=maps
 local architecture=Instance.new('Folder');architecture.Name='LobbyArchitecture';architecture.Parent=folder;state.LobbyBackup=architecture
 local recovery=Instance.new('Folder');recovery.Name='IndependentLobbyRecovery';recovery.Parent=folder
 local copy=assert(plan.Lobby:Clone(),'Cannot clone original lobby');copy.Name='OriginalLobby';copy.Parent=recovery
 copy:SetAttribute('OriginalPath','Workspace/Lobby')
 local saved=Instance.new('CFrameValue');saved.Name='OriginalActiveArenaAnchor';saved.Value=plan.Anchor.CFrame;saved.Parent=recovery
 -- This separate journal is captured before Lobby.Apply. Its recovery does not
 -- depend on that builder reaching its return or finishing its own Undo.
 local journal={Parents={},Parts={},Pivots={},Attributes={},Texts={},Anchor=plan.Anchor.CFrame,Previous=lp.Previous}
 state.Journal=journal
 for _,o in ipairs(lp.Archives) do table.insert(journal.Parents,{o,o.Parent}) end
 if lp.Previous then table.insert(journal.Parents,{lp.Previous,lp.Previous.Parent}) end
 for _,row in ipairs(lp.Texts) do table.insert(journal.Texts,{row.Label,row.Label.Text}) end
 for _,move in ipairs(lp.Moves) do
  local all={move.Model};for _,o in ipairs(move.Model:GetDescendants()) do table.insert(all,o) end
  for _,o in ipairs(all) do
   if o:IsA('BasePart') then table.insert(journal.Parts,{o,o.CFrame})
   elseif o:IsA('Model') then table.insert(journal.Pivots,{o,o.WorldPivot}) end
   for name,value in pairs(o:GetAttributes()) do if typeof(value)=='CFrame' then table.insert(journal.Attributes,{o,name,value}) end end
  end
 end
end
function W.Apply(state)
 if not state.Plan.Changed then return end
 assert(state.Journal and state.Backup:IsDescendantOf(game:GetService('ServerStorage')),'World backup must be complete before commit')
 for _,row in ipairs(state.NewRoots) do
  row.Original.Parent=state.MapBackup;assert(row.Original.Parent==state.MapBackup,'Cannot archive '..row.Path)
  row.Object.Parent=row.Parent;assert(row.Object.Parent==row.Parent,'Cannot install '..row.Path)
 end
 local newLobby,result=Lobby.Apply(state.Plan.Lobby,state.LobbyBackup,state.Plan.Anchor)
 state.NewLobby=newLobby;state.Undo=result and result.Undo
 assert(newLobby.Parent==state.Plan.Lobby,'Lobby parent readback failed')
end
function W.Verify(state)
 local plan=state.Plan
 local lp=Lobby.Plan(plan.Lobby,plan.Anchor)
 assert(lp.Previous and #lp.Moves==0 and #lp.Archives==0 and #lp.Texts==0,'Lobby commit did not reach its target layout')
 for _,entry in ipairs(plan.Roots) do validateRoot(path(entry.Path),entry.Kind,true,plan.ActiveName) end
 local floor=one(one(path('Workspace/Maps'),plan.ActiveName),'Floor')
 assert((floor.Position+Vector3.new(0,floor.Size.Y/2,0)-plan.Anchor.Position).Magnitude<.01,'Installed arena does not align with viewing anchor')
 assert(workspace:GetAttribute('CurrentVotedMap')==plan.VotedMap,'Map selection was unexpectedly changed')
end
function W.Rollback(state)
 local failures={}
 local function restore(label,fn)
  local ok,message=pcall(fn);if not ok then table.insert(failures,label..': '..tostring(message)) end
 end
 if state.Undo then pcall(state.Undo) end -- independent restoration below is authoritative
 local journal=state.Journal
 if journal then
  for _,row in ipairs(journal.Parts) do restore(row[1].Name..' CFrame',function() row[1].CFrame=row[2];assert(close(row[1].CFrame,row[2]),'readback failed') end) end
  for _,row in ipairs(journal.Pivots) do restore(row[1].Name..' pivot',function() row[1].WorldPivot=row[2];assert(close(row[1].WorldPivot,row[2]),'readback failed') end) end
  for _,row in ipairs(journal.Attributes) do restore(row[1].Name..' attribute '..row[2],function() row[1]:SetAttribute(row[2],row[3]);assert(close(row[1]:GetAttribute(row[2]),row[3]),'readback failed') end) end
  for _,row in ipairs(journal.Texts) do restore(row[1].Name..' text',function() row[1].Text=row[2];assert(row[1].Text==row[2],'readback failed') end) end
  restore('ActiveArenaAnchor',function() state.Plan.Anchor.CFrame=journal.Anchor;assert(close(state.Plan.Anchor.CFrame,journal.Anchor),'readback failed') end)
  for _,row in ipairs(journal.Parents) do restore(row[1].Name..' parent',function() row[1].Parent=row[2];assert(row[1].Parent==row[2],'readback failed') end) end
  for _,o in ipairs(state.Plan.Lobby:GetChildren()) do
   if o.Name=='HABLobbyLayoutV16' and o~=journal.Previous then restore('New lobby root',function() o:Destroy();assert(o.Parent==nil,'delete readback failed') end) end
  end
 end
 for _,row in ipairs(state.NewRoots) do
  restore(row.Path..' original',function() row.Original.Parent=row.Parent;assert(row.Original.Parent==row.Parent,'readback failed') end)
  restore(row.Path..' new geometry',function() row.Object:Destroy();assert(row.Object.Parent==nil,'delete readback failed') end)
 end
 return failures
end
return W

end)()
local priorVersion=workspace:GetAttribute('HABPolishVersion')
if priorVersion~=nil and priorVersion~=16 then problem('Workspace.HABPolishVersion='..tostring(priorVersion)..'. V16 starts from the uploaded HABWAS place; open that original or restore its complete backup.') end
for _,name in ipairs({'HABMonetizationConfigV15','HABModalV15','HABUILayoutV15','HABActionAnimationsV15','HABAbilityEffectsV15','HABCleanCosmeticsV15'}) do
 for _,o in ipairs(Replicated:GetDescendants()) do if o.Name==name then problem('Rejected V15 runtime '..full(o)..'; this installer uses the original HABWAS gameplay and UI.') end end
end
local objects,edits,additions,compileObjects={},{},{},{}
for _,entry in ipairs(entries) do
 local object=find(entry.path,entry.add)
 if entry.add then
  local name=entry.path:match('[^/]+$')
  for _,other in ipairs(Replicated:GetDescendants()) do
   if other.Name==name and other~=object then problem(entry.path..': another copy exists at '..full(other)) end
  end
 end
 if object then
  objects[entry.path]=object
  if object.ClassName~=entry.class then problem(entry.path..': expected '..entry.class..', found '..object.ClassName)
  else
   local source=try(entry.path..' source read',function() return object.Source end)
   if type(source)=='string' then
    local actual=canonical(source)
    local oldMatches=entry.old and actual==canonical(entry.old)
    local targetMatches=entry.target and actual==canonical(entry.target)
    if not oldMatches and not targetMatches then
     problem(entry.path..': source differs from both the actual uploaded HABWAS script and this V16 update. Custom edits were preserved; review them before installing.')
    else
     if entry.target and not targetMatches then table.insert(edits,{object=object,target=entry.target,path=entry.path}) end
     table.insert(compileObjects,{path=entry.path,text=entry.target or source})
    end
   end
   if object:IsA('BaseScript') and object.Disabled~=entry.disabled then problem(entry.path..': unexpected Disabled state; controller ownership requires review.') end
  end
 elseif entry.add then
  local parent=find(entry.path:match('^(.*)/[^/]+$'))
  if parent then
   table.insert(additions,{parent=parent,name=entry.path:match('[^/]+$'),class=entry.class,target=entry.target,path=entry.path})
   table.insert(compileObjects,{path=entry.path,text=entry.target})
  end
 end
end
-- The supplied place's only bootstrap is INSIDE Services. Do not create another.
local mainCount=0
for _,o in ipairs(Server:GetDescendants()) do
 if o.Name=='ServerMain' and o:IsA('LuaSourceContainer') then
  mainCount+=1
  if o~=objects['ServerScriptService/Services/ServerMain'] then problem('Competing ServerMain at '..full(o)) end
 end
end
if mainCount~=1 then problem('Expected exactly one ServerMain at ServerScriptService/Services/ServerMain; found '..mainCount) end
local worldPlan=try('World compatibility',function() return World.Plan(priorVersion) end)
stop()
local staging=Instance.new('Folder');staging.Name='HABPolishV16Preflight'
while Storage:FindFirstChild(staging.Name) do staging.Name..='_' end
staging.Parent=Storage
for _,entry in ipairs(compileObjects) do
 local probe=Instance.new('ModuleScript');probe.Name='SyntaxProbe';probe.Parent=staging
 local ok,err=pcall(function()
  local wrapper='return function()\n'..entry.text..'\nend\n'
  probe.Source=wrapper;assert(probe.Source==wrapper,'Source readback mismatch')
  -- Parsing occurs, but the returned function is never called. No live module,
  -- purchase handler, profile writer, animation or gameplay service runs here.
  assert(type(require(probe))=='function','Unexpected syntax-probe result')
 end)
 probe:Destroy()
 if not ok then problem(entry.path..': Luau syntax probe failed: '..tostring(err)) end
end
if #issues>0 then staging:Destroy();stop() end
if #edits==0 and #additions==0 and not worldPlan.Changed and priorVersion==16 then
 local ok,err=pcall(function() World.Verify({Plan=worldPlan}) end)
 staging:Destroy()
 if not ok then error('V16 validation stopped; existing game preserved: '..tostring(err),0) end
 print('V16 already installed. Sources, dependencies, map structure and Luau syntax verified. No duplicate systems, geometry or backups created.')
 return
end
local backup=Instance.new('Folder');backup.Name='HABPolishV16Backup_'..os.time()
while Storage:FindFirstChild(backup.Name) do backup.Name..='_' end
local originals,created={},{}
local worldState
local ok,err=pcall(function()
 local scripts=Instance.new('Folder');scripts.Name='Scripts';scripts.Parent=backup
 local world=Instance.new('Folder');world.Name='World';world.Parent=backup
 for _,entry in ipairs(edits) do
  local o=entry.object;assert(o.Archivable,entry.path..' must be Archivable for a source backup')
  local old={source=o.Source,disabled=nil};if o:IsA('BaseScript') then old.disabled=o.Disabled end
  originals[o]=old
  local copy=assert(o:Clone(),'Cannot clone '..entry.path);copy.Name=tostring(#scripts:GetChildren()+1)..'_'..o.Name
  copy:SetAttribute('OriginalPath',entry.path)
  if copy:IsA('BaseScript') then copy:SetAttribute('OriginalDisabled',o.Disabled);copy.Disabled=true end
  copy.Parent=scripts
 end
 for _,entry in ipairs(additions) do
  local o=Instance.new(entry.class);o.Name=entry.name;o.Source=entry.target;o.Parent=staging
  assert(o.Source==entry.target,'New module source readback failed: '..entry.path)
  table.insert(created,{object=o,parent=entry.parent,path=entry.path})
 end
 worldState=World.Stage(worldPlan,staging)
 World.Backup(worldState,world)
 backup:SetAttribute('OriginalPolishVersion',priorVersion)
 backup:SetAttribute('Installer','HAB V16 for original HABWAS')
 backup:SetAttribute('OriginalUploadSHA256','c354d8c3c7ac43b9364749aa292716aa592eee6f496f532c98c0bafb88279309')
 local lines={'V16 stopped-Studio installation backup. Do not run archived scripts.','',
  'Restore each Scripts copy Source to its OriginalPath and OriginalDisabled state.',
  'World/OriginalMapRoots: move MapLibrary to ServerStorage; Maps to Workspace; BombTagV6Previews and BombTagPreviewGalleryV5 to ReplicatedStorage. Remove the corresponding new roots first.',
  'World/IndependentLobbyRecovery/OriginalLobby is a complete original lobby clone. It can replace Workspace/Lobby for manual disaster recovery.',
  'World/LobbyArchitecture retains archived originals, original booth clones and the builder transform journal. The independent lobby clone preserves full original properties.',
  'Restore Workspace/ActiveArenaAnchor.CFrame from World/IndependentLobbyRecovery/OriginalActiveArenaAnchor.',
  'Restore Workspace.HABPolishVersion from OriginalPolishVersion on this backup; no attribute means remove it.',
  'Original round, bomb and movement rules are unchanged. Reviewed changes protect economy startup and block retired effect purchases; saved profile data is not rewritten.',
  '', 'ADDED MODULES (remove during full manual restore):'}
 for _,row in ipairs(created) do table.insert(lines,row.path) end
 local record=Instance.new('StringValue');record.Name='RestoreManifest';record.Value=table.concat(lines,'\n');record.Parent=backup
end)
if not ok then
 staging:Destroy();backup:Destroy()
 error('V16 staging failed; original scripts and world were not modified: '..tostring(err),0)
end
ok,err=pcall(function()
 backup.Parent=Storage;assert(backup.Parent==Storage,'Backup parent commit failed')
 for _,row in ipairs(created) do row.object.Parent=row.parent;assert(row.object.Parent==row.parent,'Module parent commit failed: '..row.path) end
 for _,entry in ipairs(edits) do entry.object.Source=entry.target;assert(entry.object.Source==entry.target,'Source write/readback failed: '..entry.path) end
 World.Apply(worldState)
 World.Verify(worldState)
 workspace:SetAttribute('HABPolishVersion',16)
 assert(workspace:GetAttribute('HABPolishVersion')==16,'Version marker readback failed')
end)
if not ok then
 local failures={}
 local function restore(label,fn)
  local success,message=pcall(fn);if not success then table.insert(failures,label..': '..tostring(message)) end
 end
 local restored,worldFailures=pcall(function() return World.Rollback(worldState) end)
 if restored then for _,message in ipairs(worldFailures) do table.insert(failures,message) end
 else table.insert(failures,'World recovery journal: '..tostring(worldFailures)) end
 for _,row in ipairs(created) do restore(row.path,function() row.object:Destroy();assert(row.object.Parent==nil,'Removal readback failed') end) end
 for o,old in pairs(originals) do restore(full(o),function()
  o.Source=old.source;assert(o.Source==old.source,'Source restoration readback failed')
  if old.disabled~=nil then o.Disabled=old.disabled;assert(o.Disabled==old.disabled,'Disabled restoration readback failed') end
 end) end
 restore('Version marker',function() workspace:SetAttribute('HABPolishVersion',priorVersion);assert(workspace:GetAttribute('HABPolishVersion')==priorVersion,'Version restoration readback failed') end)
 restore('Preflight cleanup',function() staging:Destroy() end)
 if #failures==0 then
  backup:Destroy()
  error('V16 installation rolled back; original scripts, world objects and properties restored. Initial error: '..tostring(err),0)
 end
 -- Never delete originals when even one recovery operation cannot be verified.
 local saved,saveError=pcall(function() backup.Parent=Storage end)
 error('V16 installation stopped. Backup retained at ServerStorage/'..backup.Name..(saved and '' or ' (backup parent failure: '..tostring(saveError)..')')..'. Restore errors: '..table.concat(failures,'; ')..'. Initial error: '..tostring(err),0)
end
staging:Destroy()
print('V16 installed. Original/target source compatibility, dependencies, Luau syntax, world validation and commit readbacks passed.')
print('Backup: ServerStorage/'..backup.Name..'. Original GUI and gameplay are preserved. Fifteen replacement maps, spectator lobby, ability poses and new weave are installed.')
print('Save a separate copy, then test solo practice and two-player rounds in Studio before publishing. Native animation playback and physics still require that playtest.')
